```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy("status", "plan").orderBy("row_num", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

base = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("start_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-07-14")))
    .select(

        "customer_id",

        (F.datediff(F.current_date(), "end_date") / 30).alias("months_since_end_date"),
    )
)

latest = (
    base
    .withColumn("row_num", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("monthly_fee").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

metrics = (
    latest
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("months_since_end_date").over(w_recent).alias("running_sum_months_since_end_date"),
        F.max("months_since_end_date").over(w_recent).alias("running_max_months_since_end_date"),
        F.avg("months_since_end_date").over(w_recent).alias("running_avg_months_since_end_date"),
        F.min("months_since_end_date").over(w_recent).alias("running_min_months_since_end_date"),
        F.avg("months_since_end_date").over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("start_date"))).alias("start_date_year_avg_months_since_end_date"),
    )
)

        "s.days_start_date_to_end_date",

        "s.running_sum_months_since_end_date",
        "s.running_max_months_since_end_date",
        "s.running_avg_months_since_end_date",
        "s.start_date_year_avg_months_since_end_date",
        F.col("c.age"),
        F.col("c.city"),
        F.col("c.country"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    enriched

    .withColumn("age_whole", F.floor("age"))
)

enriched_subscriptions = (

)

enriched_subscriptions_2 = (
    enriched_subscriptions
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("running_max_months_since_end_date").over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("running_sum_months_since_end_date", "id")).alias("next_running_max_months_since_end_date"),
        F.lag("days_start_date_to_end_date").over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("running_sum_months_since_end_date", "id")).alias("prev_days_start_date_to_end_date"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("running_sum_months_since_end_date", "id")).alias("seq_no"),
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "country").orderBy(F.col("days_start_date_to_end_date").desc_nulls_last())).alias("days_start_date_to_end_date_cume_dist"),
    )

        F.round(F.sum("age_whole") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "London", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("age_whole_per_london"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("country")).alias("num_countries"),
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("country") == "US", F.col("age"))).alias("us_avg_age"),
    )
)

result = (

        "age_whole_quartiles",
        "us_avg_age",
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_shipments
    .filter((F.col("shipped_date") > F.lit("2023-09-05").cast("date")) & F.col("carrier").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "delivered_date",
        "cost",
        "status",
        F.round(F.datediff(F.col("delivered_date"), F.col("shipped_date")) / 30, 1).alias("months_shipped_date_to_delivered_date"),
        F.concat_ws("-", F.col("status"), F.col("carrier")).alias("status_carrier_key"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("carrier"), F.lit("OTHER")).alias("carrier_clean"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    base
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("b"), F.col("src.order_id") == F.col("b.id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "src.id",
        "src.order_id",
        "src.carrier",
        "src.shipped_date",
        "src.delivered_date",
        "src.cost",
        "src.carrier_clean",
        F.col("b.discount"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    with_dims
    .filter((F.col("delivered_date") > F.lit("2023-05-26").cast("date")) & F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.date_add(F.col("delivered_date"), 2).alias("delivered_date_plus_2d"),
        F.when(F.col("discount") >= 0.36, "High").when(F.col("discount") >= 0.08, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("discount_level"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("carrier"), F.lit("N/A")).alias("resolved_carrier"),
    )
)

with_dims_shipments = (
    cleaned
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("d"), F.col("src.order_id") == F.col("d.id"), "inner")
    .select("src.*", F.col("d.status"), F.col("d.amount"), F.col("d.channel"))
)

deduped = (
    with_dims_shipments
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .drop("rank_in_group")
)

result = (
    deduped
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("year", "shipped_date").alias("year_start"))
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("cost") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "COMPLETED", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("cost_per_completed"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("channel") == "mobile", 1)).alias("mobile_rows"),
        F.percentile_approx("discount", 0.5).alias("discount_p50"),
        F.countDistinct("carrier").alias("distinct_carriers"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("discount_p50") >= 0)
    .orderBy(F.col("cost_per_completed").desc())
)
```

```python
        F.count("latency_ms").over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("log_ts"), "host").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-900, Window.currentRow)).alias("latency_ms_count_15m"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_running = Window.partitionBy("dept_id").orderBy("salary", "id")

scored = (
    df_employees
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("salary", 1).over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("hire_date"), "dept_id").orderBy("salary", "id")).alias("prev_salary"),
        F.avg("salary").over(Window.orderBy("hire_date", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)).alias("salary_avg_5_prior"),
        F.lag("salary", 1, 0).over(w_running).alias("prev_salary_2"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "manager_id",
        "job_title",
        "is_remote",
        "level",
        "prev_salary",
        "prev_salary_2",
        F.lead("prev_salary", 2, 0).over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("hire_date")).orderBy("salary", "id")).alias("next_prev_salary"),
        F.avg("salary_avg_5_prior").over(Window.orderBy("salary_avg_5_prior", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)).alias("salary_avg_5_prior_avg_5"),
        F.sum("salary_avg_5_prior").over(Window.orderBy("prev_salary", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_salary_avg_5_prior"),
        F.last("prev_salary", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy("prev_salary_2", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_prev_salary"),
        F.round((F.col("prev_salary_2") / F.sum("prev_salary_2").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("hire_date"), "manager_id"))), 4).alias("prev_salary_2_share"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    with_windows
    .select("job_title")
    .intersect(
        df_employees
        .filter(F.upper("full_name").like("%OB %"))
        .select("job_title")
    )
)

verified = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.job_title") == F.col("k.job_title")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

metrics = (
    verified
    .select(
        "id",
        "manager_id",
        "job_title",
        "level",
        "prev_salary",
        "prev_salary_2",
        "next_prev_salary",
        "salary_avg_5_prior_avg_5",
        "last_known_prev_salary",
        "prev_salary_2_share",
        F.avg("prev_salary_2").over(Window.partitionBy("level")).alias("level_avg_prev_salary_2"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    metrics
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_employees.alias("e"), F.col("a.manager_id") == F.col("e.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("e.email").like("%@yahoo.com"))
    .select(
        "a.*",
        F.col("e.salary"),
        F.col("e.level").alias("employee_level"),
        F.col("e.full_name"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_dims
    .groupBy("job_title")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("job_title") == "Designer", 1)).alias("designer_rows"),

)
```

```python
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("account_id", "merchant").orderBy("balance", "id")).alias("seq_no"),
    )
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid = (
    df_stores
    .filter((F.col("opened_date") > F.lit("2023-07-31").cast("date")) & F.col("region").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.floor("sqft").alias("sqft_whole"),
        F.coalesce("region", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("resolved_region"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    valid
    .select(
        "id",
        "region",
        "sqft_whole",
        "resolved_region",
        F.ntile(3).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("sqft_whole").desc(), "id")).alias("sqft_whole_bucket"),
        F.sum("sqft_whole").over(Window.orderBy("opened_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_sqft_whole"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy(F.col("running_sqft_whole").desc_nulls_first())))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

base = (
    ranked
    .filter(F.col("region").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "region",
        "sqft_whole",
        "resolved_region",
        "running_sqft_whole",
        "dedup_rank",
        F.coalesce("region", F.lit("unassigned")).alias("region_filled"),
        F.coalesce("region", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("resolved_region_2"),
    )
)

enriched_stores = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") <= 1)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy(F.col("sqft_whole").desc_nulls_first())).alias("sqft_whole_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy(F.col("running_sqft_whole").desc_nulls_first())).alias("running_sqft_whole_cume_dist"),
        F.first("running_sqft_whole", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy("dedup_rank", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_running_sqft_whole"),
    )
)

daily = (
    enriched_stores
    .cube("region")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("running_sqft_whole_cume_dist") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("region") == "West", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("running_sqft_whole_cume_dist_per_west"),
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("region") == "Central", F.col("running_sqft_whole_cume_dist"))).alias("central_avg_running_sqft_whole_cume_dist"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("region")).alias("num_regions"),
        F.percentile_approx("sqft_whole_rank", 0.5).alias("sqft_whole_rank_p50"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("gid"),
    )
)

result = (
    daily
    .select(
        "running_sqft_whole_cume_dist_per_west",
        "central_avg_running_sqft_whole_cume_dist",
        "sqft_whole_rank_p50",
        "gid",
    )
    .orderBy("running_sqft_whole_cume_dist_per_west")
)
```

```python
        F.last("cost", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("shipped_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_cost"),
    )
)

base = (

    .filter(F.col("delivered_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-10-04")))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.coalesce("cost", F.lit(0)).alias("cost_filled"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid = (
    df_promotions
    .filter((F.col("discount_pct").between(0.14, 0.15)) & (F.col("ends_on") > F.lit("2023-12-08").cast("date")))
    .withColumn("promo_code_channel_key", F.concat_ws("-", "promo_code", "channel"))
    .withColumn("resolved_channel", F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("UNKNOWN")))
)

with_window = (
    valid
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.col("s.channel").eqNullSafe(F.col("pr.channel"))) & (F.col("s.starts_on").between(F.col("pr.starts_on"), F.col("pr.ends_on"))), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code").alias("promotion_promo_code"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct").alias("promotion_discount_pct"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    with_window
    .select(
        "id",
        "promo_code",
        "ends_on",
        "discount_pct",
        "promo_code_channel_key",
        "resolved_channel",
        "promo_id",
        "promotion_promo_code",
        F.count("promo_id").over(Window.partitionBy("promo_code", "channel").orderBy("discount_pct", "id", "promo_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count_promo_id"),
        F.sum("promo_id").over(Window.partitionBy("promo_code", "channel").orderBy("discount_pct", "id", "promo_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_sum_promo_id"),
        F.max("promo_id").over(Window.partitionBy("promo_code", "channel").orderBy("discount_pct", "id", "promo_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_max_promo_id"),
        F.avg("promo_id").over(Window.partitionBy("promo_code", "channel").orderBy("discount_pct", "id", "promo_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_avg_promo_id"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("rn", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("promotion_promo_code").orderBy(F.col("running_avg_promo_id").desc_nulls_last())))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

scored = (
    ranked
    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("running_avg_promo_id").over(Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("running_count_promo_id", "id", "promo_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_max_running_avg_promo_id"),
        F.avg("running_avg_promo_id").over(Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("running_count_promo_id", "id", "promo_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_avg_running_avg_promo_id"),
        F.sum("running_avg_promo_id").over(Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("running_count_promo_id", "id", "promo_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_sum_running_avg_promo_id"),
        F.count("running_avg_promo_id").over(Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("running_count_promo_id", "id", "promo_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count_running_avg_promo_id"),
        F.avg("running_count_promo_id").over(Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("ends_on", "id", "promo_id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)).alias("running_count_promo_id_avg_3_prior"),
    )
)

grouped = (
    scored
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("running_avg_promo_id") >= 10.4, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("running_avg_promo_id_tier"),
        "promo_id",
        F.when(F.col("discount_pct") >= 0.27, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("discount_pct_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("promotion_promo_code") == "VIP", 1)).alias("vip_count"),
        F.count_if(F.col("promotion_promo_code") == "BUNDLE").alias("bundle_events"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("promo_code")).alias("promo_code_list"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("promotion_promo_code")).alias("num_promotion_promo_codes"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("num_promotion_promo_codes") >= 1)
)

result = (
    grouped
    .select(
        "running_avg_promo_id_tier",
        "promo_id",
        "discount_pct_tier",
        "bundle_events",
        "promo_code_list",
        "num_promotion_promo_codes",
    )
    .orderBy("discount_pct_tier")
)
```

```python
exploded = (
```

```python
    .select(
```

```python
        "service",
        "level",
        F.explode("context").alias("key", "v"),
    )

    exploded
    .filter(~F.col("key").eqNullSafe(F.lit("trace")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "level",

        "v",
        F.upper("service").alias("service_upper"),
    )
)

    filtered
    .filter(F.col("key").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("key_filled", F.coalesce("key", F.lit("Unknown")))
)

cleaned = (
    filtered_app_logs
    .filter(F.col("key").isNotNull() & (F.col("key").eqNullSafe(F.lit("trace"))))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.concat_ws(",", "key", "service").alias("key_service_key"),
        F.length("service").alias("service_length"),
        F.coalesce("key", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("key_filled_2"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy(F.col("service_length").desc(), "id", "key")))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .drop("rn")
)

result = (
    deduped
    .groupBy("key")
    .agg(
        F.size(F.collect_set("level")).alias("num_levels"),
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("level") == "DEBUG", F.col("service_length"))).alias("debug_avg_service_length"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("level") == "INFO", F.col("service_length")).otherwise(0)).alias("info_service_length"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("running_max_shipping_fee", "id")
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("running_max_shipping_fee", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)

scored = (
    df_shipments
    .filter(F.col("status") == "LOST")
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count("cost").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count_cost"),
        F.avg("cost").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_avg_cost"),
        F.sum("cost").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_sum_cost"),
    )
)

joined = (
    scored
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_orders.alias("b"), F.col("e.order_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("b.shipping_fee"))
)

with_dims = (
    joined
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_orders.alias("p"), F.col("e.order_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("p.amount"), F.col("p.status").alias("order_status"))
)

scored_shipments = (
    with_dims
    .select(
        "id",
        "carrier",
        "running_avg_cost",
        "shipping_fee",
        "amount",
        F.max("shipping_fee").over(Window.partitionBy("order_status", "status").orderBy("running_sum_cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_max_shipping_fee"),
        F.min("shipping_fee").over(Window.partitionBy("order_status", "status").orderBy("running_sum_cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_min_shipping_fee"),
        F.count("shipping_fee").over(Window.partitionBy("order_status", "status").orderBy("running_sum_cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count_shipping_fee"),
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("status", "order_id").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc())).alias("amount_cume_dist"),
    )
)

latest = (
    scored_shipments
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy(F.col("running_avg_cost").desc_nulls_first())))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .drop("rank_in_group")
)

result = (
    latest
    .select(
        "id",
        "running_avg_cost",
        "shipping_fee",
        F.ntile(5).over(w_part).alias("running_max_shipping_fee_bucket"),
        F.round((F.col("running_avg_cost") / F.sum("running_avg_cost").over(Window.partitionBy("carrier"))), 4).alias("running_avg_cost_share"),
        F.avg("running_count_shipping_fee").over(w_ordered).alias("running_count_shipping_fee_avg_6_prior"),
    )
)
```

```python
        "customer_id",
        "plan",
        "end_date",
        "monthly_fee",
        "segment",
        "signup_date",
        F.avg("monthly_fee").over(w_ordered).alias("running_avg_monthly_fee"),
        F.max("monthly_fee").over(w_ordered).alias("running_max_monthly_fee"),
        F.sum("monthly_fee").over(w_ordered).alias("running_sum_monthly_fee"),
        F.ntile(3).over(w_part).alias("monthly_fee_bucket"),
    )
)

enriched_subscriptions = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "segment",
        "signup_date",
        "running_avg_monthly_fee",
        "monthly_fee_bucket",
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "segment").orderBy("running_sum_monthly_fee")).alias("running_sum_monthly_fee_cume_dist"),
        F.avg("monthly_fee_bucket").over(Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("monthly_fee_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)).alias("monthly_fee_bucket_avg_2"),
        F.round((F.col("running_sum_monthly_fee") / F.sum("running_sum_monthly_fee").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("signup_date"), "customer_id"))), 4).alias("running_sum_monthly_fee_share"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("segment").orderBy(F.col("running_sum_monthly_fee").desc(), "id")).alias("row_seq"),
        F.lag("monthly_fee", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("segment").orderBy("end_date", "id")).alias("prev_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    enriched_subscriptions
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_customers.alias("p"), F.col("e.customer_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("p.email"), F.col("p.signup_date").alias("customer_signup_date"))
)

result = (
    with_dims
    .rollup(
        "customer_id",
        F.when(F.col("monthly_fee_bucket") >= 7, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("monthly_fee_bucket_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("row_seq", 0.95).alias("row_seq_p95"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("segment") == "Consumer", F.col("running_sum_monthly_fee_share")).otherwise(0)).alias("consumer_running_sum_monthly_fee_share"),
        F.round(F.sum("monthly_fee_bucket") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("segment") == "Corporate", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("monthly_fee_bucket_per_corporate"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("consumer_running_sum_monthly_fee_share").desc_nulls_first())
)
```

```python
    df_products
    .filter(F.col("supplier_id").isNull() & (F.col("launch_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-06-28"))))
    .select(

        "launch_date",
        "tags",
        F.concat_ws(",", "category", "brand").alias("category_brand_key"),
    )

    base
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("cost").over(Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy("launch_date", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("cost_avg_3"),
        F.sum("cost").over(Window.partitionBy("brand", "category").orderBy("launch_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_cost"),
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy(F.col("cost").asc_nulls_first())).alias("cost_percent_rank"),
        F.round((F.col("cost") / F.sum("cost").over(Window.partitionBy("category"))), 4).alias("cost_share"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    scored

        "category",
        "brand",

        F.round("cost_share", 0).alias("cost_share_rounded"),

    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy(F.col("cost_percent_rank").desc(), "id")))

)

    latest
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_running = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("amount", "id")
w_part = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "segment").orderBy("prev_shipping_fee", "id")

base = (
    df_orders
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull() & (F.col("order_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-07-03"))))
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.datediff(F.current_date(), "order_date") / 365).alias("years_since_order_date"),
        F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("resolved_channel"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "store_id",
        "amount",
        "discount",
        "shipping_fee",
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("discount").desc_nulls_first())).alias("discount_rank"),
        F.lag("shipping_fee", 1, 0).over(w_running).alias("prev_shipping_fee"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("shipping_fee").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select("id", "customer_id", "discount", "prev_shipping_fee")
)

enriched = (
    ranked
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_customers.alias("c"), F.col("s.customer_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("c.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.city"), F.col("c.segment"), F.col("c.name"))
)

metrics = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("prev_shipping_fee") <= 33)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("discount").over(w_part).alias("next_discount"),
        F.lag("discount").over(w_part).alias("prev_discount"),
        F.lag("prev_shipping_fee").over(w_part).alias("prev_prev_shipping_fee"),
        F.lead("prev_shipping_fee").over(w_part).alias("next_prev_shipping_fee"),
        F.row_number().over(w_part).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

stats = (
    metrics
    .groupBy("city")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("segment") == "Corporate", 1)).alias("corporate_rows"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("segment") == "SMB", 1)).alias("smb_count"),
        F.countDistinct("city").alias("distinct_cities"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.percentile_approx("prev_discount", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("prev_discount_quartiles"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "Singapore", 1)).alias("singapore_count"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("distinct_ids") < 1000)
)

result = (
    stats
    .select(
        "city",
        "smb_count",
        "distinct_cities",
        "distinct_ids",
        "prev_discount_quartiles",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("city").asc_nulls_first())
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_running = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("shipping_fee", "id")
w_part = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("first_known_shipping_fee", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

valid = (
    df_orders
    .filter((F.col("order_date") > F.lit("2023-03-31").cast("date")) & F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "store_id",
        "order_date",
        "status",
        "shipping_fee",
        F.when(F.col("shipping_fee") >= 32, "High").when(F.col("shipping_fee") >= 8, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("shipping_fee_band"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    valid
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "store_id",
        "shipping_fee",
        "shipping_fee_band",
        F.lead("shipping_fee", 1).over(w_running).alias("next_shipping_fee"),
        F.last("shipping_fee", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy("shipping_fee", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_shipping_fee"),
        F.min("shipping_fee").over(Window.partitionBy("status")).alias("status_min_shipping_fee"),
        F.first("shipping_fee", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("order_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_shipping_fee"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("shipping_fee").desc(), "id")).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

with_windows_orders = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("last_known_shipping_fee").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("shipping_fee_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("shipping_fee").desc())))
    .withColumn("cumulative_last_known_shipping_fee", F.sum("last_known_shipping_fee").over(Window.orderBy("first_known_shipping_fee", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
)

with_dims = (
    with_windows_orders
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_customers.alias("c"), F.col("e.customer_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("c.id")), "left")
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.customer_id",
        "e.next_shipping_fee",
        "e.last_known_shipping_fee",
        "e.status_min_shipping_fee",
        "e.first_known_shipping_fee",
        "e.cumulative_last_known_shipping_fee",
        F.col("c.city"),
        F.col("c.name"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_dims
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("status_min_shipping_fee").over(w_part).alias("running_avg_status_min_shipping_fee"),
        F.min("status_min_shipping_fee").over(w_part).alias("running_min_status_min_shipping_fee"),
        F.max("status_min_shipping_fee").over(w_part).alias("running_max_status_min_shipping_fee"),
        F.sum("status_min_shipping_fee").over(w_part).alias("running_sum_status_min_shipping_fee"),
    )
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_running = Window.orderBy(F.col("key_count_latency_ms").asc_nulls_first())

exploded = (
    df_app_logs
    .select("id", "latency_ms", F.explode_outer("context").alias("key", "v"))
)

cleaned = (
    exploded
    .filter(~F.col("key").eqNullSafe(F.lit("region")))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.initcap(F.trim("key")).alias("key_title"),
        F.coalesce("key", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("key_clean"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("latency_ms") <= 1401)
    .select(
        "id",
        "latency_ms",
        "v",
        F.count("latency_ms").over(Window.partitionBy("key")).alias("key_count_latency_ms"),
    )
)

scored = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("key_count_latency_ms_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w_running))
)

matched_keys = (
    scored
    .select("id")
    .subtract(
        df_app_logs
        .filter(F.col("latency_ms") != 1363)
        .select("id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

kept_keys = (
    reconciled
    .select("id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_app_logs
        .filter(F.col("latency_ms").between(732, 1746))
        .select("id")
    )
)

reconciled_app_logs = (
    reconciled
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

base = (
    reconciled_app_logs
    .filter(F.col("key_count_latency_ms") <= 16)
    .select(
        "id",
        "latency_ms",
        "v",
        "key_count_latency_ms",
        "key_count_latency_ms_percent_rank",
        (F.col("key_count_latency_ms_percent_rank") - F.col("latency_ms")).alias("key_count_latency_ms_percent_rank_minus_latency_ms"),
    )
)

result = (
    base
    .select(
        "latency_ms",
        "v",
```

```python
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("attr_key", "value"),
    )
)

flattened_attrs = (
    exploded
    .select(
        "id",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "attr_key",
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(1) != 0).cast("int").alias("is_flagged"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    flattened_attrs
    .select("level", "id")
    .subtract(
        df_app_logs
        .filter(F.col("log_ts") < "2025-04-01")
        .select("level", "id")
    )
)

verified = (
    flattened_attrs
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.level") == F.col("k.level")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

enriched = (
    verified
    .withColumn("status_code_high_rank", F.rank().over(w_running))
    .select("*")
)

base = (
    enriched
    .filter((F.col("log_ts") > F.lit("2025-06-01 08:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & F.col("level").isin(["ERROR", "WARN"]))

        "id",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "attr_key",
        "status_code_high",
        "is_flagged",

        F.greatest("status_code_high", "is_flagged").alias("greatest_status_code_high_is_flagged"),
    )
)

result = (
    base
    .cube(F.date_trunc("DAY", "log_ts").alias("activity_day"))
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("attr_key") == "version", 1)).alias("version_rows"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("attr_key")).alias("attr_key_list"),
```

```python
    .withColumn("prev_rating", F.lag("rating", 2).over(w_running))
)

latest = (
    scored
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("country", "city").orderBy("cumulative_rating_cume_dist", "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

eligible = (
    latest
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.supplier_id").isNotNull()), "left_anti")
)

kept = (
    eligible
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.category") != "Grocery"), "left_anti")
)

kept_suppliers = (
    kept
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.category") != "Grocery"), "left_anti")
)

result = (
    kept_suppliers
    .withColumn("rating_share_tier", F.when(F.col("rating_share") >= 0.61, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL"))
    .rollup("rating_share_tier", "city")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("cumulative_cumulative_rating") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "Berlin", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("cumulative_cumulative_rating_per_berlin"),
        F.count_if(F.col("country") == "DE").alias("de_events"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "Bangkok", 1)).alias("bangkok_count"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("country")).alias("num_countries"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("grouping_id"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("city").desc_nulls_first())
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy("budget", "id")
w_grp = Window.orderBy("last4_sum_budget_bucket", "id")

latest = (
    df_departments
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("location", "dept_name").orderBy(F.col("budget").desc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

eligible = (
    latest
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_employees.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.dept_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.dept_id") == 14), "left_anti")
)

eligible_departments = (
    eligible
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_employees.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.dept_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.hire_date") > "2023-12-10"), "left_semi")
)

scored = (
    eligible_departments
    .select(
        "id",
        "dept_name",
        F.lead("budget", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("dept_name", "location").orderBy("row_num", "id")).alias("next_budget"),
        F.ntile(10).over(Window.partitionBy("dept_name", "location").orderBy(F.col("budget").desc(), "id")).alias("budget_bucket"),
        F.lag("budget", 1).over(w_ordered).alias("prev_budget"),
        F.sum("budget").over(Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy("budget", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_budget"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "next_budget",
        "budget_bucket",
        "prev_budget",
        F.sum("budget_bucket").over(Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy("prev_budget", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("last4_sum_budget_bucket"),
        F.avg("budget_bucket").over(Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy("prev_budget", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("last4_avg_budget_bucket"),
        F.min("budget_bucket").over(Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy("prev_budget", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("last4_min_budget_bucket"),
    )
)

enriched_departments = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "next_budget",
        "budget_bucket",
        "last4_sum_budget_bucket",
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("last4_avg_budget_bucket").asc_nulls_last())).alias("last4_avg_budget_bucket_cume_dist"),
        F.last("last4_sum_budget_bucket", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy("prev_budget", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_last4_sum_budget_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(w_grp).alias("row_seq"),
    )
)

not_flagged = (
    enriched_departments
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_employees.alias("x"), (F.col("x.dept_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.email").isNotNull()), "left_anti")
)

stats = (
    not_flagged
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("last4_avg_budget_bucket_cume_dist") >= 0.86, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("last4_avg_budget_bucket_cume_dist_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("last_known_last4_sum_budget_bucket"), 2).alias("avg_last_known_last4_sum_budget_bucket"),
        F.percentile_approx("next_budget", 0.9).alias("next_budget_p90"),
    )
)

result = (
    stats
    .select("last4_avg_budget_bucket_cume_dist_tier", "next_budget_p90")
    .orderBy(
        F.col("next_budget_p90").desc_nulls_first(),
        F.col("last4_avg_budget_bucket_cume_dist_tier").desc(),
    )
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
```
```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

    )
```

```python
    cleaned
    .select("dept_id")
    .intersectAll(
        df_employees
        .filter(F.col("job_title").isNotNull())
        .select("dept_id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.dept_id") == F.col("k.dept_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

cleaned_employees = (
    kept_rows
    .filter(F.col("job_title").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "full_name",
        "email",
        "dept_id",
        "job_title",
        "salary",
        "hire_date",
        "is_remote",
        "is_remote_label",
        "full_name_length",
        F.last_day("hire_date").alias("hire_date_month_end"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    cleaned_employees
    .select(
        "id",
        "full_name",
        "email",
        "job_title",
        "salary",
        "hire_date",
        "is_remote",
        "is_remote_label",
        "full_name_length",
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("job_title").orderBy(F.col("full_name_length").asc_nulls_last())).alias("full_name_length_rank"),
        F.stddev_samp("salary").over(Window.partitionBy("job_title", "dept_id")).alias("job_title_stddev_samp_salary"),
        F.rank().over(Window.orderBy("salary")).alias("salary_rank"),
    )
)

valid = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("job_title").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.greatest("full_name_length_rank", "full_name_length").alias("greatest_full_name_length_rank_full_name_length"),
        F.regexp_replace("full_name", " ", "-").alias("full_name_slug"),
        F.coalesce("job_title", F.lit("N/A")).alias("resolved_job_title"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    valid
    .select(
        "*",
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("job_title").orderBy(F.col("full_name_length").desc_nulls_first())).alias("full_name_length_cume_dist"),
        F.stddev_samp("greatest_full_name_length_rank_full_name_length").over(Window.partitionBy("job_title")).alias("job_title_stddev_samp_greatest_full_name_length_rank_full_name_length"),
        F.round((F.col("job_title_stddev_samp_salary") / F.sum("job_title_stddev_samp_salary").over(Window.partitionBy("job_title"))), 4).alias("job_title_stddev_samp_salary_share"),
    )
)

totals = (
    metrics
    .rollup(
        F.when(F.col("job_title_stddev_samp_greatest_full_name_length_rank_full_name_length") >= 81, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("job_title_stddev_samp_greatest_full_name_length_rank_full_name_length_tier"),
        F.date_trunc("MONTH", "hire_date").alias("activity_month"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("job_title") == "Engineer", 1)).alias("engineer_rows"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("job_title")).alias("num_job_titles"),
        F.countDistinct("job_title").alias("distinct_job_titles"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("engineer_rows") > 1)
)

result = (
    totals
    .select(
        "job_title_stddev_samp_greatest_full_name_length_rank_full_name_length_tier",
        "activity_month",
        "distinct_job_titles",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("distinct_job_titles").desc_nulls_first())
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

quantity_by_product_id = df_inventory.groupBy("product_id").agg(F.sum("quantity").alias("sum_inventory_quantity"))

enriched = (
    df_order_items
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("src.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .select("src.*", F.col("p.price"), F.col("p.category"), F.col("p.brand"))
)

metrics = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("product_id") == 40)
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "category",
        "brand",
        F.min("price").over(Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy("unit_price", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_min_price"),
        F.count("price").over(Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy("unit_price", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count_price"),
        F.sum("price").over(Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy("unit_price", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_sum_price"),
        F.avg("price").over(Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy("unit_price", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_avg_price"),
        F.avg("price").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("unit_price", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)).alias("price_avg_5"),
    )
)

enriched_order_items = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "category",
        "running_min_price",
        "running_sum_price",
        F.sum("price_avg_5").over(Window.partitionBy("brand")).alias("brand_sum_price_avg_5"),
        F.avg("running_avg_price").over(Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy("running_sum_price", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)).alias("running_avg_price_avg_2_prior"),
        F.sum("running_avg_price").over(Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy("running_sum_price", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_running_avg_price"),
        F.sum("price_avg_5").over(Window.partitionBy("brand", "product_id").orderBy("running_sum_price", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_price_avg_5"),
        F.avg("running_sum_price").over(Window.orderBy("running_count_price", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)).alias("running_sum_price_avg_5_prior"),
    )
)

scored = (
    enriched_order_items
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("running_running_avg_price").over(Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy("cumulative_price_avg_5", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)).alias("running_running_avg_price_avg_5_prior"),
        F.ntile(10).over(Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy("running_sum_price", "id")).alias("running_sum_price_bucket"),
        F.first("cumulative_price_avg_5", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy("cumulative_price_avg_5", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_cumulative_price_avg_5"),
        F.lead("cumulative_price_avg_5", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy("running_sum_price", "id")).alias("next_cumulative_price_avg_5"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .join(quantity_by_product_id, on="product_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "running_min_price",
        "running_sum_price",
        "brand_sum_price_avg_5",
        "running_avg_price_avg_2_prior",
        "running_running_avg_price",
        "cumulative_price_avg_5",
        "running_running_avg_price_avg_5_prior",
        F.col("sum_inventory_quantity"),
    )
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

cleaned = (
    df_inventory
    .filter(F.col("quantity") <= 180)
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "last_restock",
        F.last_day("last_restock").alias("last_restock_month_end"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("last_restock_month_end", "id")).alias("row_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("last_restock", "id")).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

joined = (
    enriched
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("e.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("p.brand").isin("Acme", "Stark"))
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.product_id",
        "e.event_seq",
        F.col("p.launch_date"),
        F.col("p.cost"),
    )
)

scored = (
    joined
    .select(
        "id",
        "event_seq",
        "launch_date",
        F.lag("cost").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("cost", "id")).alias("prev_cost"),
        F.lead("cost").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("cost", "id")).alias("next_cost"),
        F.lag("event_seq").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("cost", "id")).alias("prev_event_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("cost", "id")).alias("row_seq"),
        F.min("event_seq").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id")).alias("product_id_min_event_seq"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "event_seq",
        "next_cost",
        "prev_event_seq",
        "row_seq",
        "product_id_min_event_seq",
        F.min("event_seq").over(Window.orderBy("prev_event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_min_event_seq"),
        F.avg("event_seq").over(Window.orderBy("prev_event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_avg_event_seq"),
        F.count("event_seq").over(Window.orderBy("prev_event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count_event_seq"),
        F.last("row_seq", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy("launch_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_row_seq"),
    )
)

scored_inventory = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("prev_event_seq").over(Window.orderBy("running_count_event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("last4_sum_prev_event_seq"),
        F.count("prev_event_seq").over(Window.orderBy("running_count_event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("last4_count_prev_event_seq"),
        F.min("prev_event_seq").over(Window.orderBy("running_count_event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("last4_min_prev_event_seq"),
        F.avg("prev_event_seq").over(Window.orderBy("running_count_event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("last4_avg_prev_event_seq"),
    )
)

metrics_inventory = (
    scored_inventory
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("last4_min_prev_event_seq").over(Window.orderBy("last4_sum_prev_event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)).alias("last4_min_prev_event_seq_avg_2_prior"),
        F.avg("product_id_min_event_seq").over(Window.orderBy("product_id_min_event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)).alias("product_id_min_event_seq_avg_3_prior"),
        F.first("last4_count_prev_event_seq", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy("running_count_event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_last4_count_prev_event_seq"),
    )
)

grouped = (
    metrics_inventory
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("row_seq") >= 7, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("row_seq_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("last4_min_prev_event_seq", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("last4_min_prev_event_seq_quartiles"),
        F.percentile_approx("event_seq", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("event_seq_quartiles"),
    )
)

result = grouped.select("row_seq_tier", "last4_min_prev_event_seq_quartiles")
```

```python
)

)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_running = Window.orderBy(F.col("account_type_count_balance").desc_nulls_first())
w_grp = Window.orderBy(F.col("row_seq_2").desc_nulls_first())
w_hist = Window.orderBy(F.col("account_type_max_row_seq_whole").desc())

latest = (
    df_transactions
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("txn_type", "account_id").orderBy(F.col("txn_time").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select("id", "account_id", "txn_type", "txn_time")
)

enriched = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("account_id").isin([9, 30, 37, 38]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("txn_time").desc(), "id")).alias("seq_no"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("txn_time").desc(), "id")).alias("event_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("txn_time"), "txn_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id")).alias("row_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id")).alias("row_seq_2"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy("txn_time", "id")).alias("event_seq_2"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    enriched
    .select("id", "account_id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_transactions
        .filter(F.hour("txn_time").between(8, 13))
        .select("id", "account_id")
    )
)

verified = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.account_id") == F.col("k.account_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

base = (
    verified
    .filter(F.col("event_seq_2").between(5, 7))
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "event_seq",
        "row_seq",
        "row_seq_2",
        "event_seq_2",
        F.floor("row_seq").alias("row_seq_whole"),
        F.when(F.col("row_seq_2") >= 8, "High").when(F.col("row_seq_2") >= 2, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("row_seq_2_band"),
    )
)

with_dims = (

    .alias("src")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("p"), F.col("src.account_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")

        "src.account_id",
        "src.event_seq",
        "src.row_seq_2",
        "src.event_seq_2",
        "src.row_seq_whole",
        "src.row_seq_2_band",

        F.col("p.balance"),
        F.col("p.account_type"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    with_dims
    .select(
        "event_seq",
        "row_seq_2",
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_running = Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("is_flagged_flag", "id")

filtered = (
    df_transactions
    .filter(F.col("merchant").isNotNull() & (~F.col("is_flagged")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "txn_type",
        "txn_time",
        "merchant",
        "is_flagged",
        F.concat("merchant", F.lit(" "), "txn_type").alias("merchant_txn_type"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("is_flagged"))
    .withColumn("last_known_merchant", F.last("merchant", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("merchant", "txn_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
)

latest = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy(F.col("txn_time").desc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "txn_type",
        "merchant",
        "is_flagged",
        "merchant_txn_type",
        "last_known_merchant",
    )
)

valid = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("merchant").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("merchant_filled", F.coalesce("merchant", F.lit("Unknown")))
)

cleaned = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("merchant").isNotNull() & F.col("txn_type").isin(["REFUND", "FEE"]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.upper("merchant").alias("merchant_upper"),
        F.coalesce("merchant", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("resolved_merchant"),
    )
)

valid_transactions = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("merchant") != "Amazon")
    .withColumn("merchant_lower", F.lower("merchant"))
    .withColumn("is_flagged_flag", F.col("is_flagged").cast("int"))
)

metrics = (
    valid_transactions
    .withColumn("prev_is_flagged_flag", F.lag("is_flagged_flag").over(w_running))
    .withColumn("next_is_flagged_flag", F.lead("is_flagged_flag").over(w_running))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w_running))
)

result = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "is_flagged",
        "merchant_txn_type",
        "resolved_merchant",
        "is_flagged_flag",
        "prev_is_flagged_flag",
        "next_is_flagged_flag",
        "seq_no",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("is_flagged_flag").desc_nulls_last(), "prev_is_flagged_flag")
)
```

```python
        F.coalesce("page", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("page_filled"),
    )
)

    base
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("b"), F.col("a.session_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "a.id",
        "a.session_id",
        "a.page",
        "a.event_time",
        "a.page_filled",
        F.col("b.browser"),
        F.col("b.device"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    enriched
    .select("id")
    .subtract(
        df_web_events
        .filter(F.col("event_time") >= "2024-01-01")
        .select("id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

base_web_events = (
    kept_rows
    .filter((F.col("event_time") > F.lit("2023-06-21").cast("date")) & F.col("device").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "session_id",
        "event_time",
        "device",
        F.trim("device").alias("clean_device"),
    )
)

joined = (
    base_web_events
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("s"), F.col("a.session_id") == F.col("s.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "a.session_id",
        "a.event_time",
        "a.device",
        "a.clean_device",
        F.col("s.country"),
        F.col("s.browser"),
        F.col("s.device").alias("session_device"),
    )
)

enriched_web_events = (
    joined
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("s"), F.col("e.session_id") == F.col("s.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("s.country") == "US")

        F.col("s.browser").alias("session_browser"),
        F.col("s.country").alias("session_country"),

)

result = (

)
```

```python
    verified
    .select("plan")
    .subtract(
        df_price_tiers
        .filter(F.col("currency") == "USD")
        .select("plan")

)
```

```python
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("a.product_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("p.id")), "left")

        "brand",
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy("unit_price_scaled")).alias("unit_price_scaled_cume_dist"),

        F.lead("unit_price_rounded", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("product_id", "brand").orderBy("unit_price_rounded_filled", "id")).alias("next_unit_price_rounded"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "level",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("attr_key", "v"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    flattened
    .filter(F.col("status_code") == 422)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("status_code").over(Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy("status_code", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("status_code_avg_3"),
        F.first("attr_key", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy("status_code", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_attr_key"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("status_code").desc())).alias("status_code_rank"),
    )
)

latest = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("service", "level").orderBy(F.col("status_code_avg_3").desc_nulls_first(), "id", "attr_key")))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .drop("dedup_rank")
)

matched_keys = (
    latest
    .select("service", "level")
    .subtract(
        df_app_logs
        .filter(F.col("latency_ms").between(949, 1538))
        .select("service", "level")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    latest
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.service") == F.col("k.service")) & (F.col("s.level") == F.col("k.level")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

base = (
    reconciled
    .filter(F.col("level").isin(["INFO", "DEBUG", "ERROR"]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.coalesce("status_code_avg_3", F.lit(0)).alias("status_code_avg_3_filled"),
        F.coalesce("attr_key", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("attr_key_clean"),
    )
)

result = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "level",
        "attr_key",
        "v",
        "status_code_avg_3",
        "first_known_attr_key",
        "status_code_rank",
        F.when(F.col("attr_key").rlike("^(version|region)$"), "OTHER_ZONE").otherwise("GROUP_B").alias("attr_key_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("status_code_avg_3").desc())
)
```

```python
        "discount_pct_avg_2_prior",
        F.last("discount_pct_avg_2_prior", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("starts_on", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_discount_pct_avg_2_prior"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy(F.col("discount_pct_share").desc_nulls_last())).alias("discount_pct_share_dense_rank"),
        F.avg("discount_pct_avg_2_prior").over(Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("discount_pct_avg_2_prior", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("discount_pct_avg_2_prior_avg_3"),
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy(F.col("prev_discount_pct").desc())).alias("prev_discount_pct_percent_rank"),
        F.lead("discount_pct_max_7d", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("discount_pct_max_7d", "id")).alias("next_discount_pct_max_7d"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .withColumn("activity_month", F.date_trunc("MONTH", "starts_on"))
    .withColumn("prev_discount_pct_percent_rank_tier", F.when(F.col("prev_discount_pct_percent_rank") >= 0.84, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .rollup("activity_month", "prev_discount_pct_percent_rank_tier")
    .agg(
        F.sum("discount_pct_max_7d").alias("total_discount_pct_max_7d"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.percentile_approx("prev_discount_pct_percent_rank", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("prev_discount_pct_percent_rank_quartiles"),
        F.grouping("activity_month").alias("grouping_id"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("activity_month").desc())
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy("plan")

lines = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        F.explode("discounts").alias("tier_value"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    lines
    .filter(F.month("effective_from").isin([2, 5, 12]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count("tier_value").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "effective_from"), "plan")).alias("effective_from_period_count_tier_value"),
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("tier_value").desc())).alias("tier_value_cume_dist"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("plan") == "basic")
    .select(
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        "effective_from_period_count_tier_value",
        "tier_value_cume_dist",
        F.when(F.col("tier_value_cume_dist") >= 0.71, "High").when(F.col("tier_value_cume_dist") >= 0.33, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("tier_value_cume_dist_level"),
        (F.col("effective_from_period_count_tier_value") + F.col("tier_value")).alias("effective_from_period_count_tier_value_plus_tier_value"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        "effective_from_period_count_tier_value",
        "tier_value_cume_dist_level",
        "effective_from_period_count_tier_value_plus_tier_value",
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy("effective_from_period_count_tier_value_plus_tier_value")).alias("effective_from_period_count_tier_value_plus_tier_value_cume_dist"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("effective_from") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2024-06-07")))
    .select(
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        "tier_value_cume_dist_level",
        "effective_from_period_count_tier_value_plus_tier_value",
        "effective_from_period_count_tier_value_plus_tier_value_cume_dist",
        F.upper("plan").alias("plan_upper"),
        F.add_months("effective_from", 12).alias("effective_from_plus_months"),
    )
)

scored = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "*",
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("effective_from_period_count_tier_value_plus_tier_value_cume_dist").desc_nulls_last())).alias("effective_from_period_count_tier_value_plus_tier_value_cume_dist_percent_rank"),
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("effective_from_period_count_tier_value_plus_tier_value_cume_dist").asc_nulls_first())).alias("effective_from_period_count_tier_value_plus_tier_value_cume_dist_percent_rank_2"),
        F.min("effective_from_period_count_tier_value_plus_tier_value").over(w_recent).alias("plan_min_effective_from_period_count_tier_value_plus_tier_value"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .select(
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        "effective_from_period_count_tier_value_plus_tier_value",
        "plan_upper",
        "plan_min_effective_from_period_count_tier_value_plus_tier_value",
        F.avg("effective_from_period_count_tier_value_plus_tier_value_cume_dist").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "effective_from_plus_months"), "plan")).alias("effective_from_plus_months_period_avg_effective_from_period_count_tier_value_plus_tier_value_cume_dist"),
        F.avg("effective_from_period_count_tier_value_plus_tier_value_cume_dist_percent_rank").over(Window.partitionBy("plan")).alias("plan_avg_effective_from_period_count_tier_value_plus_tier_value_cume_dist_percent_rank"),
    )
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid = (
    df_employees
    .filter(F.col("hire_date") > F.lit("2023-09-08").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("job_title_email_key", F.concat_ws("-", "job_title", "email"))
)

scored = (
    valid
    .select(
        "id",
        "full_name",
        "email",
        "dept_id",
        "manager_id",
        "job_title",
        "salary",
        "level",
        F.avg("salary").over(Window.partitionBy("manager_id").orderBy("hire_date", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)).alias("salary_avg_6_prior"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("dept_id").orderBy("salary", "id")).alias("row_seq"),
        F.round((F.col("salary") / F.sum("salary").over(Window.partitionBy("manager_id"))), 4).alias("salary_share"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("salary").between(112000, 139000))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("row_seq").over(Window.partitionBy("manager_id").orderBy("salary", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_sum_row_seq"),
        F.min("row_seq").over(Window.partitionBy("manager_id").orderBy("salary", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_min_row_seq"),
        F.avg("row_seq").over(Window.partitionBy("manager_id").orderBy("salary", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_avg_row_seq"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    with_windows
    .select("dept_id", "level")
    .intersect(
        df_employees
        .filter(F.col("dept_id").isin([25, 28, 40]))
        .select("dept_id", "level")
    )
)

verified = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.dept_id") == F.col("k.dept_id")) & (F.col("s.level") == F.col("k.level")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

base = (
    verified
    .filter(F.col("row_seq") == 3)
    .select(
        "full_name",
        "email",
        "dept_id",
        "job_title",
        "level",
        "salary_share",
        "running_min_row_seq",
        "running_avg_row_seq",
        F.coalesce("running_sum_row_seq", F.lit(0)).alias("running_sum_row_seq_filled"),
        F.regexp_replace("full_name", " ", "").alias("full_name_slug"),
    )
)

result = (
    base
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_departments.alias("p"), F.col("e.dept_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .groupingSets(
        [["location", "job_title"], ["location"], []],
        F.col("p.location").alias("location"),
        F.col("e.job_title").alias("job_title"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.min(F.col("e.salary_share")).alias("min_salary_share"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("level_id"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("cnt").asc_nulls_first())
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("manager_id")

    .select("a.*", F.col("p.dept_name"))
)

    .filter(F.col("dept_id").isin([12, 32]))
    .select(
        "id",

        F.avg("salary").over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("hire_date"), "job_title").orderBy("salary", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)).alias("salary_avg_3_prior"),
        F.min("salary").over(w_ordered).alias("manager_id_min_salary"),
    )
)

scored = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("manager_id_min_salary").over(w_part).alias("running_max_manager_id_min_salary"),
        F.count("manager_id_min_salary").over(w_part).alias("running_count_manager_id_min_salary"),
        F.sum("manager_id_min_salary").over(w_part).alias("running_sum_manager_id_min_salary"),

    .select(
        "a.*",
        F.col("p.job_title"),
        F.col("p.level"),
        F.col("p.full_name"),

    .intersect(
        df_employees
        .filter(F.col("dept_id").isin([10, 29, 34]))
        .select("manager_id", "job_title")

)

reconciled = (
    with_dims
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.manager_id") == F.col("k.manager_id")) & (F.col("s.job_title") == F.col("k.job_title")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

metrics_employees = (
    reconciled
    .withColumn("level_count_manager_id_min_salary", F.count("manager_id_min_salary").over(Window.partitionBy("level")))
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("monthly_fee", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("running_max_monthly_fee", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)

base = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("plan") != "basic")
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "end_date",
        "monthly_fee",
        "status",
        F.trim("plan").alias("clean_plan"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "status",
        "clean_plan",
        F.count("monthly_fee").over(w_recent).alias("running_count_monthly_fee"),
        F.min("monthly_fee").over(w_recent).alias("running_min_monthly_fee"),
        F.max("monthly_fee").over(w_recent).alias("running_max_monthly_fee"),
        F.avg("monthly_fee").over(w_recent).alias("running_avg_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "status",
        "clean_plan",
        "running_min_monthly_fee",
        "running_max_monthly_fee",
        "running_avg_monthly_fee",
        F.avg("running_avg_monthly_fee").over(w_hist).alias("running_avg_monthly_fee_avg_6_prior"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("running_avg_monthly_fee").desc(), "id")).alias("seq_no"),
        F.sum("running_avg_monthly_fee").over(Window.partitionBy("plan", "status").orderBy("running_min_monthly_fee", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_running_avg_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("seq_no") != 8)
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "status",
        "clean_plan",
        "running_min_monthly_fee",
        "running_avg_monthly_fee_avg_6_prior",
        "seq_no",
        "running_running_avg_monthly_fee",
        (F.col("seq_no") + F.col("running_min_monthly_fee")).alias("seq_no_plus_running_min_monthly_fee"),
        F.round(F.col("running_avg_monthly_fee") * 100, 2).alias("running_avg_monthly_fee_scaled"),
    )
)

scored = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("seq_no_plus_running_min_monthly_fee") >= 37)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("running_running_avg_monthly_fee").over(Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("running_avg_monthly_fee_avg_6_prior", "id")).alias("prev_running_running_avg_monthly_fee"),
        F.lag("seq_no").over(Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("running_avg_monthly_fee_avg_6_prior", "id")).alias("prev_seq_no"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("running_avg_monthly_fee_avg_6_prior", "id")).alias("seq_no_2"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    scored
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("running_running_avg_monthly_fee")))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

ranked_subscriptions = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("seq_no_plus_running_min_monthly_fee").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

stats = (
    ranked_subscriptions
    .groupBy("plan")
    .agg(
        F.max("prev_seq_no").alias("max_prev_seq_no"),
        F.percentile_approx("seq_no", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("seq_no_quartiles"),
    )
)

result = (
    stats
    .select(
        "plan",
        "max_prev_seq_no",
        "seq_no_quartiles",
        F.when(F.col("plan").rlike("^(enterprise|standard)$"), "EXTENDED").when(F.col("plan").rlike("^(basic|premium)$"), "PRIORITY").otherwise("GROUP_A").alias("plan_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("plan_zone").asc_nulls_last())
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_running = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("years_since_last_restock", "id")

base = (
    df_inventory
    .filter((F.col("last_restock") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-06-17"))) & (F.col("last_restock") <= "2024-08-27"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "quantity",
        "last_restock",
        (F.datediff(F.current_date(), "last_restock") / 365.25).alias("years_since_last_restock"),
    )
)

joined = (
    base
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_stores.alias("b"), F.col("a.store_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "a.id",
        "a.store_id",
        "a.product_id",
        "a.quantity",
        "a.last_restock",
        "a.years_since_last_restock",
        F.col("b.store_name"),
    )
)

joined_inventory = (
    joined
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("a.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("p.category"), F.col("p.launch_date"), F.col("p.price"))
)

deduped = (
    joined_inventory
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("category", "product_id").orderBy(F.col("launch_date").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "last_restock",
        "years_since_last_restock",
        "store_name",
    )
)

with_windows = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "years_since_last_restock",
        F.lag("years_since_last_restock").over(w_running).alias("prev_years_since_last_restock"),
        F.row_number().over(w_running).alias("row_seq"),
        F.ntile(5).over(Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("years_since_last_restock").desc(), "id")).alias("years_since_last_restock_bucket"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_stores.alias("dim"), F.col("a.store_id") == F.col("dim.id"), "left")
    .groupingSets(
        [["region", "city"], ["region"], []],
        F.col("dim.region").alias("region"),
        F.col("dim.city").alias("city"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.max(F.col("a.row_seq")).alias("max_row_seq"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("gid"),
    )
)
```

```python
w_recent = Window.orderBy("started_at", "id")

valid = (
    df_sessions
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isin([12, 21]))
    .select(

        "customer_id",
        "device",
        "browser",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        F.col("started_at").cast("date").alias("started_at_day"),
        F.coalesce("browser", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("browser_filled"),
    )
)

latest = (
    valid
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("device", "browser").orderBy(F.col("started_at_day").desc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

prev_events = latest.withColumn("prev_started_at", F.lag("started_at").over(Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("started_at", "id")))

gaps = (
    prev_events
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_started_at").isNull() | (F.col("started_at") > F.col("prev_started_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = (
    gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "device",
        "browser",
        "started_at",
        "browser_filled",
        F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("burst_id"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    sessionized
    .select(
        "id",
        "browser_filled",
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("burst_id")).alias("burst_id_rank"),
        F.row_number().over(w_recent).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("event_seq") >= 8, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("event_seq_tier"),

    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids_2"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids_3"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.partitionBy("store_id", "product_id").orderBy("last_restock_period_2", "id")

base = (
    df_inventory
    .filter(F.col("last_restock") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-09-02")))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.date_trunc("month", "last_restock").alias("last_restock_period"),
        F.date_trunc("year", "last_restock").alias("last_restock_period_2"),
    )
)

with_prev = base.withColumn("prev_last_restock_period", F.lag("last_restock_period").over(Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("last_restock_period", "id")))

gaps = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_last_restock_period").isNull() | (F.col("last_restock_period") > F.col("prev_last_restock_period") + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = (
    gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "last_restock",
        "last_restock_period",
        "last_restock_period_2",
        F.sum("session_start_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("last_restock_period", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("session_id"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    sessionized
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("store_id", "product_id").orderBy(F.col("last_restock_period").asc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

enriched = (
    deduped
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "last_restock",
        "last_restock_period_2",
        "session_id",
        "rank_in_group",
        F.lead("session_id").over(w_part).alias("next_session_id"),
        F.row_number().over(w_part).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

deduped_inventory = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("session_id").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

enriched_inventory = (
    deduped_inventory
    .select(
        "id",
        "last_restock",
        "session_id",
        "rank_in_group",
        "next_session_id",
        "seq_no",
        F.min("session_id").over(Window.partitionBy("store_id", "product_id").orderBy("last_restock_period_2", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_min_session_id"),
        F.avg("session_id").over(Window.partitionBy("store_id", "product_id").orderBy("last_restock_period_2", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_avg_session_id"),
        F.count("session_id").over(Window.partitionBy("store_id", "product_id").orderBy("last_restock_period_2", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count_session_id"),
        F.max("session_id").over(Window.partitionBy("store_id", "product_id").orderBy("last_restock_period_2", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_max_session_id"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched_inventory
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "rank_in_group",
        "seq_no",
        "running_min_session_id",
        "running_max_session_id",
    )
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.partitionBy("level")
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "log_ts"), "key")
w_running = Window.partitionBy("host")

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("key", "attr_value"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    lines
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("latency_ms").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-900, Window.currentRow)).alias("latency_ms_avg_15m"),
        F.corr("latency_ms", "status_code").over(w_part).alias("corr_latency_ms_status_code"),
    )
)

base = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("corr_latency_ms_status_code") > 0.0)
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "key",
        "attr_value",
        "corr_latency_ms_status_code",
        F.col("status_code").cast("double").alias("status_code_num"),
        F.coalesce("key", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("key_clean"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    base
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("corr_latency_ms_status_code").over(w_ordered).alias("log_ts_period_sum_corr_latency_ms_status_code"),
        F.max("corr_latency_ms_status_code").over(Window.partitionBy("level", "key").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-3600, Window.currentRow)).alias("corr_latency_ms_status_code_max_1h"),
        F.max("status_code_num").over(w_running).alias("host_max_status_code_num"),
    )
)

scored = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "log_ts",
        "key",
        "corr_latency_ms_status_code",
        "key_clean",
        "log_ts_period_sum_corr_latency_ms_status_code",
        "host_max_status_code_num",
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy(F.col("corr_latency_ms_status_code_max_1h").desc_nulls_last())).alias("corr_latency_ms_status_code_max_1h_dense_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .select(
        "log_ts",
        "key",
        "corr_latency_ms_status_code",
        "key_clean",
        "log_ts_period_sum_corr_latency_ms_status_code",
        "host_max_status_code_num",
        "corr_latency_ms_status_code_max_1h_dense_rank",
        F.when(F.col("key").rlike("^(version|trace)$"), "EXTENDED").when(F.col("key").rlike("^(region)$"), "GROUP_B").otherwise("PRIORITY").alias("key_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        "log_ts_period_sum_corr_latency_ms_status_code",
        F.col("log_ts").desc(),
    )
)
```
