```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

with_windows = (
    df_order_items
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "quantity",
        "unit_price",
        F.ntile(10).over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("quantity", "id")).alias("quantity_bucket"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("quantity").desc_nulls_last())).alias("quantity_rank"),
    )
)

base = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("order_id") == 4)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.greatest("quantity_rank", "quantity").alias("greatest_quantity_rank_quantity"),
        F.round("quantity", 2).alias("quantity_rounded"),
    )
)

scored = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "unit_price",
        "quantity_bucket",
        "quantity_rank",
        "greatest_quantity_rank_quantity",
        F.lead("quantity").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("quantity_bucket", "id")).alias("next_quantity"),
        F.lag("quantity").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("quantity_bucket", "id")).alias("prev_quantity"),
        F.lag("greatest_quantity_rank_quantity").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("quantity_bucket", "id")).alias("prev_greatest_quantity_rank_quantity"),
        F.lead("greatest_quantity_rank_quantity").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("quantity_bucket", "id")).alias("next_greatest_quantity_rank_quantity"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("quantity_bucket", "id")).alias("seq_no"),
        F.round((F.col("quantity_bucket") / F.sum("quantity_bucket").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id"))), 4).alias("quantity_bucket_share"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    scored
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("b"), F.col("src.order_id") == F.col("b.id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("b.amount") > 620)
    .select(
        "src.id",
        "src.order_id",
        "src.quantity_bucket",
        "src.next_greatest_quantity_rank_quantity",
        F.col("b.amount"),
    )
)

report = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "next_greatest_quantity_rank_quantity",
        "amount",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("next_greatest_quantity_rank_quantity").desc_nulls_last(), F.col("id").desc())
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
```

```python
    .select(
```

```python
        F.lead("salary").over(Window.partitionBy("manager_id", "level").orderBy("hire_date", "id")).alias("next_salary"),

        F.round((F.col("salary") / F.sum("salary").over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("hire_date")))), 4).alias("salary_share"),
    )
)

metrics = (

        F.count("salary_share").over(w_running).alias("last4_count_salary_share"),
        F.avg("salary_share").over(w_running).alias("last4_avg_salary_share"),
        F.ntile(4).over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "hire_date")).orderBy("seq_no", "id")).alias("seq_no_bucket"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    metrics
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_employees.alias("p"), F.col("a.manager_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "a.id",
        "a.email",
        "a.manager_id",
        "a.hire_date",
        "a.is_remote",
        "a.level",
        "a.next_salary",
        "a.salary_share",
        "a.last4_max_salary_share",
        "a.last4_count_salary_share",

        F.ntile(3).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("last4_avg_salary_share").desc(), "id")).alias("last4_avg_salary_share_bucket"),
        F.ntile(4).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("last4_count_salary_share").desc(), "id")).alias("last4_count_salary_share_bucket"),
    )
)

ranked = (
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

with_windows = (

        "email",

        F.lag("salary").over(Window.partitionBy("dept_id").orderBy("hire_date", "id")).alias("prev_salary"),
        F.lead("salary").over(Window.partitionBy("dept_id").orderBy("hire_date", "id")).alias("next_salary"),

    )
)

filtered = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("row_seq").between(6, 7))
    .withColumn("clean_email", F.trim("email"))
)

scored = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("is_remote"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "email",
        "is_remote",
        "prev_salary",
        "next_salary",
        F.last("prev_salary", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy("row_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_prev_salary"),
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("next_salary").desc_nulls_last())).alias("next_salary_cume_dist"),
        F.sum("next_salary").over(Window.orderBy("row_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_next_salary"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "prev_salary",
        "last_known_prev_salary",
        "next_salary_cume_dist",
        F.sum("next_salary").over(Window.orderBy("last_known_prev_salary", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_next_salary_2"),
        F.ntile(4).over(Window.orderBy("next_salary", "id")).alias("next_salary_bucket"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("cumulative_next_salary").desc())).alias("cumulative_next_salary_dense_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("cumulative_next_salary_2") >= 611538, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("cumulative_next_salary_2_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("prev_salary") >= 162000, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("prev_salary_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("cumulative_next_salary_dense_rank", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("cumulative_next_salary_dense_rank_quartiles"),
        F.round(F.avg("next_salary_cume_dist"), 2).alias("avg_next_salary_cume_dist"),
        F.percentile_approx("cumulative_next_salary_2", 0.5).alias("cumulative_next_salary_2_p50"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("avg_next_salary_cume_dist") > 0)
    .withColumn("avg_next_salary_cume_dist_rank", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("cumulative_next_salary_2_tier").orderBy(F.col("avg_next_salary_cume_dist").desc())))
    .orderBy(F.col("prev_salary_tier").desc_nulls_last())
)
```

```python
        F.row_number().over(w_recent).alias("seq_no"),
        F.sum("bulk_lines").over(w_part).alias("running_bulk_lines"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_hist = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("cost_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

enriched = (
    df_shipments
    .filter(F.col("carrier") != "Kerry")
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "shipped_date",
        "cost",
        F.avg("cost").over(Window.orderBy("shipped_date", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)).alias("cost_avg_2_prior"),
        F.ntile(3).over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "delivered_date")).orderBy("cost", "id")).alias("cost_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy("cost", "id")).alias("event_seq"),
        F.stddev_samp("cost").over(Window.partitionBy("status")).alias("status_stddev_samp_cost"),
    )
)

latest = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("cost_avg_2_prior").asc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select("id", "order_id", "cost", "cost_bucket", "status_stddev_samp_cost")
)

ranked = (
    latest
    .withColumn("rank_in_group_2", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("cost").desc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group_2") == 1)
    .drop("rank_in_group_2")
)

filtered = (
    ranked
    .filter(F.col("order_id") == 30)
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "cost",
        "cost_bucket",
        "status_stddev_samp_cost",
        F.round((F.col("status_stddev_samp_cost") / F.col("cost")), 2).alias("status_stddev_samp_cost_per_cost"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("running_min_cost_bucket", F.min("cost_bucket").over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("running_max_cost_bucket", F.max("cost_bucket").over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("running_count_cost_bucket", F.count("cost_bucket").over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("running_avg_cost_bucket", F.avg("cost_bucket").over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("last_known_cost", F.last("cost", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy("cost_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
)

result = (
    metrics
    .select("id", "order_id", "last_known_cost", "cost")
    .unpivot(
        ids=["id", "order_id"],
        values=["last_known_cost", "cost"],
        variableColumnName="measure",
        valueColumnName="metric_value",
    )
)
```

```python
        F.coalesce(F.col("city"), F.lit("NONE")).alias("city_clean"),
    )

    .join(df_orders.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.order_date") < F.col("s.signup_date")), "left_semi")
)

    .filter(F.col("city").isNotNull() & (F.col("signup_date") > F.lit("2023-03-15").cast("date")))
    .withColumn("clean_city", F.trim("city"))

    .subtract(
        df_customers
        .filter(F.col("is_active"))
        .select("city", "id")
    )

    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.city") == F.col("k.city")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

    kept_rows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("signup_date_month").desc_nulls_first())).alias("signup_date_month_cume_dist"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_transactions
    .filter(F.col("merchant").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("txn_type_lower", F.lower("txn_type"))
)

cleaned = (
    base
    .filter(~F.col("merchant").eqNullSafe(F.lit("7-Eleven")))
    .withColumn("txn_type_prefix", F.substring("txn_type", 1, 4))
)

ranked = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("txn_type", "account_id").orderBy("amount", "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "amount",
        "merchant",
        "is_flagged",
        "txn_type_lower",
    )
)

scored = (
    ranked
    .filter(F.col("account_id").isin([8, 23, 31, 40]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("amount", "id")).alias("prev_amount"),
        F.lead("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("amount", "id")).alias("next_amount"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("amount", "id")).alias("row_seq"),
        F.avg("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)).alias("amount_avg_5"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    scored
    .select("id")
    .subtract(
        df_transactions
        .filter(F.col("amount").between(1900, 3400))
        .select("id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

enriched = (
    kept_rows
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("p"), F.col("a.account_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("p.status"), F.col("p.account_type"))
)

result = (
    enriched
    .groupBy("account_id")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.stddev_samp("amount").alias("amount_stddev"),
        F.count_if(F.col("account_type") == "SAVINGS").alias("savings_events"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("status")).alias("num_status"),
    )
    .orderBy("amount_stddev")
)
```

```python
    .filter(F.hour("event_time").between(11, 15))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.concat_ws("-", "event_type", "page").alias("event_type_page_key"),
        F.length("event_type").alias("event_type_length"),
        F.coalesce("page", F.lit("NONE")).alias("page_clean"),
    )
)

    base
    .filter((F.col("event_time") > F.lit("2023-07-09").cast("date")) & (F.col("session_id").isin(10, 40)))
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "page",
        "event_time",
        "event_type_page_key",
        "page_clean",
        F.col("duration_sec").cast("double").alias("duration_sec_num"),
        F.round((F.col("event_type_length") * 1.15), 2).alias("event_type_length_scaled"),
    )
)

remaining_keys = (
    cleaned
    .select("id", "session_id")
    .subtract(
        df_web_events
        .filter(F.to_date("event_time") < "2024-08-01")
        .select("id", "session_id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.session_id") == F.col("k.session_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

with_dims = (
    kept_rows
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("s"), F.col("a.session_id") == F.col("s.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("s.started_at") >= "2024-10-21")
    .select("a.session_id", "a.event_type_page_key", F.col("s.device"))
)

    with_dims
    .select("session_id")
    .subtract(
        df_web_events
        .filter(F.col("page").isin(["/checkout", "/product", "/cart"]))
        .select("session_id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    with_dims
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.session_id") == F.col("k.session_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

filtered = (
    reconciled
    .filter(F.col("device").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lower("device").alias("device_lower"),
        F.coalesce("device", F.lit("N/A")).alias("device_clean"),

        F.coalesce("device", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("device_clean_2"),
    )
)

        "session_id",
        "device_clean",
        "device_clean_2",
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
```
```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window
```

```python
    with_windows

)

    with_windows_price_tiers

        "val",
        "val_rank",
        "val_rank_share",
        F.max("val_rank_share").over(Window.partitionBy("plan", "currency")).alias("plan_max_val_rank_share"),
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.orderBy("val")).alias("val_percent_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
```

```python
    .withColumn("is_home", F.when(F.col("page") == "/home", 1).otherwise(0))

    prev_events
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_event_time").isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.col("prev_event_time") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = with_gaps.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("new_group_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

result = (
    islands
    .groupBy("session_id")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("page") == "/search", 1)).alias("search_count"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("event_type")).alias("event_type_list"),
        F.countDistinct("session_id").alias("distinct_session_ids"),
        F.min("session_no").alias("min_session_no"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

cleaned = (
    df_store_sales
    .filter(F.col("store_id").isin([2, 4, 5]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "units",
        "revenue",
        (F.col("revenue") - F.col("units")).alias("revenue_per_unit"),
    )
)

scored = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("units") / F.sum("units").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id"))), 4).alias("units_share"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy("revenue", "id")).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

valid = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("seq_no") > 3)
    .withColumn("units_share_filled", F.coalesce("units_share", F.lit(0)))
)

remaining_keys = (
    valid
    .select("id")
    .subtract(
        df_store_sales
        .filter(F.col("revenue").between(2000, 3400))
        .select("id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    valid
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

scored_store_sales = (
    kept_rows
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "revenue",
        "revenue_per_unit",
        "units_share",
        "seq_no",
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("units_share").desc_nulls_first())).alias("units_share_percent_rank"),
    )
)

base = (
    scored_store_sales
    .filter(F.col("units_share_percent_rank") >= 0.51)
    .withColumn("adjusted_units_share", F.round((F.col("units_share") * 0.85), 2))
    .withColumn("revenue_per_unit_plus_revenue", (F.col("revenue_per_unit") + F.col("revenue")))
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

cleaned = (
    df_payments
    .filter((F.col("paid_at") > F.to_timestamp(F.lit("2023-04-23 13:00:00"))) & (~F.col("method").eqNullSafe(F.lit("cash"))))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "method",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        F.when(F.col("method").isin(["card", "bank_transfer"]), "Tier 1").otherwise("Other").alias("method_group"),
        F.datediff(F.current_date(), "paid_at").alias("days_since_paid_at"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("days_since_paid_at").between(41, 77))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "paid_at",
        "method_group",
        "days_since_paid_at",
        F.sum("days_since_paid_at").over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_sum_days_since_paid_at"),
        F.min("days_since_paid_at").over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_min_days_since_paid_at"),
        F.avg("days_since_paid_at").over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_avg_days_since_paid_at"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("rn", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("days_since_paid_at").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "days_since_paid_at",
        "running_sum_days_since_paid_at",
        "running_avg_days_since_paid_at",
    )
)

joined = (
    deduped
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_orders.alias("d"), F.col("a.order_id") == F.col("d.id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "a.id",
        "a.order_id",
        "a.days_since_paid_at",
        F.col("d.amount"),
        F.col("d.order_date"),
    )
)

result = (
    joined
    .groupBy("order_id")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("order_id").alias("distinct_order_ids"),
        F.percentile_approx("days_since_paid_at", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("days_since_paid_at_quartiles"),
        F.stddev_samp("amount").alias("amount_stddev"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("amount_stddev").asc_nulls_last())
)
```

```python
        F.lead("quantity_filled", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("quantity", "id")).alias("next_quantity_filled"),
    )

    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)

    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("running_quantity", "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

    .join(df_products.alias("b"), F.col("a.product_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("b.brand"), F.col("b.price"), F.col("b.product_name"))

)
```

```python
    .withColumn("prev_shipping_fee", F.lag("shipping_fee", 2).over(Window.orderBy("discount_filled", "id")))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("status", "store_id").orderBy(F.col("shipping_fee").desc(), "id")))
    .withColumn("discount_avg_5", F.avg("discount").over(Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("shipping_fee", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("discount_avg_3", F.avg("discount").over(Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("shipping_fee", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("amount_bucket", F.ntile(5).over(Window.orderBy("amount", "id")))
)

    .withColumn("prev_discount", F.lag("discount", 2, 0).over(Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("shipping_fee", "id")))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w_part))
    .withColumn("cumulative_discount_filled", F.sum("discount_filled").over(Window.orderBy("order_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

        "channel",
        "amount",
        "shipping_fee",
        "shipping_fee_whole",

        F.lag("seq_no", 1, 0).over(Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("prev_discount", "id")).alias("prev_seq_no"),
    )
)

filtered = (
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("key", "value"),
    )
)

unpacked = (
    lines
    .filter(F.col("key") == "version")
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "key",
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(8) != 0).cast("int").alias("flag_bit8"),
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
    )
)

scored = (
    unpacked
    .filter(F.col("flag_bit8") == 0)
    .withColumn("flag_bit8_bucket", F.ntile(10).over(Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("flag_bit8").desc(), "id", "key")))
    .withColumn("first_known_status_code_high", F.first("status_code_high", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("key", "service").orderBy("flag_bit8", "id", "key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
)

metrics = (
    scored
    .withColumn("running_count_flag_bit8", F.count("flag_bit8").over(Window.partitionBy("service", "key").orderBy("status_code_high", "id", "key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("running_max_flag_bit8", F.max("flag_bit8").over(Window.partitionBy("service", "key").orderBy("status_code_high", "id", "key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("running_min_flag_bit8", F.min("flag_bit8").over(Window.partitionBy("service", "key").orderBy("status_code_high", "id", "key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
)

matched_keys = (
    metrics
    .select("service", "id")
    .intersect(
        df_app_logs
        .filter(F.to_date("log_ts") >= "2025-05-22")
        .select("service", "id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.service") == F.col("k.service")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

metrics_app_logs = (
    reconciled
    .withColumn("key_stddev_samp_first_known_status_code_high", F.stddev_samp("first_known_status_code_high").over(Window.partitionBy("key", "service")))
)

result = (
    metrics_app_logs
    .groupBy("service")
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("service") == "search", F.col("key_stddev_samp_first_known_status_code_high")).otherwise(0)).alias("search_key_stddev_samp_first_known_status_code_high"),
        F.avg("key_stddev_samp_first_known_status_code_high").alias("avg_key_stddev_samp_first_known_status_code_high"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("service") == "search", 1)).alias("search_rows"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("service") == "billing", 1)).alias("billing_count"),
        F.countDistinct("service").alias("distinct_services"),
        F.avg("first_known_status_code_high").alias("avg_first_known_status_code_high"),
    )
    .orderBy("search_rows")
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("discount_pct", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

filtered = (
    df_promotions
    .filter((F.col("starts_on") > F.lit("2023-07-23").cast("date")) & (F.col("starts_on") <= "2025-07-05"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "promo_code",
        "starts_on",
        "ends_on",
        "discount_pct",
        F.length("channel").alias("channel_length"),
        F.datediff(F.current_date(), "ends_on").alias("days_since_ends_on"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "*",
        F.min("discount_pct").over(Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("days_since_ends_on", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)).alias("last3_min_discount_pct"),
        F.avg("discount_pct").over(Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("days_since_ends_on", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)).alias("last3_avg_discount_pct"),
        F.count("discount_pct").over(Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("days_since_ends_on", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)).alias("last3_count_discount_pct"),
        F.stddev_samp("discount_pct").over(Window.partitionBy("promo_code")).alias("promo_code_stddev_samp_discount_pct"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("running_count_last3_avg_discount_pct", F.count("last3_avg_discount_pct").over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("running_max_last3_avg_discount_pct", F.max("last3_avg_discount_pct").over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("running_sum_last3_avg_discount_pct", F.sum("last3_avg_discount_pct").over(w_recent))
)

deduped = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("row_num", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("channel", "promo_code").orderBy(F.col("discount_pct").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

valid = (
    deduped
    .filter(F.col("starts_on") > F.lit("2023-09-02").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "promo_code",
        "starts_on",
        "last3_avg_discount_pct",
        "last3_count_discount_pct",
        "promo_code_stddev_samp_discount_pct",
        "running_count_last3_avg_discount_pct",
        "row_num",
        F.floor("running_sum_last3_avg_discount_pct").alias("running_sum_last3_avg_discount_pct_whole"),
        F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("NONE")).alias("channel_filled"),
    )
)

result = (
    valid
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("running_count_last3_avg_discount_pct") >= 13, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("running_count_last3_avg_discount_pct_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("promo_code_stddev_samp_discount_pct") >= 0, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("promo_code_stddev_samp_discount_pct_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("promo_code")).alias("promo_code_list"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("channel") == "mobile", F.col("running_sum_last3_avg_discount_pct_whole")).otherwise(0)).alias("mobile_running_sum_last3_avg_discount_pct_whole"),
        F.round(F.avg("running_count_last3_avg_discount_pct"), 2).alias("avg_running_count_last3_avg_discount_pct"),
        F.percentile_approx("running_sum_last3_avg_discount_pct_whole", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("running_sum_last3_avg_discount_pct_whole_quartiles"),
    )
    .withColumn("mobile_running_sum_last3_avg_discount_pct_whole_rank", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("running_count_last3_avg_discount_pct_tier").orderBy(F.col("mobile_running_sum_last3_avg_discount_pct_whole").desc())))
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (

    .filter((F.col("paid_at") > F.lit("2023-06-24 14:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & (~F.col("method").eqNullSafe(F.lit("cash"))))
    .withColumn("amount_rounded", F.round("amount", 2))
    .withColumn("method_filled", F.coalesce("method", F.lit("OTHER")))
)

deduped = (
    base
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy(F.col("paid_at").asc_nulls_first(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .select("id", "paid_at", "status")
)

valid = (
    deduped
    .filter(F.col("paid_at") >= F.to_timestamp(F.lit("2023-08-09 05:00:00")))
    .withColumn("paid_at_day", F.col("paid_at").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("status_group", F.when(F.col("status").isin(["FAILED", "REFUNDED"]), "Core").otherwise("Other"))
)

latest = (
    valid
    .withColumn("rn", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("paid_at_day")))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("id", "status", "status_group")
)

filtered = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("status") == "FAILED")
    .withColumn("status_upper", F.upper("status"))
)

grouped = (
    filtered
    .groupBy("status")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "REFUNDED", 1)).alias("refunded_count"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("status")).alias("status_list"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "REFUNDED", 1)).alias("refunded_count_2"),

)

result = (
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select("id", "status_code", F.explode_outer("context").alias("key", "attr_value"))
)

parsed = (
    flattened
    .filter(F.col("key") == "version")
    .select(
        "id",
        "status_code",
        "key",
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(1) != 0).cast("int").alias("has_fault"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    parsed
    .select("id")
    .intersect(
        df_app_logs
        .filter(F.col("latency_ms") != 700)
        .select("id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    parsed
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

cleaned = (
    reconciled
    .filter(F.col("key").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.coalesce("key", F.lit("N/A")).alias("key_filled"),
        F.coalesce("key", F.lit("N/A")).alias("resolved_key"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("status_code").between(383, 433))
    .select(
        "id",
        "status_code",
        "status_code_high",
        "has_fault",
        "key_filled",
        "resolved_key",
        F.rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("has_fault").desc())).alias("has_fault_rank"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("key").orderBy(F.col("status_code").desc())).alias("status_code_rank"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    with_windows
    .select("id")
    .intersectAll(
        df_app_logs
        .filter(F.col("level") == "ERROR")
        .select("id")
    )
)

verified = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    verified
    .select(
        "id",
        "status_code",
        "status_code_high",
        "key_filled",
        "has_fault_rank",
        "status_code_rank",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("id").asc_nulls_first())
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy("product_id", "store_id").orderBy("event_seq", "id")
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy(F.month("sale_date"), "store_id").orderBy("sale_date", "id")

with_dims = (
    df_store_sales
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_products.alias("b"), F.col("e.product_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("b.stock_qty") == 290)
    .select(
        "e.*",
        F.col("b.brand"),
        F.col("b.product_name"),
        F.col("b.stock_qty"),
    )
)

scored = (
    with_dims
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("units").over(Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy("units", "id")).alias("prev_units"),
        F.lead("stock_qty").over(Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy("units", "id")).alias("next_stock_qty"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy("units", "id")).alias("seq_no"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("sale_date").desc(), "id")).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("d"), F.col("s.product_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("d.stock_qty").alias("product_stock_qty"),
        F.col("d.price"),
        F.col("d.brand").alias("product_brand"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("next_product_stock_qty", F.lead("product_stock_qty").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("prev_product_stock_qty", F.lag("product_stock_qty").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("prev_stock_qty", F.lag("stock_qty").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("seq_no_2", F.row_number().over(w_grp))
)

scored_store_sales = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "revenue",
        "product_name",
        "stock_qty",
        "prev_units",
        "next_stock_qty",
        "event_seq",
        "price",
        "product_brand",
        "next_product_stock_qty",
        "prev_stock_qty",
        "seq_no_2",
        F.row_number().over(w_ordered).alias("event_seq_2"),
        F.last("next_stock_qty", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("product_id", "store_id").orderBy("seq_no_2", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_next_stock_qty"),
        F.sum("event_seq").over(Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy("seq_no", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_event_seq"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    scored_store_sales
    .select("id", "product_id")
    .intersectAll(
        df_store_sales
        .filter(F.col("units").between(32, 37))
        .select("id", "product_id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    scored_store_sales
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.product_id") == F.col("k.product_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    kept_rows
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("e.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .groupingSets(
        [["brand", "product_brand"], ["brand"], []],
        F.col("p.brand").alias("brand"),
        F.col("e.product_brand").alias("product_brand"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("rows_total"),
        F.avg(F.col("e.prev_stock_qty")).alias("avg_prev_stock_qty"),
        F.min(F.col("e.seq_no_2")).alias("min_seq_no_2"),
    )
)
```

```python
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("revenue_adjusted", "id")).alias("seq_no"),
        F.lead("units", 1).over(Window.orderBy("units", "id")).alias("next_units"),
    )
)

base = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("next_units").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "revenue",
        "prev_units",
        "prev_revenue",
        "next_revenue",
        F.coalesce("prev_revenue", F.lit(0)).alias("prev_revenue_filled"),
        F.col("next_units").cast("string").alias("next_units_num"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("prev_revenue") <= 1800)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("prev_units").over(w_hist).alias("next_prev_units"),
        F.lag("prev_units").over(w_hist).alias("prev_prev_units"),
        F.lag("prev_revenue").over(w_hist).alias("prev_prev_revenue"),
        F.lead("prev_revenue").over(w_hist).alias("next_prev_revenue"),
        F.row_number().over(w_hist).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "prev_units",
        "next_revenue",
        "prev_revenue_filled",
        "next_prev_units",
        "prev_prev_revenue",
        "next_prev_revenue",
        "event_seq",
    )
    .orderBy("prev_units", F.col("prev_revenue_filled").desc())
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("attr_key", "value"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    flattened
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").desc(), "id", "attr_key")))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

metrics = (
    deduped
    .filter(F.col("attr_key") == "trace")
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("latency_ms", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy("rn", "id", "attr_key")).alias("next_latency_ms"),
        F.round((F.col("latency_ms") / F.sum("latency_ms").over(Window.partitionBy("service", "attr_key"))), 4).alias("latency_ms_share"),
        F.ntile(4).over(Window.orderBy("status_code", "id", "attr_key")).alias("status_code_bucket"),
        F.sum("status_code").over(Window.orderBy("log_ts", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_status_code"),
        F.avg("status_code").over(Window.partitionBy("host").orderBy("status_code", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(-3, -1)).alias("status_code_avg_3_prior"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("attr_key").isNotNull() & (~F.col("attr_key").eqNullSafe(F.lit("region"))))
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "status_code",
        "attr_key",
        "value",
        "rn",
        "next_latency_ms",
        "latency_ms_share",
        "cumulative_status_code",
        "status_code_avg_3_prior",
        F.round((F.col("status_code_bucket") * 100), 2).alias("status_code_bucket_scaled"),
        F.coalesce("attr_key", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("attr_key_filled"),
    )
)

result = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "id",
        "attr_key",
        "latency_ms_share",
        F.col("status_code_bucket_scaled").alias("STATUS_CODE_BUCKET_SCALED"),
    )
    .unpivot(
        ids=["id", "attr_key"],
        values=["latency_ms_share", "STATUS_CODE_BUCKET_SCALED"],
        variableColumnName="metric",
        valueColumnName="reading",
    )
    .filter(F.col("reading").isNotNull())
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

joined = (
    df_subscriptions
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_customers.alias("p"), F.col("a.customer_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("p.id")), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("p.email"))
)

with_windows = (
    joined
    .select(
        "id",
        "start_date",
        "end_date",
        "monthly_fee",
        F.max("monthly_fee").over(Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("start_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_max_monthly_fee"),
        F.count("monthly_fee").over(Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("start_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count_monthly_fee"),
        F.sum("monthly_fee").over(Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("start_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_sum_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("end_date") > F.lit("2023-06-20").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "start_date",
        "end_date",
        (F.datediff(F.col("end_date"), F.col("start_date")) / 7).alias("weeks_start_date_to_end_date"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(10).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("weeks_start_date_to_end_date").desc(), "id")).alias("weeks_start_date_to_end_date_bucket"),
        F.last("weeks_start_date_to_end_date", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy("weeks_start_date_to_end_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_weeks_start_date_to_end_date"),
    )
)

filtered_subscriptions = (
    metrics
    .filter((F.col("start_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-09-11"))) & (F.col("last_known_weeks_start_date_to_end_date") > 44))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round("weeks_start_date_to_end_date", 1).alias("weeks_start_date_to_end_date_rounded"),
        F.ceil("weeks_start_date_to_end_date").alias("weeks_start_date_to_end_date_whole"),
    )
)

result = (
    filtered_subscriptions
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "start_date").alias("activity_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.percentile_approx("weeks_start_date_to_end_date", 0.95).alias("weeks_start_date_to_end_date_p95"),
        F.percentile_approx("weeks_start_date_to_end_date_rounded", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("weeks_start_date_to_end_date_rounded_quartiles"),
        F.percentile_approx("weeks_start_date_to_end_date_whole", 0.9).alias("weeks_start_date_to_end_date_whole_p90"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("num_rows") < 1000)
    .orderBy(F.col("activity_month").desc())
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_hist = Window.orderBy("amount")
w_recent = Window.orderBy(F.col("amount_rank").desc())

matched_keys = (
    df_transactions
    .select("account_id", "txn_type")
    .exceptAll(
        df_transactions
        .filter(F.col("txn_time") < "2024-05-01")
        .select("account_id", "txn_type")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    df_transactions
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.account_id") == F.col("k.account_id")) & (F.col("s.txn_type") == F.col("k.txn_type")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

with_windows = (
    reconciled
    .filter(F.hour("txn_time").between(7, 10))
    .select(
        "account_id",
        "txn_type",
        "txn_time",
        "merchant",
        F.rank().over(w_hist).alias("amount_rank"),
    )
)

base = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("txn_time") >= F.lit("2023-10-10 22:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .withColumn("txn_time_date", F.to_date("txn_time"))
)

scored = (
    base
    .select(
        "*",
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy(F.col("amount_rank").asc_nulls_last())).alias("amount_rank_dense_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w_recent).alias("amount_rank_cume_dist"),
    )
)

remaining_keys = (
    scored
    .select("txn_type", "merchant")
    .subtract(
        df_transactions
        .filter(~F.col("is_flagged"))
        .select("txn_type", "merchant")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.txn_type") == F.col("k.txn_type")) & (F.col("s.merchant") == F.col("k.merchant")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    kept_rows
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("week", "txn_time").alias("week_start"))
    .agg(
        F.min("txn_time").alias("first_seen"),
        F.round(F.avg("amount_rank"), 2).alias("avg_amount_rank"),
        F.percentile_approx("amount_rank_cume_dist", 0.25).alias("amount_rank_cume_dist_quartiles"),
        F.percentile_approx("amount_rank_cume_dist", 0.5).alias("amount_rank_cume_dist_quartiles_2"),
        F.percentile_approx("amount_rank_cume_dist", 0.75).alias("amount_rank_cume_dist_quartiles_2_2"),
    )
)
```

```python
        "level_filled",
        F.col("is_remote").cast("int").alias("is_remote_flag"),
    )

    filtered
    .withColumn("next_is_remote_flag", F.lead("is_remote_flag", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("dept_id").orderBy("salary", "id")))
    .withColumn("is_remote_flag_avg_2", F.avg("is_remote_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("dept_id").orderBy("salary", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)))
)

metrics = (
    scored
    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("is_remote_flag_avg_2").over(Window.partitionBy("level", "dept_id").orderBy("next_is_remote_flag", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("last4_max_is_remote_flag_avg_2"),
        F.min("is_remote_flag_avg_2").over(Window.partitionBy("level", "dept_id").orderBy("next_is_remote_flag", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("last4_min_is_remote_flag_avg_2"),

        F.avg("is_remote_flag_avg_2").over(Window.partitionBy("level", "dept_id").orderBy("next_is_remote_flag", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("last4_avg_is_remote_flag_avg_2"),
    )
)

    metrics

        "a.dept_id",
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy("device_code")

base = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("reading_ts") > F.lit("2025-09-01").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("status_bits_per_pressure", F.round((F.col("status_bits") / F.col("pressure")), 2))
)

ranked = (
    base
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("status_bits_per_pressure").desc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .drop("rank_in_group")
)

prev_events = ranked.withColumn("prev_reading_ts", F.lag("reading_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")))

with_gaps = (
    prev_events
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("prev_reading_ts").isNull() | (F.col("reading_ts") > F.col("prev_reading_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL 20 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = (
    with_gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "temp_c",
        "humidity",
        "status_bits",
        "status_bits_per_pressure",
        F.sum("is_new_burst").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("island_id"),
    )
)

gaps = (
    sessionized
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.lag("reading_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("reading_ts") > F.lag("reading_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 45 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = gaps.withColumn("island_id_2", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

ranked_device_readings = (
    islands
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

metrics = (
    ranked_device_readings
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "temp_c",
        "humidity",
        "status_bits",
        "status_bits_per_pressure",
        "island_id",
        "island_id_2",
        "row_num",
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("status_bits").desc())).alias("status_bits_dense_rank"),
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("island_id_2")).alias("island_id_2_percent_rank"),
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.orderBy("status_bits_per_pressure")).alias("status_bits_per_pressure_percent_rank"),
        F.lead("island_id", 2, 0).over(Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("reading_ts"), "device_code").orderBy("temp_c", "id")).alias("next_island_id"),
    )
)

        F.sum("temp_c").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("island_id", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_temp_c"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("last_restock_day", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_ordered_2 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("running_avg_last_restock_quarter").desc())

cleaned = (
    df_inventory
    .filter(F.col("last_restock") >= "2023-08-22")
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "last_restock",
        F.dayofmonth("last_restock").alias("last_restock_day"),
    )
)

valid = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("last_restock") <= "2024-10-01")
    .select(
        "*",
        F.date_format("last_restock", "yyyy-MM-dd").alias("last_restock_label"),
    )
)

valid_inventory = (
    valid
    .filter((F.col("last_restock") > F.lit("2023-06-12").cast("date")) & (F.col("last_restock_day") >= 56))
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "last_restock_day",
        F.quarter("last_restock").alias("last_restock_quarter"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    valid_inventory
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isin([3, 5]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.min("last_restock_quarter").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("last_restock_day", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_min_last_restock_quarter"),
        F.sum("last_restock_quarter").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("last_restock_day", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_sum_last_restock_quarter"),
        F.count("last_restock_quarter").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("last_restock_day", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count_last_restock_quarter"),
        F.avg("last_restock_quarter").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("last_restock_day", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_avg_last_restock_quarter"),
    )
)

enriched_inventory = (
    enriched
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_products.alias("d"), F.col("src.product_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "src.id",
        "src.product_id",
        "src.last_restock_day",
        "src.last_restock_quarter",
        "src.running_min_last_restock_quarter",
        "src.running_sum_last_restock_quarter",
        "src.running_avg_last_restock_quarter",
        F.col("d.category"),
    )
)

scored = (
    enriched_inventory
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count("running_sum_last_restock_quarter").over(w_ordered).alias("running_count_running_sum_last_restock_quarter"),
        F.max("running_sum_last_restock_quarter").over(w_ordered).alias("running_max_running_sum_last_restock_quarter"),
        F.min("running_sum_last_restock_quarter").over(w_ordered).alias("running_min_running_sum_last_restock_quarter"),
        F.rank().over(w_ordered_2).alias("running_avg_last_restock_quarter_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("e.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .groupBy(F.col("p.brand").alias("brand"), F.col("e.category").alias("inventory_category"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.min(F.col("e.running_min_last_restock_quarter")).alias("min_running_min_last_restock_quarter"),
        F.min(F.col("e.running_sum_last_restock_quarter")).alias("min_running_sum_last_restock_quarter"),
    )
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_running = Window.partitionBy("device")
balance_by_customer_id = df_accounts.groupBy("customer_id").agg(F.avg("balance").alias("avg_account_balance"))

base = (
    df_sessions
    .filter((F.col("started_at") > F.lit("2023-07-18").cast("date")) & (~F.col("browser").eqNullSafe(F.lit("Firefox"))))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "device",
        "browser",
        "country",
        F.substring("device", 1, 2).alias("device_prefix"),
    )
)

joined = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_customers.alias("c"), F.col("s.customer_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("c.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.email"), F.col("c.country").alias("customer_country"))
)

latest_match = (
    joined
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("c"), (F.col("c.session_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.duration_sec").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.event_time"), F.col("c.duration_sec"))
)

with_prev = latest_match.withColumn("prev_event_time", F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy("event_time", "id")))

with_gaps = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("prev_event_time").isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.col("prev_event_time") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_sessions = with_gaps.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

with_gaps_2 = (
    sessions_sessions
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("event_time", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("event_time", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_sessions_2 = with_gaps_2.withColumn("session_no_2", F.sum("new_group_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

eligible = (
    sessions_sessions_2
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.session_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.event_time") < F.col("s.prev_event_time")), "left_anti")
)

with_windows = (
    eligible
    .withColumn("duration_sec_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").desc_nulls_last())))
    .withColumn("duration_sec_count_7d", F.count("duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("event_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("device_stddev_samp_session_no", F.stddev_samp("session_no").over(w_running))
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .join(balance_by_customer_id, on="customer_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "device",
        "country",
        "device_prefix",
        "customer_country",
        "event_time",
        "duration_sec",
        "session_no_2",
        F.when(F.col("device").rlike("^(desktop|tablet)$"), "GROUP_B").otherwise("CORE").alias("device_zone"),
        F.col("avg_account_balance"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("country").asc_nulls_last())
)
```

```python
    .filter((F.col("delivered_date") > F.lit("2023-09-25").cast("date")) & F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.concat("status", F.lit("/"), "carrier").alias("status_carrier"),
        F.round((F.col("cost") * 1.07), 2).alias("cost_adjusted"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("resolved_carrier"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    valid
    .select(
        "id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "cost_adjusted",
        "resolved_carrier",
        F.sum("cost_adjusted").over(Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("shipped_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_cost_adjusted"),
        F.lead("cost_adjusted", 1).over(w_recent).alias("next_cost_adjusted"),
        F.row_number().over(w_grp).alias("row_seq"),
        F.avg("cost").over(w_running).alias("cost_avg_3_prior"),
    )
)

base = (
    enriched
    .filter((F.col("shipped_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-05-07"))) & F.col("carrier").isin(["Kerry", "FedEx", "Flash"]))
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("cost_adjusted") * F.col("next_cost_adjusted")).alias("cost_adjusted_times_next_cost_adjusted"),
        F.greatest("row_seq", "running_cost_adjusted").alias("greatest_row_seq_running_cost_adjusted"),
    )
)

scored = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("shipped_date").between(F.lit("2023-09-01").cast("date"), F.lit("2024-04-21").cast("date")))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("cost_avg_3_prior", "id")).alias("seq_no"),
        F.avg("cost_avg_3_prior").over(Window.orderBy("running_cost_adjusted", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)).alias("cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior"),
    )
)

latest = (
    scored
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy(F.col("seq_no").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

deduped = (
    latest
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("cost_adjusted_times_next_cost_adjusted")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "carrier",
        "cost_adjusted",
        "running_cost_adjusted",
        "seq_no",
        "cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior",
        "latest_rank",
    )
)

scored_shipments = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy(F.col("cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior").desc(), "id")).alias("event_seq"),
        F.avg("cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior").over(Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)).alias("cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior_avg_5_prior"),
        F.lead("cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("latest_rank", "id")).alias("next_cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior"),
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy(F.col("cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior").desc_nulls_last())).alias("cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior_percent_rank"),
    )
)

summary = (
    scored_shipments
    .groupBy("seq_no")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("running_cost_adjusted"), 2).alias("avg_running_cost_adjusted"),
        F.percentile_approx("next_cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("next_cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior_quartiles"),
        F.countDistinct("carrier").alias("distinct_carriers"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .select(
        "seq_no",
        "avg_running_cost_adjusted",
        "next_cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior_quartiles",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("avg_running_cost_adjusted").asc_nulls_last())
)
```

```python
        "src.store_id",

        "src.channel",
        "src.amount",
        "src.discount",
        "src.amount_with_shipping",
        "src.channel_prefix",
        F.col("b.age"),
        F.col("b.city"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("row_num", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("channel", "store_id").orderBy("order_date")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

eligible = (
    ranked
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_payments.alias("c"), (F.col("c.order_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.status") == "SUCCESS"), "left_semi")
)

    eligible
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "amount",
        "discount",
        "channel_prefix",
        "row_num",
        F.lag("age").over(Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("amount_with_shipping", "id")).alias("prev_age"),
        F.lead("age").over(Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("amount_with_shipping", "id")).alias("next_age"),
        F.lag("amount_with_shipping").over(Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("amount_with_shipping", "id")).alias("prev_amount_with_shipping"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("amount_with_shipping", "id")).alias("event_seq"),
        F.avg("age").over(Window.orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)).alias("age_avg_6_prior"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "amount",
        "discount",
        "channel_prefix",
        "row_num",
        "prev_age",
        "next_age",
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

cleaned = (
    df_web_events
    .filter((F.col("event_time") >= F.lit("2023-09-02").cast("date")) & F.col("page").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.substring("event_type", 1, 4).alias("event_type_prefix"),
        F.upper("page").alias("page_upper"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "event_type",
        "event_time",
        "page_upper",
        F.sum("duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_duration_sec"),
        F.last("page", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_page"),
    )
)

with_windows_web_events = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("event_type").isin(["page_view", "search"]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_time", "id")).alias("row_seq"),
        F.sum("cumulative_duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("event_time"), "session_id").orderBy("cumulative_duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_cumulative_duration_sec"),
        F.sum("cumulative_duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("year", "event_time"), "session_id").orderBy("cumulative_duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_cumulative_duration_sec"),
        F.avg("cumulative_duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("event_time"), "session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)).alias("cumulative_duration_sec_avg_5_prior"),
        F.avg("cumulative_duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy(F.col("event_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_duration_sec_avg_7d"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    with_windows_web_events
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "event_type",
        "event_time",
        "cumulative_duration_sec",
        "last_known_page",
        "running_cumulative_duration_sec",
        "cumulative_duration_sec_avg_5_prior",
        F.round((F.col("row_seq") / F.sum("row_seq").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type"))), 4).alias("row_seq_share"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("session_id", "event_type").orderBy("cumulative_cumulative_duration_sec", "id")).alias("event_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy(F.col("event_time").desc(), "id")).alias("row_seq_2"),
        F.count("cumulative_duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("session_id", "event_type").orderBy(F.col("event_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_duration_sec_count_7d"),
        F.sum("running_cumulative_duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("cumulative_cumulative_duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_running_cumulative_duration_sec"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("cumulative_duration_sec_avg_5_prior") >= 2221, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("cumulative_duration_sec_avg_5_prior_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("event_type") == "click", F.col("cumulative_duration_sec")).otherwise(0)).alias("click_cumulative_duration_sec"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("event_type") == "search", 1)).alias("search_rows"),
        F.round(F.avg("row_seq_share"), 2).alias("avg_row_seq_share"),
        F.round(F.avg("row_seq_share"), 2).alias("avg_row_seq_share_2"),
        F.max("event_time").alias("ended_at"),
    )
    .orderBy("search_rows")
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
```
```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

remaining_keys = (
    df_payments
    .select("order_id", "id")
    .subtract(
        df_payments
        .filter(F.hour("paid_at").between(11, 16))
        .select("order_id", "id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    df_payments
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.order_id") == F.col("k.order_id")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

with_dims = (
    reconciled
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("d"), F.col("src.order_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("d.id")), "inner")
    .select("src.*", F.col("d.shipping_fee"))
)

enriched = (
    with_dims
    .filter(F.col("method").isin(["card", "bank_transfer"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("order_id", "status").orderBy(F.col("shipping_fee").desc_nulls_first())).alias("shipping_fee_rank"),
        F.sum("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("paid_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-2592000, Window.currentRow)).alias("amount_sum_30d"),
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc())).alias("amount_percent_rank"),
        F.stddev_samp("shipping_fee").over(Window.partitionBy("method", "order_id")).alias("method_stddev_samp_shipping_fee"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("shipping_fee_rank_per_amount_percent_rank", (F.col("shipping_fee_rank") / F.nullif("amount_percent_rank", F.lit(0))))
)

cleaned_payments = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("shipping_fee_rank_per_amount_percent_rank_minus_shipping_fee_rank", (F.col("shipping_fee_rank_per_amount_percent_rank") - F.col("shipping_fee_rank")))
)

result = (
    cleaned_payments
    .groupBy("order_id")
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("amount_percent_rank", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("amount_percent_rank_quartiles"),
        F.min("shipping_fee_rank").alias("min_shipping_fee_rank"),
        F.percentile_approx("shipping_fee_rank", 0.5).alias("shipping_fee_rank_p50"),
        F.min("amount_sum_30d").alias("min_amount_sum_30d"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("min_shipping_fee_rank") > 0)
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

lines = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select("id", "currency", F.explode("tier_limits").alias("tier_value"))
)

filtered = (
    lines
    .filter(F.col("currency") == "USD")
    .withColumn("currency_lower", F.lower("currency"))
)

scored = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "tier_value",
        "currency_lower",
        F.count("tier_value").over(Window.partitionBy("currency")).alias("currency_count_tier_value"),
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("tier_value").desc_nulls_last())).alias("tier_value_cume_dist"),
        F.min("tier_value").over(Window.partitionBy("currency")).alias("currency_min_tier_value"),
        F.avg("tier_value").over(Window.partitionBy("currency")).alias("currency_avg_tier_value"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("tier_value").asc_nulls_first())).alias("tier_value_rank"),
    )
)

filtered_price_tiers = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("currency_min_tier_value").between(26, 71))
    .select(
        "currency_lower",
        "currency_count_tier_value",
        "currency_min_tier_value",
        "currency_avg_tier_value",
        "tier_value_rank",
        F.least("currency_count_tier_value", "currency_min_tier_value").alias("least_currency_count_tier_value_currency_min_tier_value"),

)

scored_price_tiers = (
    filtered_price_tiers
    .select(
        "currency_count_tier_value",
        "least_currency_count_tier_value_currency_min_tier_value",
        F.rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("currency_avg_tier_value").desc_nulls_last())).alias("currency_avg_tier_value_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("currency_min_tier_value").desc_nulls_first())).alias("currency_min_tier_value_cume_dist"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored_price_tiers
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

matched_keys = (
    df_web_events
    .select("id")
    .intersect(
        df_web_events
        .filter(F.col("page").isin(["/product", "/search"]))
        .select("id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    df_web_events
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

metrics = (
    kept_rows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy(F.col("event_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-2592000, Window.currentRow)).alias("duration_sec_avg_30d"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").desc())).alias("duration_sec_rank"),
        F.count("duration_sec").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("event_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)).alias("duration_sec_count_7d"),
    )
)

joined = (
    metrics
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("p"), F.col("a.session_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("p.country"))
)

enriched = (
    joined
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("p"), F.col("src.session_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "src.session_id",
        "src.event_type",
        "src.event_time",
        "src.duration_sec",
        "src.duration_sec_avg_30d",
        "src.duration_sec_rank",
        "src.duration_sec_count_7d",
        F.col("p.browser"),
        F.col("p.country").alias("session_country"),
    )
)

base = (
    enriched
    .filter((F.col("event_time") >= F.lit("2023-08-07 21:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & F.col("session_country").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "session_id",
        "event_type",
        "event_time",
        "duration_sec_avg_30d",
        "duration_sec_rank",
        "duration_sec_count_7d",
        "browser",
        "session_country",
        F.lower("event_type").alias("event_type_lower"),
    )
)

enriched_web_events = (
    base
    .select(
        "session_id",
        "duration_sec_count_7d",
        "browser",
        "event_type_lower",

)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_store_sales
    .filter(F.col("sale_date") >= F.lit("2023-05-11").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("revenue_tier", F.when(F.col("revenue") >= 3300, "High").when(F.col("revenue") >= 900, "Medium").otherwise("Low"))
)

metrics = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "sale_date",
        "revenue_tier",
        F.lead("units").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("sale_date", "id")).alias("next_units"),
        F.lag("units").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("sale_date", "id")).alias("prev_units"),
        F.lag("revenue").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("sale_date", "id")).alias("prev_revenue"),
        F.lead("revenue").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("sale_date", "id")).alias("next_revenue"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("sale_date", "id")).alias("event_seq"),
        F.ntile(4).over(Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("units", "id")).alias("units_bucket"),
    )
)

valid = (
    metrics
    .filter((F.col("sale_date") > F.lit("2023-04-09").cast("date")) & F.col("store_id").isin([4, 6]))
    .withColumn("next_revenue_int", F.col("next_revenue").cast("int"))
)

ranked = (
    valid
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("sale_date").desc_nulls_first(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "sale_date",
        "prev_units",
        "prev_revenue",
        "next_revenue",
        "event_seq",
        "units_bucket",
        "next_revenue_int",
    )
)

joined = (
    ranked
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_stores.alias("s"), F.col("e.store_id") == F.col("s.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("s.opened_date") >= "2023-08-01")
    .select("e.*", F.col("s.city"), F.col("s.opened_date"))
)

result = (
    joined
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "prev_units",
        "prev_revenue",
        "next_revenue",
        "units_bucket",
        "next_revenue_int",
        "city",
        "opened_date",
    )
    .orderBy("prev_units")
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

metrics = (
    df_web_events
    .select(
        "id",
        "duration_sec",
        F.lag("duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id")).alias("prev_duration_sec"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id")).alias("row_seq"),
        F.max("duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("session_id")).alias("session_id_max_duration_sec"),
    )
)

base = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("session_id_max_duration_sec").between(198, 291))
    .withColumn("session_id_max_duration_sec_plus_row_seq", F.col("session_id_max_duration_sec") + F.col("row_seq"))
)

with_windows = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "duration_sec",
        "row_seq",
        "session_id_max_duration_sec",
        "session_id_max_duration_sec_plus_row_seq",
        F.lag("duration_sec", 2, 0).over(Window.orderBy("row_seq", "id")).alias("prev_duration_sec_2"),
        F.lead("prev_duration_sec", 1).over(Window.orderBy("session_id_max_duration_sec", "id")).alias("next_prev_duration_sec"),
        F.sum("session_id_max_duration_sec_plus_row_seq").over(Window.orderBy("row_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_session_id_max_duration_sec_plus_row_seq"),
        F.sum("row_seq").over(Window.orderBy("prev_duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_row_seq"),
        F.lead("session_id_max_duration_sec", 2, 0).over(Window.orderBy("session_id_max_duration_sec_plus_row_seq", "id")).alias("next_session_id_max_duration_sec"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("last_known_duration_sec", F.last("duration_sec", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy("cumulative_session_id_max_duration_sec_plus_row_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("duration_sec_avg_6", F.avg("duration_sec").over(Window.orderBy("session_id_max_duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)))
)

totals = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("prev_duration_sec_2_tier", F.when(F.col("prev_duration_sec_2") >= 513, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .withColumn("next_session_id_max_duration_sec_tier", F.when(F.col("next_session_id_max_duration_sec") >= 477, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["prev_duration_sec_2_tier", "next_session_id_max_duration_sec_tier"], ["prev_duration_sec_2_tier"], []],
        "prev_duration_sec_2_tier", "next_session_id_max_duration_sec_tier",
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.round(F.avg("cumulative_session_id_max_duration_sec_plus_row_seq"), 2).alias("avg_cumulative_session_id_max_duration_sec_plus_row_seq"),
        F.sum("row_seq").alias("total_row_seq"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("grouping_level"),
    )
)

result = (
    totals
    .select(
        "next_session_id_max_duration_sec_tier",
        "avg_cumulative_session_id_max_duration_sec_plus_row_seq",
        "total_row_seq",
        "distinct_ids",
        "grouping_level",
    )
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy(F.year("signup_date"), "country").orderBy("credit_limit", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)

filtered = (
    df_customers
    .filter(F.col("city").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "name",
        "email",
        "country",
        "city",
        "segment",
        "signup_date",
        "is_active",
        "credit_limit",
        "age",
        F.substring("city", 1, 3).alias("city_prefix"),
        F.upper(F.trim("name")).alias("name_normalized"),
        F.coalesce("city", F.lit("N/A")).alias("resolved_city"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("running_count_age", F.count("age").over(Window.partitionBy("country", "segment").orderBy("age", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("running_min_age", F.min("age").over(Window.partitionBy("country", "segment").orderBy("age", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("running_sum_age", F.sum("age").over(Window.partitionBy("country", "segment").orderBy("age", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("running_max_age", F.max("age").over(Window.partitionBy("country", "segment").orderBy("age", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
)

not_flagged = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.started_at") >= F.col("s.signup_date")), "left_anti")
)

enriched = (
    not_flagged
    .select(
        "id",
        "name",
        "email",
        "country",
        "city",
        "segment",
        "signup_date",
        "is_active",
        "name_normalized",
        "running_count_age",
        "running_sum_age",
        F.avg("credit_limit").over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("signup_date", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)).alias("credit_limit_avg_6_prior"),
        F.avg("running_min_age").over(w_grp).alias("running_min_age_avg_6"),
    )
)

valid = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("segment").eqNullSafe(F.lit("Corporate")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "name",
        "city",
        "segment",
        "signup_date",
        "name_normalized",
        "running_min_age_avg_6",
        F.when(F.col("is_active"), "Yes").otherwise("No").alias("is_active_label"),
        F.coalesce("segment", F.lit("NONE")).alias("segment_clean"),
    )
)

enriched_customers = (
    valid
    .select(
        "id",
        "city",
        "name_normalized",
        "running_min_age_avg_6",
        F.sum("running_min_age_avg_6").over(Window.partitionBy("segment", "city").orderBy("running_min_age_avg_6", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_running_min_age_avg_6"),
        F.sum("running_min_age_avg_6").over(Window.orderBy("signup_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_running_min_age_avg_6"),
        F.ntile(10).over(Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("running_min_age_avg_6").desc(), "id")).alias("running_min_age_avg_6_bucket"),
    )
)

totals = (
    enriched_customers
    .groupBy("city")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("city").alias("distinct_cities"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("city")).alias("city_list"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "Berlin", 1)).alias("berlin_rows"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
    )
)

result = (
    totals
    .select(
        "city",
        "distinct_ids",
        F.when(F.col("city").rlike("^(Chiang Mai|New York)$"), "OTHER_ZONE").otherwise("GROUP_A").alias("city_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("distinct_ids").desc(), "city_zone")
)
```

```python
        "running_max_amount_share",
        F.avg("running_max_amount_share").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id", "method").orderBy("running_min_amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_avg_running_max_amount_share"),
        F.sum("running_max_amount_share").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id", "method").orderBy("running_min_amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_sum_running_max_amount_share"),
        F.min("running_max_amount_share").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id", "method").orderBy("running_min_amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_min_running_max_amount_share"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy(F.col("seq_no").desc(), "id")).alias("row_seq"),
    )
)

scored_payments = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "running_sum_running_max_amount_share",
        "running_min_running_max_amount_share",
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("running_sum_running_max_amount_share").desc_nulls_last())).alias("running_sum_running_max_amount_share_percent_rank"),
        F.lead("running_min_running_max_amount_share", 1).over(Window.orderBy("running_min_running_max_amount_share", "id")).alias("next_running_min_running_max_amount_share"),
        F.ntile(5).over(Window.orderBy("row_seq", "id")).alias("row_seq_bucket"),
        F.sum("running_avg_running_max_amount_share").over(Window.orderBy("running_sum_running_max_amount_share", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_running_avg_running_max_amount_share"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored_payments
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("next_running_min_running_max_amount_share") >= 0.64, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("next_running_min_running_max_amount_share_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("running_sum_running_max_amount_share", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("running_sum_running_max_amount_share_quartiles"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("next_running_min_running_max_amount_share_tier").asc_nulls_last())
)
```
