```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_running = Window.partitionBy("level", "key")

flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("key", "v"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    flattened
    .filter(F.col("key").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        "key",
        "v",
        F.concat_ws("-", "key", "level").alias("key_level_key"),
        F.coalesce("key", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("key_clean"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "v",
        "key_clean",
        F.round((F.col("latency_ms") / F.sum("latency_ms").over(Window.partitionBy("key"))), 4).alias("latency_ms_share"),
        F.stddev_samp("latency_ms").over(Window.partitionBy("level")).alias("level_stddev_samp_latency_ms"),
        F.corr("status_code", "latency_ms").over(w_running).alias("corr_status_code_latency_ms"),
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy(F.col("status_code").desc())).alias("status_code_percent_rank"),
        F.round((F.col("latency_ms") / F.sum("latency_ms").over(Window.partitionBy("key"))), 4).alias("latency_ms_share_2"),
    )
)

cleaned_app_logs = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("corr_status_code_latency_ms") < 0.5)
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("status_code_percent_rank") - F.col("latency_ms_share")).alias("status_code_percent_rank_minus_latency_ms_share"),
        F.round("latency_ms_share_2", 1).alias("latency_ms_share_2_rounded"),
    )
)

valid = (
    cleaned_app_logs
    .filter(F.col("latency_ms_share_2_rounded") < 33)
    .withColumn("level_stddev_samp_latency_ms_tier", F.when(F.col("level_stddev_samp_latency_ms") >= 2053, "High").when(F.col("level_stddev_samp_latency_ms") >= 882, "Medium").otherwise("Low"))
)

summary = (
    valid
    .groupBy("level")
    .agg(
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("level")).alias("level_list"),
        F.percentile_approx("latency_ms_share_2_rounded", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("latency_ms_share_2_rounded_quartiles"),
    )
)

result = summary.select("level", "latency_ms_share_2_rounded_quartiles")
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
```

```python
        F.count("product_name_length").over(w_recent).alias("running_count_product_name_length"),
        F.avg("product_name_length").over(w_recent).alias("running_avg_product_name_length"),
    )

scored = (

    .select(

        "product_name",
        "cost",
        "category_product_name_key",
        "product_name_length",
        "running_sum_product_name_length",
        "running_count_product_name_length",

        F.max("cost").over(Window.partitionBy("supplier_id").orderBy("product_name_length", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("last4_max_cost"),
        F.min("cost").over(Window.partitionBy("supplier_id").orderBy("product_name_length", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("last4_min_cost"),
    )
)

        "category_product_name_key",
        "running_sum_product_name_length",
        "last4_avg_cost",
        "last4_max_cost",
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_running = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
amount_by_order_id = df_payments.groupBy("order_id").agg(F.avg("amount").alias("avg_payment_amount"))

gaps = (
    df_payments
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.lag("paid_at").over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("paid_at", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("paid_at") > F.lag("paid_at").over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("paid_at", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_payments = gaps.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

enriched = (
    sessions_payments
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_orders.alias("d"), F.col("e.order_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("d.order_date") > "2024-11-01")
    .select("e.*", F.col("d.channel"))
)

gaps_2 = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.lag("paid_at").over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("paid_at") > F.lag("paid_at").over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = gaps_2.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

metrics = (
    sessionized
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("session_no").over(w_running).alias("running_sum_session_no"),
        F.count("session_no").over(w_running).alias("running_count_session_no"),
        F.avg("session_no").over(w_running).alias("running_avg_session_no"),
        F.first("is_new_burst", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("session_no", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_is_new_burst"),
    )
)

joined = (
    metrics
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_orders.alias("p"), F.col("e.order_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .select("e.*", F.col("p.discount"))
)

with_prev = joined.withColumn("prev_paid_at", F.lag("paid_at").over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id")))

gaps_3 = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_paid_at").isNull() | (F.col("paid_at") > F.col("prev_paid_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_payments_2 = gaps_3.withColumn("burst_id_2", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

result = (
    sessions_payments_2
    .join(amount_by_order_id, on="order_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "amount",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        "session_no",
        "channel",
        "is_new_session",
        "running_sum_session_no",
        F.col("avg_payment_amount"),
    )
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy("region")
w_ordered = Window.orderBy("sqft", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

filtered = (
    df_stores
    .filter(F.col("region").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("city_lower", F.lower("city"))
)

with_windows = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("opened_date") > "2025-10-01")
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("sqft").over(w_grp).alias("region_sum_sqft"),
        F.first("region", ignorenulls=True).over(w_ordered).alias("first_known_region"),
    )
)

scored = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_name",
        "opened_date",
        "sqft",
        "city_lower",
        "first_known_region",
        F.max("region_sum_sqft").over(w_grp).alias("running_max_region_sum_sqft"),
        F.avg("region_sum_sqft").over(w_grp).alias("running_avg_region_sum_sqft"),
        F.sum("region_sum_sqft").over(w_grp).alias("running_sum_region_sum_sqft"),
        F.count("region_sum_sqft").over(w_grp).alias("running_count_region_sum_sqft"),
        F.sum("sqft").over(Window.partitionBy("city", "region").orderBy("region_sum_sqft", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_sqft"),
    )
)

with_windows_stores = (
    scored
    .select(
        "*",
        F.first("running_sum_region_sum_sqft", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy("running_sum_region_sum_sqft", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_running_sum_region_sum_sqft"),
        F.first("running_sqft", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy("opened_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_running_sqft"),
        F.lead("sqft", 2).over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("opened_date")).orderBy("running_max_region_sum_sqft", "id")).alias("next_sqft"),
        F.rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("running_count_region_sum_sqft").desc_nulls_last())).alias("running_count_region_sum_sqft_rank"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    with_windows_stores
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("running_max_region_sum_sqft").over(Window.orderBy("running_count_region_sum_sqft", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_max_region_sum_sqft_avg_2"),
        F.avg("running_max_region_sum_sqft").over(Window.orderBy("running_sqft", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)).alias("running_max_region_sum_sqft_avg_3_prior"),
        F.first("running_count_region_sum_sqft", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy("running_avg_region_sum_sqft", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_running_count_region_sum_sqft"),
        F.ntile(10).over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("opened_date")).orderBy("running_avg_region_sum_sqft", "id")).alias("running_avg_region_sum_sqft_bucket"),
        F.last("running_count_region_sum_sqft", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("WEEK", "opened_date")).orderBy("running_max_region_sum_sqft", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_running_count_region_sum_sqft"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_name",
        "opened_date",
        "sqft",
        "first_known_region",
        "running_max_region_sum_sqft",
        "running_avg_region_sum_sqft",
        "running_count_region_sum_sqft",
        "first_known_running_sqft",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("id").desc())
)
```

```python
deduped = (
    base
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("months_since_start_date").asc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)

        F.ceil("monthly_fee").alias("monthly_fee_whole"),
    )

deduped_subscriptions = (
    valid
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("months_since_start_date", "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)

enriched = (
    deduped_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("customer_id") == 2)
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "monthly_fee",
        "months_since_start_date",
        "rank_in_group",
        F.lag("monthly_fee_whole", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("rank_in_group", "id")).alias("prev_monthly_fee_whole"),
        F.avg("monthly_fee").over(Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("months_since_start_date", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)).alias("monthly_fee_avg_5"),
        F.max("monthly_fee_whole").over(Window.partitionBy("customer_id")).alias("customer_id_max_monthly_fee_whole"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("end_date"), "customer_id").orderBy("monthly_fee").asc_nulls_first())).alias("monthly_fee_dense_rank"),
        F.sum("monthly_fee").over(Window.orderBy("monthly_fee_whole", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "prev_monthly_fee_whole",
        "monthly_fee_avg_5",
        "monthly_fee_dense_rank",
        F.lead("customer_id_max_monthly_fee_whole").over(w_ordered).alias("next_customer_id_max_monthly_fee_whole"),
        F.lead("monthly_fee_avg_5").over(w_ordered).alias("next_monthly_fee_avg_5"),
        F.row_number().over(w_ordered).alias("event_seq"),
        F.last("monthly_fee_dense_rank", ignorenulls=True).over(w_running).alias("last_known_monthly_fee_dense_rank"),
    )
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_payments
    .filter((F.col("paid_at") >= F.lit("2023-06-03 19:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & F.col("order_id").isin([2, 8, 12, 36]))
    .withColumn("method_filled", F.coalesce("method", F.lit("Unknown")))
)

gaps = (
    base
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.col("paid_at") - F.lag("paid_at").over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id")) > F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = (
    gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "method",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        "method_filled",
        F.sum("new_group_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("session_id"),
    )
)

result = (
    islands
    .withColumn("session_id_tier", F.when(F.col("session_id") >= 7, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL"))
    .rollup("session_id_tier")
    .agg(
        F.count_if(F.col("status") == "REFUNDED").alias("refunded_events"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("method") == "paypal", F.col("session_id"))).alias("paypal_max_session_id"),
        F.percentile_approx("session_id", 0.95).alias("session_id_p95"),
        F.percentile_approx("session_id", 0.95).alias("session_id_p95_2"),
        F.grouping("session_id_tier").alias("grouping_level"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("refunded_events") < 1000)
    .orderBy(F.col("session_id_tier").desc())
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

exploded = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select("id", "currency", F.explode_outer("discounts").alias("tier_value"))
)

valid = (
    exploded
    .filter(F.col("tier_value") > 62)
    .withColumn("is_usd", F.when(F.col("currency") == "USD", 1).otherwise(0))
)

scored = (
    valid
    .select(
        "*",
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("is_usd").asc_nulls_last())).alias("is_usd_cume_dist"),
        F.max("is_usd").over(Window.partitionBy("currency")).alias("currency_max_is_usd"),
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("is_usd").desc_nulls_last())).alias("is_usd_cume_dist_2"),
        F.sum("is_usd").over(Window.partitionBy("currency")).alias("currency_sum_is_usd"),
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy("is_usd")).alias("is_usd_cume_dist_3"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("currency_sum_is_usd") >= 260)
    .select(
        "is_usd",
        "currency_max_is_usd",
        "is_usd_cume_dist_2",
        F.sum("is_usd_cume_dist_3").over(Window.partitionBy("currency")).alias("currency_sum_is_usd_cume_dist_3"),
        F.stddev_samp("tier_value").over(Window.partitionBy("currency")).alias("currency_stddev_samp_tier_value"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("is_usd_cume_dist_3").asc_nulls_last())).alias("is_usd_cume_dist_3_rank"),
        F.stddev_samp("tier_value").over(Window.partitionBy("currency")).alias("currency_stddev_samp_tier_value_2"),
    )
)

base = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("is_usd_cume_dist_2") >= 0.71)
    .withColumn("currency_stddev_samp_tier_value_2_rounded", F.round("currency_stddev_samp_tier_value_2", 0))
)

grouped = (
    base
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("is_usd_cume_dist_3_rank") >= 7, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("is_usd_cume_dist_3_rank_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("is_usd") >= 81, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("is_usd_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("is_usd"), 2).alias("avg_is_usd"),
        F.percentile_approx("currency_max_is_usd", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("currency_max_is_usd_quartiles"),
        F.percentile_approx("currency_stddev_samp_tier_value", 0.9).alias("currency_stddev_samp_tier_value_p90"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("avg_is_usd") >= 0)
)

result = (
    grouped
    .select(
        "is_usd_cume_dist_3_rank_tier",
        "is_usd_tier",
        "currency_max_is_usd_quartiles",
        "currency_stddev_samp_tier_value_p90",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("is_usd_tier").desc_nulls_first())
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy("order_id")
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "product_id")
w_running = Window.orderBy(F.col("unit_price").desc())
w_running_2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("quantity_share").desc())
w_recent = Window.orderBy(F.col("unit_price_cume_dist").desc())

matched_keys = (
    df_order_items
    .select("product_id", "id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_order_items
        .filter(F.col("unit_price") <= 340)
        .select("product_id", "id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    df_order_items
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.product_id") == F.col("k.product_id")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

scored = (
    reconciled
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count("unit_price").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id")).alias("product_id_count_unit_price"),
        F.corr("unit_price", "quantity").over(w_grp).alias("corr_unit_price_quantity"),
        F.corr("quantity", "unit_price").over(w_hist).alias("corr_quantity_unit_price"),
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("unit_price").desc_nulls_last())).alias("unit_price_cume_dist"),
        F.round((F.col("quantity") / F.sum("quantity").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id"))), 4).alias("quantity_share"),
    )
)

scored_order_items = (
    scored
    .select(
        "unit_price",
        "product_id_count_unit_price",
        "corr_quantity_unit_price",
        "unit_price_cume_dist",
        "quantity_share",
        F.rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("quantity").desc())).alias("quantity_rank"),
        F.max("quantity_share").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id", "order_id")).alias("product_id_max_quantity_share"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    scored_order_items
    .select(
        "product_id_count_unit_price",
        "corr_quantity_unit_price",
        "quantity_rank",
        "product_id_max_quantity_share",
        F.cume_dist().over(w_running).alias("unit_price_cume_dist_2"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w_running_2).alias("quantity_share_percent_rank"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w_recent).alias("unit_price_cume_dist_percent_rank"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("product_id_max_quantity_share") <= 0)
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("quantity_rank") / F.nullif("corr_quantity_unit_price", F.lit(0))).alias("quantity_rank_per_corr_quantity_unit_price"),
        F.col("unit_price_cume_dist_2").cast("int").alias("unit_price_cume_dist_2_int"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "*",
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("quantity_rank").asc_nulls_first())).alias("quantity_rank_percent_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("unit_price_cume_dist_2_int").asc_nulls_first())).alias("unit_price_cume_dist_2_int_cume_dist"),
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("unit_price_cume_dist_2").asc())).alias("unit_price_cume_dist_2_percent_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("unit_price_cume_dist_2_int_cume_dist") >= 0.62, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("unit_price_cume_dist_2_int_cume_dist_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("quantity_rank_percent_rank") >= 0.62, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("quantity_rank_percent_rank_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("product_id_max_quantity_share") >= 1, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("product_id_max_quantity_share_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("unit_price_cume_dist_2", 0.5).alias("unit_price_cume_dist_2_p50"),
        F.round(F.avg("quantity_share_percent_rank"), 2).alias("avg_quantity_share_percent_rank"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.percentile_approx("quantity_rank", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("quantity_rank_quartiles"),
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows_2"),
    )
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("key", "attr_value"),
    )
)

unpacked = (
    flattened
    .select(
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "key",
        "attr_value",
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(1) != 0).cast("int").alias("is_flagged"),
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
    )
)

base = (
    unpacked
    .filter(F.col("service") != "checkout")
    .select(
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "key",
        "is_flagged",
        "status_code_high",
        F.coalesce("key", F.lit("unassigned")).alias("key_filled"),
        F.coalesce("key", F.lit("NONE")).alias("key_clean"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    base
    .filter((F.col("log_ts") >= F.to_timestamp(F.lit("2025-06-01 15:00:00"))) & F.col("key").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("status_code_high_tier", F.when(F.col("status_code_high") >= 2, "High").when(F.col("status_code_high") >= 1, "Medium").otherwise("Low"))
)

with_windows = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("is_flagged_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("WEEK", "log_ts"), "key").orderBy(F.col("is_flagged").desc_nulls_first())))
    .withColumn("is_flagged_avg_15m", F.avg("is_flagged").over(Window.partitionBy("key").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-900, Window.currentRow)))
)

with_windows_app_logs = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("is_flagged_cume_dist_2", F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("log_ts"), "service").orderBy(F.col("is_flagged").desc())))
    .withColumn("is_flagged_rank", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("key").orderBy("is_flagged")))
    .withColumn("status_code_high_avg_30m", F.avg("status_code_high").over(Window.partitionBy("key").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-1800, Window.currentRow)))
)

result = (
    with_windows_app_logs
    .select(
        "key",
        "is_flagged",
        "key_filled",
        "is_flagged_cume_dist",
        "is_flagged_cume_dist_2",
        "is_flagged_rank",
        "status_code_high_avg_30m",
        F.when(F.col("key").rlike("^(trace|region)$"), "GROUP_B").otherwise("OTHER_ZONE").alias("key_zone"),
    )
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

cleaned = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("quantity_rounded", F.round("quantity", 2))
)

with_windows = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "quantity",
        "quantity_rounded",
        F.corr("quantity", "unit_price").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id", "product_id")).alias("corr_quantity_unit_price"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("quantity_rounded").desc(), "id")).alias("seq_no"),
        F.ntile(4).over(Window.orderBy("quantity", "id")).alias("quantity_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("product_id", "order_id").orderBy("quantity", "id")).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

scored = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("corr_quantity_unit_price") > 0.5)
    .select(
        "id",
        "quantity",
        "quantity_rounded",
        "event_seq",
        F.avg("corr_quantity_unit_price").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id")).alias("order_id_avg_corr_quantity_unit_price"),
        F.avg("seq_no").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("seq_no", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)).alias("seq_no_avg_3_prior"),
    )
)

cleaned_order_items = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("event_seq") < 7)
    .withColumn("seq_no_avg_3_prior_rounded", F.round("seq_no_avg_3_prior", 0))
)

result = (
    cleaned_order_items
    .rollup(
        F.when(F.col("quantity_rounded") >= 90, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("quantity_rounded_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("order_id_avg_corr_quantity_unit_price") >= 1, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("order_id_avg_corr_quantity_unit_price_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("event_seq"), 2).alias("avg_event_seq"),
        F.percentile_approx("seq_no_avg_3_prior", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("seq_no_avg_3_prior_quartiles"),
        F.round(F.avg("order_id_avg_corr_quantity_unit_price"), 2).alias("avg_order_id_avg_corr_quantity_unit_price"),
        F.percentile_approx("seq_no_avg_3_prior", 0.95).alias("seq_no_avg_3_prior_p95"),
        F.percentile_approx("quantity_rounded", 0.95).alias("quantity_rounded_p95"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("avg_order_id_avg_corr_quantity_unit_price").desc_nulls_last())
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

exploded = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("k", "attr_value"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    exploded
    .select(
        "id",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "status_code",
        "k",
        "attr_value",
        F.avg("status_code").over(Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "k").rowsBetween(-6, -1)).alias("status_code_avg_6_prior"),
        F.lag("status_code", 2).over(Window.orderBy("status_code", "id", "k")).alias("prev_status_code"),
    )
)

scored = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("status_code_avg_6_prior").between(350, 358))
    .select(
        "id",
        "level",
        "k",
        "prev_status_code",
        F.sum("prev_status_code").over(Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy("status_code_avg_6_prior", "id", "k").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_prev_status_code"),
        F.sum("status_code").over(Window.orderBy("prev_status_code", "id", "k").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_status_code"),
        F.ntile(5).over(Window.orderBy("prev_status_code", "id", "k")).alias("prev_status_code_bucket"),
        F.ntile(10).over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "log_ts"), "k").orderBy(F.col("prev_status_code").desc(), "id", "k")).alias("prev_status_code_bucket_2"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    scored
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy(F.col("prev_status_code_bucket_2").desc(), "id", "k")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

daily = (
    ranked
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("prev_status_code_bucket") >= 8, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("prev_status_code_bucket_tier"),
        "level",
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("level") == "INFO", F.col("cumulative_prev_status_code")).otherwise(0)).alias("info_cumulative_prev_status_code"),
        F.round(F.sum("prev_status_code_bucket") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("k") == "region", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("prev_status_code_bucket_per_region"),
        F.count_if(F.col("k") == "region").alias("region_events"),
    )
)

result = (
    daily
    .select(
        "prev_status_code_bucket_tier",
        "level",
        "info_cumulative_prev_status_code",
        "region_events",
    )
)
```

```python
    .filter((F.col("page").eqNullSafe(F.lit("/cart"))) & (F.col("page").isNotNull()))

        F.coalesce("page", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("page_filled"),
    )

    filtered
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = (
    flagged
    .select(
        "id",
        "page",
        "event_time",
        "page_event_type",
        "page_filled",
        F.sum("session_start_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("island_id"),
    )
)

result = (
    islands
    .withColumn("island_id_tier", F.when(F.col("island_id") >= 7, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["island_id_tier", "island_id"], ["island_id_tier"]],
        "island_id_tier",
        "island_id",
    )
    .agg(
        F.min("event_time").alias("first_seen"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.min("event_time").alias("started_at"),

    .orderBy(F.col("island_id_tier").desc_nulls_first())
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

cleaned = (
    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("paid_at") > F.lit("2023-06-07 16:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "method",
        "amount",
        "status",
        F.to_date(F.col("paid_at")).alias("paid_at_date"),
        F.trim(F.col("status")).alias("clean_status"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .select("id", "order_id", "method", "amount", "clean_status")
)

latest = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("rn", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc_nulls_last())))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

matched_keys = (
    latest
    .select("order_id", "method")
    .subtract(
        df_payments
        .filter(F.col("method").isin(["card", "promptpay"]))
        .select("order_id", "method")
    )
)

verified = (
    latest
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.order_id") == F.col("k.order_id")) & (F.col("s.method") == F.col("k.method")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

filtered = (
    verified
    .filter(F.col("amount").between(690, 1380))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "amount",
        "clean_status",
        "rn",
        F.round(F.col("amount") * 1.1, 2).alias("adjusted_amount"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "id",
        "amount",
        "adjusted_amount",
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("adjusted_amount").desc_nulls_last())).alias("adjusted_amount_dense_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .cube(
        F.when(F.col("adjusted_amount") >= 82, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("adjusted_amount_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("adjusted_amount_dense_rank") >= 9, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("adjusted_amount_dense_rank_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("amount"), 2).alias("avg_amount"),
        F.round(F.avg("adjusted_amount"), 2).alias("avg_adjusted_amount"),
        F.round(F.avg("adjusted_amount"), 2).alias("avg_adjusted_amount_2"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("adjusted_amount_dense_rank_tier").desc())
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("is_flagged", "id", "k").rowsBetween(-6, -1)

exploded = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("k", "attr_value"),
    )
)

parsed = (
    exploded
    .filter(F.col("k") == "region")
    .select(
        "id",
        "status_code",
        "k",
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(4) != 0).cast("int").alias("is_flagged"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    parsed
    .filter(F.col("k").isin(["version", "trace"]))
    .withColumn("status_code_avg_6_prior", F.avg("status_code").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("status_code_high_bucket", F.ntile(10).over(Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("status_code_high", "id", "k")))
    .withColumn("status_code_high_rank", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy(F.col("status_code_high").desc_nulls_last())))
)

deduped = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy(F.col("status_code_high_rank").desc(), "id", "k")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .drop("rank_in_group")
)

result = (
    deduped
    .groupBy("k")
    .agg(
        F.size(F.collect_set("k")).alias("num_ks"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("k") == "region", F.col("status_code_high_bucket")).otherwise(0)).alias("region_status_code_high_bucket"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("k")).alias("k_list"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("k").desc())
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("start_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-06-20")))
    .withColumn("end_date_month_end", F.last_day("end_date"))
    .withColumn("months_since_start_date", (F.datediff(F.current_date(), "start_date") / 30))
)

metrics = (
    base
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("end_date_month_end", "id")))
    .withColumn("months_since_start_date_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "status").orderBy(F.col("months_since_start_date").asc_nulls_first())))
)

deduped = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("status", "plan").orderBy(F.col("start_date").asc_nulls_first(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

with_window = (
    deduped
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("sub"), (F.col("a.customer_id") == F.col("sub.customer_id")) & (F.col("a.start_date") >= F.col("sub.start_date")) & (F.col("a.start_date") <= F.date_add(F.col("sub.end_date"), 10)), "left")
    .select(
        "a.*",
        F.col("sub.id").alias("subscription_id"),
        F.col("sub.plan").alias("subscription_plan"),
        F.col("sub.monthly_fee").alias("subscription_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

totals = (
    with_window
    .withColumn("months_since_start_date_cume_dist_tier", F.when(F.col("months_since_start_date_cume_dist") >= 0.83, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .withColumn("seq_no_tier", F.when(F.col("seq_no") >= 8, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .rollup("months_since_start_date_cume_dist_tier", "seq_no_tier", "customer_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("subscription_plan")).alias("subscription_plan_list"),
        F.grouping("months_since_start_date_cume_dist_tier").alias("grouping_level"),
    )
)

result = (
    totals
    .select(
        "months_since_start_date_cume_dist_tier",
        "seq_no_tier",
        "customer_id",
        "row_count",
        "subscription_plan_list",
        "grouping_level",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("seq_no_tier").desc())
)
```

```python
    cleaned
    .withColumn("full_name_length_bucket", F.ntile(3).over(Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy(F.col("full_name_length").desc(), "id")))
    .withColumn("full_name_length_avg_6", F.avg("full_name_length").over(Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy("hire_date", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)))

    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.level") == F.col("k.level")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
```

```python
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("promotion_promo_code", "promo_code").orderBy(F.col("promo_id").asc_nulls_first())).alias("promo_id_dense_rank"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "method",
        "amount",
        "status",
        F.col("amount").cast("int").alias("amount_int"),
        F.date_format("paid_at", "MMM yyyy").alias("paid_at_label"),
        F.coalesce("method", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("method_clean"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    base
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("b"), F.col("src.order_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "src.id",
        "src.order_id",
        "src.method",
        "src.amount",
        "src.paid_at_label",
        "src.method_clean",
        F.col("b.order_date"),
        F.col("b.amount").alias("order_amount"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("order_date").desc_nulls_first(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

metrics = (
    deduped
    .filter(F.col("method") != "cash")
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "method",
        "amount",
        "paid_at_label",
        "method_clean",
        "latest_rank",
        F.ntile(4).over(Window.partitionBy("method", "order_id").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc(), "id")).alias("amount_bucket"),
        F.lead("order_amount", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("order_amount", "id")).alias("next_order_amount"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "paid_at_label",
        "method_clean",
        "latest_rank",
        "amount_bucket",
        "next_order_amount",
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("next_order_amount").asc_nulls_first())).alias("next_order_amount_cume_dist"),
        F.sum("amount_bucket").over(Window.orderBy("amount_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_amount_bucket"),
        F.stddev_samp("next_order_amount").over(Window.partitionBy("method")).alias("method_stddev_samp_next_order_amount"),
        F.round((F.col("amount") / F.sum("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("method"))), 4).alias("amount_share"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("next_order_amount_cume_dist").between(0.41, 0.64))
    .select(
        "id",
        "paid_at_label",
        "latest_rank",
        "amount_bucket",
        "next_order_amount",
        "next_order_amount_cume_dist",
        "running_amount_bucket",
        "method_stddev_samp_next_order_amount",
        (F.col("next_order_amount_cume_dist") - F.col("next_order_amount")).alias("next_order_amount_cume_dist_minus_next_order_amount"),
        F.when(F.col("running_amount_bucket") >= 40, "High").when(F.col("running_amount_bucket") >= 16, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("running_amount_bucket_band"),
    )
)

enriched_payments = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "id",
        "paid_at_label",
        "latest_rank",
        "next_order_amount",
        "method_stddev_samp_next_order_amount",
        "next_order_amount_cume_dist_minus_next_order_amount",
        F.lag("next_order_amount_cume_dist_minus_next_order_amount").over(Window.orderBy("next_order_amount_cume_dist", "id")).alias("prev_next_order_amount_cume_dist_minus_next_order_amount"),
        F.lead("amount_bucket").over(Window.orderBy("next_order_amount_cume_dist", "id")).alias("next_amount_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy("next_order_amount_cume_dist", "id")).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched_payments
    .select(
        "id",
        "paid_at_label",
        "next_order_amount",
        "method_stddev_samp_next_order_amount",
        "next_amount_bucket",
        "seq_no",
    )
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.partitionBy("device_code")
w_running = Window.orderBy(F.col("status_bits").desc())

base = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("reading_ts") >= F.lit("2025-09-01 02:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .withColumn("status_bits_num", F.col("status_bits").cast("string"))
)

filtered = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("pressure") < 994)
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "temp_c",
        "humidity",
        "pressure",
        "status_bits",
        "firmware",
        F.substring("firmware", 1, 4).alias("firmware_prefix"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    filtered
    .select("device_code")
    .intersectAll(
        df_device_readings
        .filter(F.col("device_code").isin("DV-04", "DV-02"))
        .select("device_code")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    filtered
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.device_code") == F.col("k.device_code")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

enriched = (
    kept_rows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("temp_c").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code")).alias("device_code_max_temp_c"),
        F.max("pressure").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("week", "reading_ts"), "device_code")).alias("reading_ts_period_max_pressure"),
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("temp_c").desc())).alias("temp_c_percent_rank"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("temp_c") <= 25)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count("temp_c_percent_rank").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("WEEK", "reading_ts"))).alias("reading_ts_period_count_temp_c_percent_rank"),
        F.count("status_bits").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7200, Window.currentRow)).alias("status_bits_count_2h"),
        F.sum("pressure").over(w_part).alias("device_code_sum_pressure"),
        F.count("reading_ts_period_max_pressure").over(w_part).alias("device_code_count_reading_ts_period_max_pressure"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w_running).alias("status_bits_cume_dist"),
    )
)

base_device_readings = (
    metrics
    .filter((F.col("reading_ts") > F.lit("2025-09-01").cast("date")) & (F.col("device_code_count_reading_ts_period_max_pressure").between(8, 15)))
    .withColumn("years_since_reading_ts", (F.datediff(F.current_date(), "reading_ts") / 365.25))
)

result = (
    base_device_readings
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("hour", "reading_ts").alias("hour_window"))
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("device_code") == "DV-03", F.col("humidity")).otherwise(0)).alias("dv_03_humidity"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.countDistinct("firmware").alias("distinct_firmwares"),
    )
)
```

```python
)

with_gaps = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.lag("started_at").over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("started_at", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("started_at") > F.lag("started_at").over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("started_at", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = (
    with_gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        "seq_no",
        F.sum("session_start_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("session_id"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    sessionized
    .select("customer_id", "id")
    .intersect(
        df_sessions
        .filter(F.to_date("started_at") >= "2025-03-01")
        .select("customer_id", "id")
    )
)

verified = (
    sessionized
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("k.customer_id")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    verified
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_customers.alias("dim"), F.col("e.customer_id") == F.col("dim.id"), "inner")
    .groupBy(F.col("dim.segment").alias("segment"), F.col("e.country").alias("session_country"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.sum(F.col("e.seq_no")).alias("total_seq_no"),

)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("running_count_duration_sec", "id")

with_prev = df_web_events.withColumn("prev_event_time", F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id")))

with_gaps = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_event_time").isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.col("prev_event_time") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = (
    with_gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "event_time",
        "duration_sec",
        F.sum("new_group_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("burst_id"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    sessionized
    .filter(F.col("burst_id") < 6)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_avg_duration_sec"),
        F.sum("duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_sum_duration_sec"),
        F.count("duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count_duration_sec"),
        F.max("duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_max_duration_sec"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").desc(), "id")).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

flagged = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = flagged.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

with_windows = (
    islands
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "event_time",
        "duration_sec",
        "running_count_duration_sec",
        "running_max_duration_sec",
        "seq_no",
        F.lag("island_id", 2, 0).over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("is_new_burst", "id")).alias("prev_island_id"),
        F.row_number().over(w_grp).alias("event_seq"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy(F.col("running_max_duration_sec").desc_nulls_last())).alias("running_max_duration_sec_dense_rank"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy(F.col("running_count_duration_sec").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .drop("rn")
)

flagged_2 = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.col("event_time") - F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id")) > F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_web_events = (
    flagged_2
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "event_time",
        "running_max_duration_sec",
        "prev_island_id",
        "running_max_duration_sec_dense_rank",
        F.sum("new_group_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("burst_id"),
    )
)

joined = (
    sessions_web_events
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("d"), F.col("s.session_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", F.col("d.device"), F.col("d.country"), F.col("d.browser"))
)

result = (
    joined
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("WEEK", "event_time").alias("week_start"),
        "browser",
    )
    .agg(
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("browser")).alias("browser_list"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("device") == "desktop", 1)).alias("desktop_count"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("device")).alias("num_devices"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("browser").desc())
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

filtered = (
    df_inventory
    .filter((F.col("last_restock") >= F.lit("2023-03-17").cast("date")) & (F.col("product_id").isin([4, 5, 9])))
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "quantity",
        "last_restock",
        F.round("quantity", 1).alias("quantity_rounded"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("last_restock") < "2024-02-05")
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        F.sum("quantity_rounded").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("last_restock", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_sum_quantity_rounded"),
        F.count("quantity_rounded").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("last_restock", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count_quantity_rounded"),
        F.max("quantity_rounded").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("last_restock", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_max_quantity_rounded"),
        F.avg("quantity_rounded").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("last_restock", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_avg_quantity_rounded"),
        F.ntile(3).over(Window.partitionBy("store_id", "product_id").orderBy(F.col("quantity_rounded").desc(), "id")).alias("quantity_rounded_bucket"),
    )
)

remaining_keys = (
    metrics
    .select("product_id")
    .intersect(
        df_inventory
        .filter(F.col("product_id").isin([2, 3, 8, 10]))
        .select("product_id")
    )
)

verified = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.product_id") == F.col("k.product_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

base = (
    verified
    .filter(F.col("running_sum_quantity_rounded") < 300)
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "running_sum_quantity_rounded",
        "running_count_quantity_rounded",
        "running_max_quantity_rounded",
        "running_avg_quantity_rounded",
        "quantity_rounded_bucket",
        F.col("running_avg_quantity_rounded").cast("int").alias("running_avg_quantity_rounded_int"),
    )
)

result = (
    base
    .cube(
        F.when(F.col("running_count_quantity_rounded") >= 16, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("running_count_quantity_rounded_tier"),
        "store_id",
    )
    .agg(
        F.min("running_count_quantity_rounded").alias("min_running_count_quantity_rounded"),
        F.round(F.avg("running_count_quantity_rounded"), 2).alias("avg_running_count_quantity_rounded"),
        F.percentile_approx("running_sum_quantity_rounded", 0.95).alias("running_sum_quantity_rounded_p95"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("running_sum_quantity_rounded_p95") >= 0)
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid = (
    df_payments
    .filter((F.col("order_id").isNotNull()) & (~F.col("method").eqNullSafe(F.lit("paypal"))))
    .select(
        "id",
        "method",
        "amount",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        F.substring("status", 1, 3).alias("status_prefix"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    valid
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("method", "status").orderBy(F.col("paid_at").desc_nulls_first(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .drop("rank_in_group")
)

deduped = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .drop("dedup_rank")
)

gaps = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("paid_at") - F.lag("paid_at").over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("paid_at", "id")) > F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = (
    gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "amount",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        F.sum("session_start_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("island_id"),
    )
)

result = (
    sessionized
    .select("id", "status", "island_id")
    .orderBy(F.col("status").desc_nulls_last())
)
```

```python
        "shipped_date",
        "delivered_date",
        "cost",
        "status",
        "carrier_filled",
        "carrier_filled_2",
        F.last("cost", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("is_ups", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_cost"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("status", "order_id").orderBy(F.col("is_ups").desc_nulls_last())).alias("is_ups_dense_rank"),
        F.lead("is_ups", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("cost", "id")).alias("next_is_ups"),
        F.avg("cost").over(Window.orderBy("is_ups", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)).alias("cost_avg_2_prior"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    enriched
    .select("status", "id")
    .subtract(
        df_shipments
        .filter(F.month("delivered_date").isin([1, 10, 11]))
        .select("status", "id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.status") == F.col("k.status")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

matched_keys = (
    reconciled
    .select("id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_shipments
        .filter(F.col("delivered_date").between("2024-05-20", "2025-05-11"))
        .select("id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    reconciled
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

valid = (
    kept_rows
    .filter(F.col("shipped_date") > "2024-05-01")
    .select(
        "id",
        "shipped_date",
        "delivered_date",
        "cost",
        "status",
        "carrier_filled",
        "carrier_filled_2",
        "last_known_cost",
        "is_ups_dense_rank",
        "next_is_ups",
        (F.col("cost") - F.col("cost_avg_2_prior")).alias("cost_minus_cost_avg_2_prior"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    valid
    .withColumn("next_is_ups_rank", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("next_is_ups").desc_nulls_first())))
    .withColumn("cost_minus_cost_avg_2_prior_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("cost_minus_cost_avg_2_prior").desc_nulls_last())))
)

with_windows_shipments = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "shipped_date",
        "delivered_date",
        "status",
        "carrier_filled",
        "carrier_filled_2",
        "last_known_cost",
        "is_ups_dense_rank",
        "cost_minus_cost_avg_2_prior",
        "cost_minus_cost_avg_2_prior_cume_dist",
        F.max("next_is_ups_rank").over(Window.partitionBy("status")).alias("status_max_next_is_ups_rank"),
        F.max("is_ups_dense_rank").over(Window.partitionBy("status")).alias("status_max_is_ups_dense_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows_shipments
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("status_max_next_is_ups_rank") >= 7, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("status_max_next_is_ups_rank_tier"),
        "status",
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("status_max_is_ups_dense_rank", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("status_max_is_ups_dense_rank_quartiles"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("status")).alias("num_status"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("status")).alias("status_list"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("num_status") > 1)
    .withColumn("num_status_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("status_max_next_is_ups_rank_tier").orderBy(F.col("num_status").desc())))
    .orderBy(F.col("num_status").desc_nulls_last())
)
```

```python
    .alias("s")

        "s.country_avg_product_cost",

    )
)

totals = (

    .groupBy(
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

cleaned = (
    df_store_sales
    .filter((F.col("sale_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-04-24"))) & (F.col("units") >= 17))
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "sale_date",
        "units",
        F.date_add("sale_date", 64).alias("sale_date_plus_64d"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("units").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("sale_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_max_units"),
        F.min("units").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("sale_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_min_units"),
        F.sum("units").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("sale_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_sum_units"),
        F.count("units").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("sale_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count_units"),
        F.ntile(10).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("units").desc(), "id")).alias("units_bucket"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("running_sum_units").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

enriched = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(10).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("running_max_units").desc(), "id")).alias("running_max_units_bucket"),
        F.round((F.col("running_sum_units") / F.sum("running_sum_units").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "sale_date"), "product_id"))), 4).alias("running_sum_units_share"),
    )
)

enriched_store_sales = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("running_sum_units").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("running_sum_units_share", "id")).alias("next_running_sum_units"),
        F.lead("units_bucket").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("running_sum_units_share", "id")).alias("next_units_bucket"),
        F.lag("units_bucket").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("running_sum_units_share", "id")).alias("prev_units_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("running_sum_units_share", "id")).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched_store_sales
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "sale_date",
        "units",
        "sale_date_plus_64d",
        "running_min_units",
        "running_count_units",
        "units_bucket",
        "row_num",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("running_count_units").desc())
)
```

```python
    .withColumn("location_length", F.length("location"))
    .withColumn("location_group", F.when(F.col("location").isin(["Berlin", "New York"]), "Tier 1").otherwise("Other"))
)

    base
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("location").orderBy(F.col("budget").asc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

metrics = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("location_length").desc(), "id")))
    .withColumn("budget_bucket", F.ntile(5).over(Window.partitionBy("dept_name", "location").orderBy("budget", "id")))
    .withColumn("budget_share", F.round((F.col("budget") / F.sum("budget").over(Window.partitionBy("dept_name"))), 4))
    .withColumn("next_budget", F.lead("budget", 1).over(Window.orderBy("budget", "id")))
    .withColumn("budget_rank", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("location").orderBy(F.col("budget").desc_nulls_last())))
)

cleaned = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("location").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("event_seq_minus_budget_bucket", (F.col("event_seq") - F.col("budget_bucket")))
    .withColumn("budget_bucket_minus_dedup_rank", (F.col("budget_bucket") - F.col("dedup_rank")))
)

    cleaned
    .withColumn("budget_rank_tier", F.when(F.col("budget_rank") >= 8, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["budget_rank_tier", "location"], ["budget_rank_tier"], []],
        "budget_rank_tier",
        "location",
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("budget_rank") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("location") == "Tokyo", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("budget_rank_per_tokyo"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("location") == "Chiang Mai", 1)).alias("chiang_mai_count"),
        F.count_if(F.col("dept_name") == "Marketing").alias("marketing_events"),
        F.grouping("budget_rank_tier").alias("grouping_level"),
    )
)

result = (
```

```python
    .filter((F.col("started_at") > F.lit("2023-09-24").cast("date")) & F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "device",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        F.date_format("started_at", "yyyy-MM").alias("started_at_label"),
        F.coalesce("browser", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("resolved_browser"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    base
    .select(
        "*",
        F.first("country", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("week", "started_at"), "device").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_country"),
        F.last("country", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_country"),
        F.first("country", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_country_2"),
    )
)

kept = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.session_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.event_time") < "2025-03-01"), "left_anti")
)

enriched = (
    kept
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_customers.alias("d"), F.col("e.customer_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("d.id")), "inner")
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.customer_id",
        "e.device",
        "e.started_at",
        "e.country",
        "e.started_at_label",
        "e.resolved_browser",
        "e.first_known_country_2",
        F.col("d.country").alias("customer_country"),
    )
)

with_window = (
    enriched
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("sub"), (F.col("src.customer_id") == F.col("sub.customer_id")) & (F.col("src.started_at") >= F.col("sub.start_date")) & (F.col("src.started_at") <= F.date_add(F.col("sub.end_date"), 10)), "inner")
    .select(
        "src.*",
        F.col("sub.id").alias("subscription_id"),
        F.col("sub.plan"),
        F.col("sub.monthly_fee"),
    )
)

not_flagged = (
    with_window
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.session_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (~F.col("ch.event_type").isin("search", "click")), "left_semi")
)

result = (
    not_flagged
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "started_at",
        "started_at_label",
        "first_known_country_2",
        "subscription_id",
        "plan",
        "monthly_fee",
    )
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("discount_pct", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("channel")

scored = (
    df_promotions
    .withColumn("cumulative_discount_pct", F.sum("discount_pct").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("prev_discount_pct", F.lag("discount_pct", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("channel", "promo_code").orderBy("discount_pct", "id")))
    .withColumn("channel_avg_discount_pct", F.avg("discount_pct").over(w_hist))
)

result = (
    scored
    .groupBy("promo_code")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("discount_pct"), 2).alias("avg_discount_pct"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("channel")).alias("channel_list"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("promo_code") == "VIP", F.col("cumulative_discount_pct")).otherwise(0)).alias("vip_cumulative_discount_pct"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("promo_code") == "SPRING10", 1)).alias("spring10_rows"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("promo_code")).alias("promo_code_list"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("avg_discount_pct") >= 0)
    .orderBy(F.col("spring10_rows").desc_nulls_first())
)
```

```python
    .select(
```

```python
        F.sum("temp_c").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-3600, Window.currentRow)).alias("temp_c_sum_1h"),
        F.lag("humidity", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("pressure", "id")).alias("prev_humidity"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("reading_ts") >= F.lit("2025-09-01 08:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.coalesce("humidity", F.lit(0)).alias("humidity_filled"),
        (F.col("running_pressure") / F.nullif("status_bits_max_15m", F.lit(0))).alias("running_pressure_per_status_bits_max_15m"),
    )

scored = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("humidity").between(54, 75))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("prev_humidity").over(Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("reading_ts")).orderBy("status_bits", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)).alias("prev_humidity_avg_3_prior"),
        F.avg("status_bits_max_15m").over(Window.orderBy("humidity_filled", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("status_bits_max_15m_avg_3"),
        F.sum("prev_humidity").over(Window.orderBy("temp_c_sum_1h", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_prev_humidity"),
        F.avg("status_bits").over(Window.orderBy("status_bits_max_15m", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)).alias("status_bits_avg_6_prior"),
        F.ntile(5).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("temp_c_sum_1h").desc(), "id")).alias("temp_c_sum_1h_bucket"),
    )
)

        "next_temp_c",

        "status_bits_max_15m_avg_3",

        "temp_c_sum_1h",

        "status_bits_avg_6_prior",
        "running_pressure_per_status_bits_max_15m_filled",
        "status_bits_max_15m_times_temp_c_sum_1h",

        "humidity",
        "running_pressure",
        "next_temp_c",
        "running_prev_humidity",
        "status_bits_avg_6_prior",
        "next_temp_c_times_running_pressure",
        "event_seq",
        "humidity_rank",
    )
    .orderBy("running_prev_humidity")
```

```python
    .filter(F.col("quantity").between(102, 174))
    .withColumn("last_restock_plus_months", F.add_months("last_restock", 6))
)

enriched = (
    base
    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("quantity").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id")).alias("product_id_max_quantity"),
        F.avg("quantity").over(Window.partitionBy("store_id", "product_id").orderBy("quantity", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)).alias("quantity_avg_3_prior"),
        F.ntile(5).over(Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("quantity", "id")).alias("quantity_bucket"),
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("last_restock_plus_months")).orderBy(F.col("quantity").asc_nulls_last())).alias("quantity_percent_rank"),
    )
)

enriched_inventory = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "last_restock_plus_months",
        "quantity_bucket",
        F.sum("quantity_avg_3_prior").over(w_ordered).alias("last4_sum_quantity_avg_3_prior"),
        F.count("quantity_avg_3_prior").over(w_ordered).alias("last4_count_quantity_avg_3_prior"),
        F.avg("quantity_avg_3_prior").over(w_ordered).alias("last4_avg_quantity_avg_3_prior"),
        F.min("quantity_avg_3_prior").over(w_ordered).alias("last4_min_quantity_avg_3_prior"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    enriched_inventory
    .filter(F.col("quantity_bucket") >= 6)
    .withColumn("last4_min_quantity_avg_3_prior_rounded", F.round("last4_min_quantity_avg_3_prior", 2))
)

totals = (
    cleaned
    .cube(
        F.when(F.col("last4_avg_quantity_avg_3_prior") >= 208, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("last4_avg_quantity_avg_3_prior_tier"),
        F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "last_restock_plus_months").alias("quarter_start"),
        F.when(F.col("last4_min_quantity_avg_3_prior_rounded") >= 89, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("last4_min_quantity_avg_3_prior_rounded_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("last4_count_quantity_avg_3_prior", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("last4_count_quantity_avg_3_prior_quartiles"),
        F.percentile_approx("last4_min_quantity_avg_3_prior_rounded", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("last4_min_quantity_avg_3_prior_rounded_quartiles"),
        F.percentile_approx("last4_avg_quantity_avg_3_prior", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("last4_avg_quantity_avg_3_prior_quartiles"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("grouping_level"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("shipping_fee", "id")
w_running = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("order_date", "id")
w_part = Window.orderBy("next_order_id_max_status_length", "id")

valid = (
    df_shipments
    .filter((F.col("delivered_date") >= F.lit("2023-07-15").cast("date")) & (F.col("status").isin("LOST", "IN_TRANSIT", "DELIVERED")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "shipped_date",
        "cost",
        "status",
        F.length("status").alias("status_length"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    valid
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_orders.alias("d"), F.col("s.order_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("d.id")), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.order_id",
        "s.status_length",
        F.col("d.channel"),
        F.col("d.order_date"),
        F.col("d.shipping_fee"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "order_date",
        "shipping_fee",
        F.avg("shipping_fee").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "order_date"), "order_id").orderBy("status_length", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)).alias("shipping_fee_avg_3_prior"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("order_date", "id")).alias("seq_no"),
        F.max("status_length").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id")).alias("order_id_max_status_length"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_date",
        "shipping_fee_avg_3_prior",
        F.row_number().over(w_ordered).alias("event_seq"),
        F.lead("order_id_max_status_length", 2).over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "order_date"), "order_id").orderBy("shipping_fee", "id")).alias("next_order_id_max_status_length"),
        F.lead("order_id_max_status_length", 2).over(w_running).alias("next_order_id_max_status_length_2"),
    )
)

with_windows_shipments = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("shipping_fee_avg_3_prior").over(w_part).alias("next_shipping_fee_avg_3_prior"),
        F.lag("shipping_fee_avg_3_prior").over(w_part).alias("prev_shipping_fee_avg_3_prior"),
        F.lag("event_seq").over(w_part).alias("prev_event_seq"),
        F.lead("event_seq").over(w_part).alias("next_event_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(w_part).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows_shipments
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_date",
        "shipping_fee_avg_3_prior",
        "event_seq",
        "next_order_id_max_status_length",
        "next_order_id_max_status_length_2",
        "next_shipping_fee_avg_3_prior",
        "prev_shipping_fee_avg_3_prior",
        "prev_event_seq",
    )
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_hist = Window.partitionBy("attr_key", "service").orderBy(F.col("is_flagged").desc())

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("attr_key", "v"),
    )
)

parsed = (
    lines
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "status_code",
        "attr_key",
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(4) != 0).cast("int").alias("is_flagged"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    parsed
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("service", "attr_key").orderBy(F.col("is_flagged").desc_nulls_first(), "id", "attr_key")))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

ranked = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("rn_2", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy(F.col("rn").desc(), "id", "attr_key")))
    .filter(F.col("rn_2") == 1)
)

metrics = (
    ranked
    .select(
        "id",
        "status_code",
        "attr_key",
        "status_code_high",
        "rn",
        "rn_2",
        F.cume_dist().over(w_hist).alias("is_flagged_cume_dist"),
        F.first("attr_key", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("WEEK", "log_ts"), "level").orderBy("is_flagged", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_attr_key"),
        F.lead("status_code_high", 1, 0).over(Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy("rn", "id", "attr_key")).alias("next_status_code_high"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    metrics
    .filter(~F.col("attr_key").eqNullSafe(F.lit("version")))
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("status_code_high") + F.col("next_status_code_high")).alias("status_code_high_plus_next_status_code_high"),
        F.coalesce("attr_key", F.lit("N/A")).alias("attr_key_clean"),
    )
)

result = (
    filtered
    .groupBy("attr_key")
    .agg(
        F.min("status_code_high_plus_next_status_code_high").alias("min_status_code_high_plus_next_status_code_high"),
        F.count_if(F.col("attr_key") == "version").alias("version_events"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("attr_key") == "version", F.col("is_flagged_cume_dist"))).alias("version_max_is_flagged_cume_dist"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("version_max_is_flagged_cume_dist").desc_nulls_first())
)
```

```python
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.orderBy("val")
w_recent = Window.orderBy(F.col("val").desc())
w_recent_2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("val").asc_nulls_first())

    .select("id")
    .subtract(

        .filter(F.col("plan").isin(["basic", "pro", "enterprise"]))
        .select("id")
    )
)

    flattened
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

base = (
    kept_rows
    .filter(F.col("effective_from") >= F.lit("2024-06-02").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("effective_from_plus_65d", F.date_add("effective_from", 65))
)

enriched = (

    .select(
        "id",
        "effective_from",
        F.dense_rank().over(w_part).alias("val_dense_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w_recent).alias("val_cume_dist"),
        F.rank().over(w_recent_2).alias("val_rank"),

        F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("val").desc_nulls_last())).alias("val_dense_rank_3"),
    )

result = (

    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("val_dense_rank_2") >= 7, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("val_dense_rank_2_tier"),
        F.date_trunc("year", "effective_from").alias("year_start"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

cleaned = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("reading_ts") > F.lit("2025-09-01").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("device_code_firmware", F.concat("device_code", F.lit(" "), "firmware"))
)

ranked = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .drop("rank_in_group")
)

base = (
    ranked
    .filter(~F.col("device_code").isin(["DV-03", "DV-02", "DV-01"]))
    .withColumn("pressure_plus_status_bits", (F.col("pressure") + F.col("status_bits")))
    .withColumn("pressure_plus_humidity", (F.col("pressure") + F.col("humidity")))
)

with_gaps = (
    base
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("reading_ts") - F.lag("reading_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")) > F.expr("INTERVAL 20 MINUTES"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = with_gaps.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

remaining_keys = (
    sessionized
    .select("device_code", "id")
    .intersectAll(
        df_device_readings
        .filter(~F.col("firmware").isin(["1.1.0", "2.0.1"]))
        .select("device_code", "id")
    )
)

verified = (
    sessionized
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.device_code") == F.col("k.device_code")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

enriched = (
    verified
    .filter(F.col("humidity") > 65)
    .select(
        "id",
        "humidity",
        "pressure",
        "device_code_firmware",
        "pressure_plus_humidity",
        "session_start_flag",
        "island_id",
        F.round((F.col("humidity") / F.sum("humidity").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "reading_ts")))), 4).alias("humidity_share"),
        F.min("temp_c").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code")).alias("device_code_min_temp_c"),
        F.max("humidity").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-3600, Window.currentRow)).alias("humidity_max_1h"),
    )
)

valid = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("session_start_flag") == 0)
    .withColumn("pressure_plus_humidity_max_1h", (F.col("pressure") + F.col("humidity_max_1h")))
)

result = (
    valid
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code_firmware",
        "pressure_plus_humidity",
        "humidity_share",
        "device_code_min_temp_c",
        "humidity_max_1h",
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("pressure_plus_humidity_max_1h").asc_nulls_last())).alias("pressure_plus_humidity_max_1h_percent_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("device_code_min_temp_c").desc_nulls_first())).alias("device_code_min_temp_c_dense_rank"),
        F.rank().over(Window.orderBy("pressure")).alias("pressure_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("humidity_share").desc_nulls_first())).alias("humidity_share_cume_dist"),
    )
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("sale_date_plus_months", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

        "store_id",

        "sale_date",
        "sale_date_plus_months",

        F.sum("revenue").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("WEEK", "sale_date_plus_months"), "product_id").orderBy("sale_date_plus_months", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_revenue"),
        F.sum("revenue").over(w_recent).alias("running_revenue_2"),
        F.sum("revenue").over(Window.orderBy("sale_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_revenue_3"),
    )

    .select(

        "product_id",

        "units_whole",
        "running_revenue",
        "running_revenue_3",

    )

with_dims = (

        F.col("d.product_name"),

)

metrics_store_sales = (
    with_dims
    .select(
        "*",
        F.min("running_revenue").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("running_revenue_2_times_units_whole", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_min_running_revenue"),
        F.count("running_revenue").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("running_revenue_2_times_units_whole", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count_running_revenue"),
        F.max("running_revenue").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("running_revenue_2_times_units_whole", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_max_running_revenue"),
        F.avg("running_revenue").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("running_revenue_2_times_units_whole", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_avg_running_revenue"),
        F.max("running_revenue_2_times_units_whole").over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("sale_date"))).alias("sale_date_year_max_running_revenue_2_times_units_whole"),
    )
)
```
