```python
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("e.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("p.product_name").like("Lap%"))
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.product_id",
        "e.prev_revenue",
        F.col("p.launch_date"),
        F.col("p.price"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "prev_revenue",
        "launch_date",
        "price",
        F.sum("prev_revenue").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("prev_revenue", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_prev_revenue"),
        F.sum("prev_revenue").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("price", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_prev_revenue"),
        F.lead("price", 2).over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("launch_date"), "product_id").orderBy("prev_revenue", "id")).alias("next_price"),
        F.last("price", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("price", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_price"),
        F.ntile(4).over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("price", "id")).alias("price_bucket"),
    )
)

joined = (
    with_windows
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("e.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.product_id",
        "e.price",
        "e.cumulative_prev_revenue",
        "e.last_known_price",
        "e.price_bucket",
        F.col("p.category"),
        F.col("p.stock_qty"),
        F.col("p.launch_date").alias("product_launch_date"),
    )
)

metrics_store_sales = (
    joined
    .select(
        "*",
        F.dense_rank().over(w_hist).alias("price_dense_rank"),
        F.sum("last_known_price").over(w_running).alias("running_last_known_price"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w_running_2).alias("stock_qty_cume_dist"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics_store_sales
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("stock_qty_cume_dist").over(Window.orderBy("last_known_price", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_stock_qty_cume_dist"),
        F.avg("stock_qty").over(w_running).alias("stock_qty_avg_5_prior"),
        F.round((F.col("running_last_known_price") / F.sum("running_last_known_price").over(Window.partitionBy("category"))), 4).alias("running_last_known_price_share"),
    )
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

kept_keys = (
    df_payments
    .select("method", "order_id")
    .subtract(
        df_payments
        .filter(F.col("status") == "SUCCESS")
        .select("method", "order_id")
    )
)

verified = (
    df_payments
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.method") == F.col("k.method")) & (F.col("s.order_id") == F.col("k.order_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

scored = (
    verified
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("paid_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7776000, Window.currentRow)).alias("amount_count_90d"),
        F.round((F.col("amount") / F.sum("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id"))), 4).alias("amount_share"),
    )
)

valid = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "method",
        "amount",
        "status",
        "amount_count_90d",
        "amount_share",
        F.length("method").alias("method_length"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("amount").between(420, 700))
    .select(
        "id",
        "method",
        "amount",
        "amount_count_90d",
        "amount_share",
        F.substring("status", 1, 2).alias("status_prefix"),
    )
)

scored_payments = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("amount_share") <= 0.29)
    .withColumn("method_stddev_samp_amount_count_90d", F.stddev_samp("amount_count_90d").over(Window.partitionBy("method")))
)

valid_payments = (
    scored_payments
    .filter(F.col("amount_count_90d") > 14)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("amount_share") >= 0.76, "High").when(F.col("amount_share") >= 0.35, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("amount_share_level"),
        F.least("method_stddev_samp_amount_count_90d", "amount_share").alias("least_method_stddev_samp_amount_count_90d_amount_share"),
        F.coalesce("method", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("method_clean"),
    )
)

filtered_payments = (
    valid_payments
    .filter(F.col("method").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("least_method_stddev_samp_amount_count_90d_amount_share_scaled", F.round((F.col("least_method_stddev_samp_amount_count_90d_amount_share") * 1.15), 2))
)

result = (
    filtered_payments
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("amount_share") >= 0.83, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("amount_share_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("method") == "paypal", 1)).alias("paypal_rows"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("method") == "bank_transfer", F.col("method_stddev_samp_amount_count_90d")).otherwise(0)).alias("bank_transfer_method_stddev_samp_amount_count_90d"),
        F.percentile_approx("least_method_stddev_samp_amount_count_90d_amount_share_scaled", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("least_method_stddev_samp_amount_count_90d_amount_share_scaled_quartiles"),
    )
    .orderBy("paypal_rows")
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy("level", "host").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms").asc_nulls_last())
w_running = Window.orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-900, Window.currentRow)

exploded = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("attr_key", "attr_value"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    exploded
    .filter(F.col("status_code") <= 434)
    .withColumn("latency_ms_rank", F.rank().over(w_recent))
)

valid = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("attr_key").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.concat_ws("-", "host", "level").alias("host_level_key"),
        F.floor("status_code").alias("status_code_whole"),
        F.coalesce("attr_key", F.lit("NONE")).alias("attr_key_clean"),
    )
)

valid_app_logs = (
    valid
    .filter((~F.col("attr_key").eqNullSafe(F.lit("version"))) & F.col("attr_key").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("status_code_plus_status_code_whole", (F.col("status_code") + F.col("status_code_whole")))
    .withColumn("latency_ms_whole", F.floor("latency_ms"))
)

scored = (
    valid_app_logs
    .select(
        "*",
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy(F.col("status_code_plus_status_code_whole").asc_nulls_first())).alias("status_code_plus_status_code_whole_cume_dist"),
        F.corr("latency_ms", "status_code").over(Window.partitionBy("service", "host")).alias("corr_latency_ms_status_code"),
        F.max("status_code_whole").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-1800, Window.currentRow)).alias("status_code_whole_max_30m"),
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("status_code_whole").desc())).alias("status_code_whole_cume_dist"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "status_code",
        "attr_value",
        "latency_ms_rank",
        "host_level_key",
        "status_code_plus_status_code_whole",
        "latency_ms_whole",
        "status_code_plus_status_code_whole_cume_dist",
        "status_code_whole_max_30m",
        "status_code_whole_cume_dist",
        F.avg("status_code_whole_max_30m").over(w_running).alias("status_code_whole_max_30m_avg_15m"),
        F.max("latency_ms_whole").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("log_ts"), "host").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7200, Window.currentRow)).alias("latency_ms_whole_max_2h"),
    )
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_payments
    .filter((F.col("paid_at") > F.lit("2023-08-31 23:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "method",
        "amount",
        "status",
        F.when(F.col("method").isin(["card", "paypal"]), "Priority").otherwise("Other").alias("method_group"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    base
    .withColumn("prev_amount", F.lag("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("amount", "id")))
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("amount", "id")))
)

scored = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "method_group",
        "prev_amount",
        F.sum("prev_amount").over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("row_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_sum_prev_amount"),
        F.min("prev_amount").over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("row_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_min_prev_amount"),
        F.count("prev_amount").over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("row_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count_prev_amount"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy("row_seq", "id")).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

latest = (
    scored
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("running_sum_prev_amount").desc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "method_group",
        "prev_amount",
        "running_sum_prev_amount",
        "running_min_prev_amount",
        "running_count_prev_amount",
        "seq_no",
    )
)

cleaned = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("prev_amount").between(630, 1160))
    .select(
        "id",
        "running_sum_prev_amount",
        "running_min_prev_amount",
        "running_count_prev_amount",
        "seq_no",
        F.greatest(F.col("running_min_prev_amount"), F.col("prev_amount")).alias("greatest_running_min_prev_amount_prev_amount"),
    )
)

with_windows_payments = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("next_greatest_running_min_prev_amount_prev_amount", F.lead("greatest_running_min_prev_amount_prev_amount").over(Window.orderBy("seq_no", "id")))
    .withColumn("prev_seq_no", F.lag("seq_no").over(Window.orderBy("seq_no", "id")))
    .withColumn("next_seq_no", F.lead("seq_no").over(Window.orderBy("seq_no", "id")))
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy("seq_no", "id")))
)

result = (
    with_windows_payments
    .withColumn("running_sum_prev_amount_tier", F.when(F.col("running_sum_prev_amount") >= 7100, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["prev_seq_no", "running_sum_prev_amount_tier"], ["prev_seq_no"]],
        "prev_seq_no",
        "running_sum_prev_amount_tier",
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.percentile_approx("running_sum_prev_amount", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("running_sum_prev_amount_quartiles"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("distinct_ids") >= 1)
)
```

```python
        F.count("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("cost", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)).alias("last7_count_amount"),
        F.avg("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("cost", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)).alias("last7_avg_amount"),
        F.sum("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("cost", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)).alias("last7_sum_amount"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("cost").asc_nulls_first())).alias("cost_percent_rank"),
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("last7_count_amount").desc())).alias("last7_count_amount_percent_rank"),
        F.ntile(4).over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("cost").desc(), "id")).alias("cost_bucket"),
        F.min("last7_sum_amount").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("week", "shipped_date"), "order_id")).alias("shipped_date_period_min_last7_sum_amount"),
    )
)

enriched_shipments = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("last7_sum_amount").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("last7_min_amount", "id")).alias("next_last7_sum_amount"),
        F.lag("last7_sum_amount").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("last7_min_amount", "id")).alias("prev_last7_sum_amount"),
        F.lead("last7_avg_amount").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("last7_min_amount", "id")).alias("next_last7_avg_amount"),
        F.lag("last7_avg_amount").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("last7_min_amount", "id")).alias("prev_last7_avg_amount"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("last7_min_amount", "id")).alias("row_seq"),
        F.sum("shipped_date_period_min_last7_sum_amount").over(Window.orderBy("cost_percent_rank", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_shipped_date_period_min_last7_sum_amount"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched_shipments
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "cost",
        "last7_min_amount",
        "last7_count_amount",
        "last7_avg_amount",
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy(F.col("cost").desc(), "id")
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("shipped_date", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)

valid = (
    df_shipments
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "cost",
        "status",
        F.date_sub("shipped_date", 57).alias("shipped_date_minus_57d"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("carrier_filled"),
    )
)

valid_shipments = (
    valid
    .filter((~F.col("carrier").eqNullSafe(F.lit("Flash"))) & (F.col("shipped_date").between("2023-10-01", "2025-08-01")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "cost",
        "status",
        F.coalesce("cost", F.lit(0)).alias("cost_filled"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    valid_shipments
    .withColumn("cost_filled_rank", F.rank().over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("cost_bucket", F.ntile(4).over(w_grp))
)

latest = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("shipped_date").asc_nulls_first())))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "cost_filled",
        "cost_bucket",
    )
)

scored = (
    latest
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("cost_bucket").over(w_ordered).alias("last7_avg_cost_bucket"),
        F.sum("cost_bucket").over(w_ordered).alias("last7_sum_cost_bucket"),
        F.max("cost_bucket").over(w_ordered).alias("last7_max_cost_bucket"),
        F.min("cost_bucket").over(w_ordered).alias("last7_min_cost_bucket"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("last7_avg_cost_bucket") >= 6.6, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("last7_avg_cost_bucket_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("carrier") == "UPS", 1)).alias("ups_rows"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("carrier") == "Flash", F.col("last7_avg_cost_bucket"))).alias("flash_max_last7_avg_cost_bucket"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("carrier")).alias("num_carriers"),
        F.avg("last7_min_cost_bucket").alias("avg_last7_min_cost_bucket"),
        F.avg("cost_bucket").alias("avg_cost_bucket"),
    )
    .orderBy("avg_cost_bucket")
)
```

```python
        F.ntile(5).over(Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy(F.col("sqft").desc(), "id")).alias("sqft_bucket"),
    )
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("week", "txn_time"), "merchant").orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

cleaned = (
    df_transactions
    .filter(F.col("merchant").isNotNull() & (F.col("merchant").eqNullSafe(F.lit("7-Eleven"))))
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "amount",
        "txn_time",
        "merchant",
        "is_flagged",
        F.concat_ws("-", "txn_type", "merchant").alias("txn_type_merchant_key"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("amount") <= 1600)
    .withColumn("merchant_group", F.when(F.col("merchant").isin(["Lazada", "Amazon"]), "Core").otherwise("Other"))
)

metrics = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("txn_time", "id")).alias("seq_no"),
        F.last("amount", ignorenulls=True).over(w_part).alias("last_known_amount"),
        F.sum("amount").over(w_grp).alias("cumulative_amount"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("is_flagged"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "merchant",
        "is_flagged",
        "merchant_group",
        "seq_no",
        "last_known_amount",
        F.lead("last_known_amount").over(Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("amount", "id")).alias("next_last_known_amount"),
        F.lag("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("amount", "id")).alias("prev_amount"),
        F.lead("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("amount", "id")).alias("next_amount"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("amount", "id")).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

cleaned_transactions = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("merchant").isNotNull() & (F.col("last_known_amount") > 3800))
    .withColumn("next_amount_tier", F.when(F.col("next_amount") >= 4000, "High").when(F.col("next_amount") >= 1200, "Medium").otherwise("Low"))
    .withColumn("merchant_length", F.length("merchant"))
)

with_dims = (
    cleaned_transactions
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("b"), F.col("e.account_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.account_id",
        "e.seq_no",
        "e.last_known_amount",
        "e.next_last_known_amount",
        "e.next_amount",
        "e.event_seq",
        "e.next_amount_tier",
        "e.merchant_length",
        F.col("b.status"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_dims
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "last_known_amount",
        "next_last_known_amount",
        "next_amount",
        "merchant_length",
        "status",
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("next_amount").desc())).alias("next_amount_percent_rank"),
        F.sum("last_known_amount").over(Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_last_known_amount"),
    )
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("temp_c") >= 33)
    .select(
        "id",
        "temp_c",
        "status_bits",
        "firmware",
        F.coalesce("pressure", F.lit(0)).alias("pressure_filled"),
    )
)

valid_device_readings = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("pressure_filled").between(68, 69))
    .withColumn("status_bits_adjusted", F.round((F.col("status_bits") * 0.9), 2))
)

matched_keys = (
    valid_device_readings
    .select("firmware", "id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_device_readings
        .filter(F.col("status_bits") == 8)
        .select("firmware", "id")
    )
)

verified = (
    valid_device_readings
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.firmware") == F.col("k.firmware")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

valid_device_readings_2 = (
    verified
    .filter(F.col("status_bits").between(11, 12))
    .select(
        "temp_c",
        "status_bits",
        "firmware",
        "pressure_filled",
        "status_bits_adjusted",
        F.trim("firmware").alias("clean_firmware"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    valid_device_readings_2
    .withColumn("status_bits_adjusted_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("status_bits_adjusted").asc_nulls_last())))
)

result = (
    metrics
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("status_bits_adjusted") >= 75, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("status_bits_adjusted_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("pressure_filled") >= 70, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("pressure_filled_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("status_bits_adjusted_dense_rank") >= 9, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("status_bits_adjusted_dense_rank_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.bit_and("status_bits").alias("status_bits_bit_and"),
        F.round(F.avg("status_bits_adjusted_dense_rank"), 2).alias("avg_status_bits_adjusted_dense_rank"),
        F.sum("status_bits").alias("total_status_bits"),
        F.bit_and("status_bits").alias("status_bits_bit_and_2"),
        F.percentile_approx("status_bits_adjusted", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("status_bits_adjusted_quartiles"),
        F.avg("pressure_filled").alias("avg_pressure_filled"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("status_bits_adjusted_dense_rank_tier").desc())
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_ordered = Window.orderBy(F.col("price").desc())

    df_carts
    .withColumn("line", F.explode_outer("items"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "coupon_codes",

        F.col("line.price"),
    )

    exploded
    .filter(F.col("product_id") != 4)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("product_id").desc_nulls_first())).alias("product_id_rank"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w_ordered).alias("price_percent_rank"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("qty").between(3, 4))
    .withColumn("greatest_price_percent_rank_price", F.greatest("price_percent_rank", "price"))
)

valid = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.array_contains("coupon_codes", "SPRING10"))
    .withColumn("greatest_price_percent_rank_price_times_price_percent_rank", F.col("greatest_price_percent_rank_price") * F.col("price_percent_rank"))
    .withColumn("sorted_coupon_codes", F.sort_array("coupon_codes"))
)

result = (

    .select(
        "id",
        "coupon_codes",
        "product_id",
        "qty",
        "price",
        "product_id_rank",
        "price_percent_rank",
        "greatest_price_percent_rank_price_times_price_percent_rank",
        "sorted_coupon_codes",
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("greatest_price_percent_rank_price_times_price_percent_rank").desc_nulls_first())).alias("greatest_price_percent_rank_price_times_price_percent_rank_dense_rank"),
        F.rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("product_id_rank").desc_nulls_last())).alias("product_id_rank_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("product_id_rank").desc())).alias("product_id_rank_dense_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("greatest_price_percent_rank_price_times_price_percent_rank").desc_nulls_last())).alias("greatest_price_percent_rank_price_times_price_percent_rank_dense_rank_2"),
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("product_id_rank").desc_nulls_first())).alias("product_id_rank_percent_rank"),
    )
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_hist = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy("status_code", "id", "k")

exploded = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("k", "attr_value"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    exploded
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("host", "service").orderBy("status_code", "id", "k")))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

ranked = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("host", "service").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "k")))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

metrics = (
    ranked
    .filter(F.hour("log_ts").between(9, 13))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("status_code").over(w_hist).alias("prev_status_code"),
        F.lead("status_code").over(w_hist).alias("next_status_code"),
        F.row_number().over(w_hist).alias("event_seq"),
        F.count("status_code").over(Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7200, Window.currentRow)).alias("status_code_count_2h"),
    )
)

latest = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("host", "service").orderBy(F.col("prev_status_code").asc_nulls_first(), "id", "k")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

stats = (
    latest
    .groupBy("host")
    .agg(
        F.min("log_ts").alias("started_at"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("host")).alias("host_list"),
    )
)

result = (
    stats
    .select("host", "started_at", "host_list")
    .orderBy(F.col("started_at").desc())
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.partitionBy("method")

scored = (
    df_payments
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "paid_at",
        F.avg("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)).alias("amount_avg_6_prior"),
        F.avg("amount").over(w_part).alias("method_avg_amount"),
    )
)

with_prev = scored.withColumn("prev_paid_at", F.lag("paid_at").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("paid_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("prev_paid_at").isNull() | (F.col("paid_at") > F.col("prev_paid_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = flagged.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

cleaned = (
    islands
    .filter(F.col("paid_at") >= F.lit("2023-06-27").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("is_new_burst") + F.col("island_id")).alias("is_new_burst_plus_island_id"),
        (F.col("island_id") / F.nullif("is_new_burst", F.lit(0))).alias("island_id_per_is_new_burst"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "id",
        "amount_avg_6_prior",
        "method_avg_amount",
        "prev_paid_at",
        "is_new_burst",
        "is_new_burst_plus_island_id",
        "island_id_per_is_new_burst",
        F.first("amount_avg_6_prior", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("is_new_burst", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_amount_avg_6_prior"),
        F.lead("amount_avg_6_prior", 1).over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "prev_paid_at"), "order_id").orderBy("amount_avg_6_prior", "id")).alias("next_amount_avg_6_prior"),
        F.avg("island_id").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id")).alias("order_id_avg_island_id"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("paid_at"), "order_id").orderBy("island_id", "id")).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

cleaned_payments = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("is_new_burst") < 1)
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("next_amount_avg_6_prior") - F.col("is_new_burst_plus_island_id")).alias("next_amount_avg_6_prior_minus_is_new_burst_plus_island_id"),
    )
)

result = (
    cleaned_payments
    .select(
        "id",
        "is_new_burst_plus_island_id",
        "island_id_per_is_new_burst",
    )
    .unpivot(
        ids=["id"],
        values=["is_new_burst_plus_island_id", "island_id_per_is_new_burst"],
        variableColumnName="metric_name",
        valueColumnName="reading",
    )
    .filter(F.col("reading").isNotNull())
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_running = Window.partitionBy(F.year("last_restock"), "product_id").orderBy(F.col("quantity").asc_nulls_last())
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("quantity").desc_nulls_last())

deduped = (
    df_inventory
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("quantity").asc_nulls_first(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

enriched = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "quantity",
        "last_restock",
        "row_num",
        F.dense_rank().over(w_running).alias("quantity_dense_rank"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w_recent).alias("quantity_percent_rank"),
        F.ntile(10).over(Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("quantity").desc(), "id")).alias("quantity_bucket"),
    )
)

deduped_inventory = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("last_restock")))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

scored = (
    deduped_inventory
    .select(
        "*",
        F.first("quantity", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("product_id", "store_id").orderBy("quantity_percent_rank", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_quantity"),
        F.ntile(5).over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("last_restock"), "product_id").orderBy(F.col("quantity_dense_rank").desc(), "id")).alias("quantity_dense_rank_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy("quantity_bucket", "id")).alias("seq_no"),
        F.avg("quantity").over(Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("last_restock", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)).alias("quantity_avg_3_prior"),
    )
)

joined = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_stores.alias("p"), F.col("s.store_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.store_id",
        "s.quantity",
        "s.last_restock",
        "s.quantity_percent_rank",
        "s.quantity_bucket",
        "s.latest_rank",
        "s.first_known_quantity",
        "s.seq_no",
        "s.quantity_avg_3_prior",
        F.col("p.region"),
        F.col("p.store_name"),
    )
)

result = (

        "id",
        "last_restock",
        "quantity_percent_rank",
        "latest_rank",
        "first_known_quantity",
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_hist = Window.partitionBy("k", "host").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "k").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("k", "attr_value"),
    )
)

unpacked = (
    lines
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",
        "k",
        "attr_value",
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(2) != 0).cast("int").alias("flag_bit2"),
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    unpacked
    .filter(F.col("host").isin(["h4", "h1"]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("status_code_high").over(Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("status_code_high", "id", "k").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_status_code_high"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy(F.col("status_code_high").desc_nulls_last())).alias("status_code_high_dense_rank"),
        F.first("status_code_high", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy("log_ts", "id", "k").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_status_code_high"),
        F.sum("flag_bit2").over(w_hist).alias("running_flag_bit2"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("k").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("status_code_high") * F.col("running_flag_bit2")).alias("status_code_high_times_running_flag_bit2"),
        F.coalesce("k", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("k_filled"),
    )
)

flagged = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.lag("log_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("host").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "k")).isNull() | (F.col("log_ts") > F.lag("log_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("host").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "k")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 15 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = (
    flagged
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",
        "k",
        "attr_value",
        "status_code_high",
        "running_status_code_high",
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("k", "attr_value"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    flattened
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("status_code")))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

with_gaps = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.lag("log_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "k")).isNull() | (F.col("log_ts") > F.lag("log_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "k")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 1 HOUR")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = (
    with_gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        "k",
        "attr_value",
        F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "k").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("session_id"),
    )
)

ranked_app_logs = (
    islands
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("service", "k").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "k")))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

summary = (
    ranked_app_logs
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("HOUR", "log_ts").alias("hour_window"),
        F.when(F.col("status_code") >= 410, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("status_code_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("k") == "version", 1)).alias("version_rows"),
        F.bit_or("status_code").alias("status_code_bit_or"),
        F.round(F.avg("session_id"), 2).alias("avg_session_id"),
        F.percentile_approx("session_id", 0.95).alias("session_id_p95"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .select(
        "hour_window",
        "status_code_tier",
        "status_code_bit_or",
        "avg_session_id",
    )
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

latest_match = (
    df_sessions
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("c"), (F.col("c.session_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")

    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.event_type"))
)

gaps = (
    latest_match
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("started_at") - F.lag("started_at").over(Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("started_at", "id")) > F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = (
    gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "device",
        "browser",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        "event_type",
        F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("session_id"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    sessionized
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_customers.alias("d"), F.col("a.customer_id") == F.col("d.id"), "inner")
    .filter(~F.col("d.is_active"))
    .select(
        "a.id",
        "a.customer_id",
        "a.started_at",
        "a.country",
        F.col("d.segment"),
        F.col("d.signup_date"),
    )
)

gaps_2 = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.lag("started_at").over(Window.partitionBy("segment").orderBy("started_at", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("started_at") > F.lag("started_at").over(Window.partitionBy("segment").orderBy("started_at", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_sessions = (
    gaps_2
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        "segment",
        "signup_date",
        F.sum("is_new_burst").over(Window.partitionBy("segment").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("session_no"),
    )
)

scored = (
    sessions_sessions
    .select(

        "customer_id",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        "segment",

        F.avg("session_no").over(Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("started_at"), "customer_id").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("session_no_avg_3"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "segment").orderBy(F.col("session_no").desc())).alias("session_no_dense_rank"),

)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

enriched = (
    df_transactions
    .select(
        "id",
        "txn_time",
        "is_flagged",
        F.lag("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("merchant", "txn_type").orderBy("amount", "id")).alias("prev_amount"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("merchant", "txn_type").orderBy("amount", "id")).alias("row_seq"),
        F.sum("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_amount"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("row_seq").between(4, 7))
    .select(
        "id",
        "is_flagged",
        "row_seq",
        F.ntile(10).over(Window.orderBy("running_amount", "id")).alias("running_amount_bucket"),
        F.ntile(5).over(Window.orderBy("running_amount", "id")).alias("running_amount_bucket_2"),
        F.sum("row_seq").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("txn_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-2592000, Window.currentRow)).alias("row_seq_sum_30d"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "is_flagged",
        "running_amount_bucket_2",
        F.rank().over(Window.orderBy("running_amount_bucket_2")).alias("running_amount_bucket_2_rank"),
        F.lag("running_amount_bucket_2", 1).over(Window.orderBy("running_amount_bucket", "id")).alias("prev_running_amount_bucket_2"),
    )
)

valid = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("prev_running_amount_bucket_2") >= 6)
    .withColumn("running_amount_bucket_2_scaled", F.round((F.col("running_amount_bucket_2") * 1.1), 2))
)

base = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("running_amount_bucket_2").between(4, 7))
    .withColumn("running_amount_bucket_2_scaled_times_running_amount_bucket_2", (F.col("running_amount_bucket_2_scaled") * F.col("running_amount_bucket_2")))
    .withColumn("is_flagged_label", F.when(F.col("is_flagged"), "Yes").otherwise("No"))
)

result = (
    base
    .withColumn("prev_running_amount_bucket_2_tier", F.when(F.col("prev_running_amount_bucket_2") >= 7, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .withColumn("running_amount_bucket_2_scaled_tier", F.when(F.col("running_amount_bucket_2_scaled") >= 83, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["prev_running_amount_bucket_2_tier", "running_amount_bucket_2_scaled_tier"], ["prev_running_amount_bucket_2_tier"]],
        "prev_running_amount_bucket_2_tier",
        "running_amount_bucket_2_scaled_tier",
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("running_amount_bucket_2", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("running_amount_bucket_2_quartiles"),
        F.round(F.avg("running_amount_bucket_2_scaled_times_running_amount_bucket_2"), 2).alias("avg_running_amount_bucket_2_scaled_times_running_amount_bucket_2"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("distinct_ids") >= 1)
    .orderBy(F.col("running_amount_bucket_2_scaled_tier").desc())
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "monthly_fee",
        F.when(F.col("status") == "ACTIVE", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_active"),
        F.round(F.col("monthly_fee") * 1.07, 2).alias("monthly_fee_scaled"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("monthly_fee") < 240)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round("is_active", 1).alias("is_active_rounded"),
        F.when(F.col("plan").isin(["basic", "enterprise"]), "Group A").otherwise("Other").alias("plan_group"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("monthly_fee_scaled").desc_nulls_first(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

base_subscriptions = (
    ranked
    .filter(F.col("monthly_fee_scaled") >= 25)
    .withColumn("monthly_fee_band", F.when(F.col("monthly_fee") >= 255, "High").when(F.col("monthly_fee") >= 116, "Medium").otherwise("Low"))
)

with_windows = (
    base_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("monthly_fee").between(140, 200))
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "monthly_fee",
        "is_active",
        "plan_group",
        "latest_rank",
        "monthly_fee_band",
        F.ntile(10).over(Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("is_active").desc(), "id")).alias("is_active_bucket"),
        F.ntile(4).over(Window.orderBy("monthly_fee", "id")).alias("monthly_fee_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("latest_rank", "id")).alias("event_seq"),
        F.ntile(4).over(Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("monthly_fee_scaled").desc(), "id")).alias("monthly_fee_scaled_bucket"),
        F.last("monthly_fee", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("latest_rank", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

ranked_subscriptions = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("last_known_monthly_fee").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "is_active",
        "latest_rank",
        "monthly_fee_band",
        "is_active_bucket",
        "monthly_fee_bucket",
        "event_seq",
        "monthly_fee_scaled_bucket",
    )
)

result = (
    ranked_subscriptions
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "is_active",
        "latest_rank",
        "monthly_fee_band",
        "is_active_bucket",
        "monthly_fee_bucket",
        "monthly_fee_scaled_bucket",
        F.when(F.col("plan").rlike("^(basic|premium)$"), "OTHER_ZONE").otherwise("EXTENDED").alias("plan_zone"),
    )
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
```

```python
    .drop("rank_in_group")
)
```

```python
    .drop("dedup_rank")
)

    .select(

        "end_date",
        "status",
        F.datediff(F.current_date(), "end_date").alias("days_since_end_date"),
        F.date_sub("end_date", 57).alias("end_date_minus_57d"),
    )
)

base = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("days_since_end_date") < 53)
    .withColumn("months_since_end_date_minus_57d", F.datediff(F.current_date(), "end_date_minus_57d") / 30)
)

scored = (

    .select(

        "plan",
        "end_date",

        F.first("days_since_end_date", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("end_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_days_since_end_date"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("shipped_date", "id")

metrics = (
    df_shipments
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("cost").over(w_grp).alias("prev_cost"),
        F.lead("cost").over(w_grp).alias("next_cost"),
        F.row_number().over(w_grp).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

metrics_shipments = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "event_seq",
        F.ntile(10).over(Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("prev_cost", "id")).alias("prev_cost_bucket"),
        F.sum("prev_cost").over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("shipped_date"), "order_id").orderBy("prev_cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_prev_cost"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    metrics_shipments
    .select("id", "carrier")
    .subtract(
        df_shipments
        .filter(F.col("shipped_date") < "2024-03-30")
        .select("id", "carrier")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    metrics_shipments
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.carrier") == F.col("k.carrier")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

matched_keys_2 = (
    kept_rows
    .select("id", "carrier")
    .intersectAll(
        df_shipments
        .filter(F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
        .select("id", "carrier")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    kept_rows
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys_2.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.carrier") == F.col("k.carrier")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

cleaned = (
    reconciled
    .filter(F.col("carrier").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "event_seq",
        "prev_cost_bucket",
        "cumulative_prev_cost",
        F.round((F.col("cumulative_prev_cost") / F.col("event_seq")), 2).alias("cumulative_prev_cost_per_event_seq"),
        F.least(F.col("cumulative_prev_cost"), F.col("prev_cost_bucket")).alias("least_cumulative_prev_cost_prev_cost_bucket"),
    )
)

valid = (
    cleaned
    .filter((F.col("shipped_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-06-01"))) & F.col("carrier").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "shipped_date",
        "prev_cost_bucket",
        "cumulative_prev_cost",
        "cumulative_prev_cost_per_event_seq",
        F.greatest(F.col("prev_cost_bucket"), F.col("least_cumulative_prev_cost_prev_cost_bucket")).alias("greatest_prev_cost_bucket_least_cumulative_prev_cost_prev_cost_bucket"),
        F.round((F.col("prev_cost_bucket") / F.col("cumulative_prev_cost")), 2).alias("prev_cost_bucket_per_cumulative_prev_cost"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("carrier"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("carrier_filled"),
    )
)

base = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("cumulative_prev_cost_per_event_seq") <= 51)
    .select(
        "id",
        "shipped_date",
        "cumulative_prev_cost",
        "cumulative_prev_cost_per_event_seq",
        "greatest_prev_cost_bucket_least_cumulative_prev_cost_prev_cost_bucket",
        "carrier_filled",
        F.round(F.col("prev_cost_bucket"), 1).alias("prev_cost_bucket_rounded"),
        F.add_months(F.col("shipped_date"), 3).alias("shipped_date_plus_months"),
    )
)

result = (
    base
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "shipped_date_plus_months").alias("activity_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids_2"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids_3"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("distinct_ids").asc_nulls_first())
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid = (
    df_web_events
    .filter((F.col("event_time") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-06-11"))) & F.col("page").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.datediff(F.current_date(), "event_time") / 30).alias("months_since_event_time"),
        F.initcap(F.trim("event_type")).alias("event_type_title"),
        F.coalesce("page", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("page_clean"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("months_since_event_time") <= 51)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("months_since_event_time", 1, 0).over(Window.partitionBy("session_id", "event_type").orderBy("months_since_event_time", "id")).alias("prev_months_since_event_time"),
        F.last("duration_sec", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_duration_sec"),
        F.count("duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "event_time"), "event_type").orderBy(F.col("event_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)).alias("duration_sec_count_7d"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy(F.col("months_since_event_time").desc_nulls_first(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

with_windows_web_events = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "event_type",
        "page",
        "event_time",
        "event_type_title",
        "page_clean",
        "last_known_duration_sec",
        "row_num",
        F.first("months_since_event_time", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy("prev_months_since_event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_months_since_event_time"),
        F.count("last_known_duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type")).alias("event_type_count_last_known_duration_sec"),
        F.lag("prev_months_since_event_time", 2, 0).over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("year", "event_time"), "event_type").orderBy("months_since_event_time", "id")).alias("prev_prev_months_since_event_time"),
        F.lag("months_since_event_time", 1, 0).over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("months_since_event_time", "id")).alias("prev_months_since_event_time_2"),
        F.lead("months_since_event_time", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("duration_sec_count_7d", "id")).alias("next_months_since_event_time"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    with_windows_web_events
    .filter(F.col("first_known_months_since_event_time").between(43, 79))
    .withColumn("first_known_months_since_event_time_level", F.when(F.col("first_known_months_since_event_time") >= 62, "High").when(F.col("first_known_months_since_event_time") >= 10, "Medium").otherwise("Low"))
    .withColumn("page_clean_2", F.coalesce("page", F.lit("UNKNOWN")))
)

result = (
    cleaned
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("dim"), F.col("src.session_id") == F.col("dim.id"), "inner")

        F.col("dim.device").alias("device"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_running = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("country", "city").orderBy("rating", "id")

filtered = (
    df_suppliers
    .filter(F.upper("supplier_name").like("%URO%"))
    .withColumn("clean_supplier_name", F.trim("supplier_name"))
)

deduped = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("rating").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .select("id", "country", "city", "rating", "clean_supplier_name")
)

scored = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "*",
        F.min("rating").over(w_running).alias("last4_min_rating"),
        F.avg("rating").over(w_running).alias("last4_avg_rating"),
        F.count("rating").over(w_running).alias("last4_count_rating"),
        F.max("rating").over(w_running).alias("last4_max_rating"),
        F.lead("rating", 1).over(w_grp).alias("next_rating"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "city",
        "last4_max_rating",
        "next_rating",
        F.lag("last4_max_rating").over(Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("last4_max_rating", "id")).alias("prev_last4_max_rating"),
        F.lead("last4_max_rating").over(Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("last4_max_rating", "id")).alias("next_last4_max_rating"),
        F.lag("last4_avg_rating").over(Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("last4_max_rating", "id")).alias("prev_last4_avg_rating"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("last4_max_rating", "id")).alias("row_seq"),
    )
)

filtered_suppliers = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("city").isNotNull() & (~F.col("city").eqNullSafe(F.lit("Chiang Mai"))))
    .select(
        "id",
        "city",
        "last4_max_rating",
        "next_rating",
        "prev_last4_max_rating",
        "prev_last4_avg_rating",
        F.round("row_seq", 0).alias("row_seq_rounded"),
        (F.col("row_seq") * F.col("next_rating")).alias("row_seq_times_next_rating"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    filtered_suppliers
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count("next_rating").over(Window.partitionBy("city")).alias("city_count_next_rating"),
        F.first("prev_last4_max_rating", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("prev_last4_max_rating", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_prev_last4_max_rating"),
        F.lead("row_seq_times_next_rating", 1).over(Window.orderBy("prev_last4_avg_rating", "id")).alias("next_row_seq_times_next_rating"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .groupBy(
        "city",
        F.when(F.col("next_row_seq_times_next_rating") >= 73, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("next_row_seq_times_next_rating_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count_if(F.col("city") == "Bangkok").alias("bangkok_events"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.min("row_seq_rounded").alias("min_row_seq_rounded"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("min_row_seq_rounded") > 0)
    .orderBy(F.col("city").asc_nulls_last())
)
```

```python
    .select("job_title")
    .intersect(
        df_employees
        .filter(F.col("salary") > 103000)
        .select("job_title")

    .select("s.*")
)

joined_employees = (
    reconciled
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_employees.alias("d"), F.col("s.manager_id") == F.col("d.id"), "inner")
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

filtered = (
    df_sessions
    .filter(~F.col("browser").eqNullSafe(F.lit("Firefox")) & (F.col("browser") == "Edge"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.concat_ws("-", "browser", "device").alias("browser_device_key"),
        F.coalesce("browser", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("resolved_browser"),
    )
)

gaps = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("started_at") - F.lag("started_at").over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("started_at", "id")) > F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_sessions = (
    gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        "browser_device_key",
        "resolved_browser",
        F.sum("is_new_burst").over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("session_id"),
    )
)

result = (
    sessions_sessions
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("WEEK", "started_at").alias("week_start"), "session_id")
    .agg(
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("country") == "SG", F.col("session_id"))).alias("sg_avg_session_id"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("country") == "DE", 1)).alias("de_rows"),
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("started_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("started_at"))) / 60).alias("span_minutes"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("country") == "DE", 1)).alias("de_rows_2"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("country") == "SG", F.col("session_id"))).alias("sg_total_session_id"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

cleaned = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("start_date") > F.lit("2023-04-28").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("plan_lower", F.lower("plan"))
)

enriched = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "id",
        "end_date",
        "monthly_fee",
        "status",
        F.lag("monthly_fee").over(Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("end_date", "id")).alias("prev_monthly_fee"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("end_date", "id")).alias("row_seq"),
        F.ntile(5).over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "end_date"), "status").orderBy("monthly_fee", "id")).alias("monthly_fee_bucket"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("end_date").desc_nulls_first(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

base = (
    ranked
    .filter((F.col("end_date") >= F.lit("2023-06-01").cast("date")) & (F.col("monthly_fee") >= 210))
    .withColumn("days_since_end_date", F.datediff(F.current_date(), "end_date"))
)

cleaned_subscriptions = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("end_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-09-15")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "end_date",
        "monthly_fee",
        "status",
        "prev_monthly_fee",
        "row_seq",
        "monthly_fee_bucket",
        "rank_in_group",
        "days_since_end_date",
        F.least("row_seq", "monthly_fee").alias("least_row_seq_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

result = (
    cleaned_subscriptions
    .select(
        "id",
        "end_date",
        "status",
        "row_seq",
        "monthly_fee_bucket",
        "rank_in_group",
        "days_since_end_date",
        F.when(F.col("status").rlike("^(EXPIRED|ACTIVE)$"), "GROUP_A").when(F.col("status").rlike("^(CANCELLED|PAUSED)$"), "GROUP_B").otherwise("CORE").alias("status_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy("rank_in_group")
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
```
```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

deduped = (
    df_transactions
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc_nulls_first(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

base = (
    deduped
    .filter((F.col("txn_type") == "CREDIT") & (F.col("merchant").eqNullSafe(F.lit("Starbucks"))))
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "amount",
        "txn_time",
        "merchant",
        "rank_in_group",
        F.least("amount", "rank_in_group").alias("least_amount_rank_in_group"),
    )
)

deduped_transactions = (
    base
    .withColumn("rank_in_group_2", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy(F.col("least_amount_rank_in_group").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group_2") == 1)
)

metrics = (
    deduped_transactions
    .filter(F.col("least_amount_rank_in_group") > 23)
    .select(
        "id",
        "amount",
        "txn_time",
        "merchant",
        "rank_in_group_2",
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("account_id", "merchant").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc_nulls_first())).alias("amount_dense_rank"),
        F.avg("amount").over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("txn_time")).orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)).alias("amount_avg_5_prior"),
        F.avg("least_amount_rank_in_group").over(Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy(F.col("txn_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7776000, Window.currentRow)).alias("least_amount_rank_in_group_avg_90d"),
        F.lead("least_amount_rank_in_group", 1, 0).over(Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("amount", "id")).alias("next_least_amount_rank_in_group"),
        F.avg("amount").over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("txn_time"), "merchant").orderBy("rank_in_group_2", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("amount_avg_3"),
    )
)

flagged = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("txn_time") - F.lag("txn_time").over(Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("txn_time", "id")) > F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = (
    flagged
    .select(
        "id",
        "amount",
        "txn_time",
        "merchant",
        "amount_dense_rank",
        "amount_avg_5_prior",
        "amount_avg_3",
        F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("session_no"),
    )
)

deduped_transactions_2 = (
    sessionized
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy(F.col("amount_dense_rank").desc_nulls_first(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

filtered = (
    deduped_transactions_2
    .filter(F.col("txn_time") >= F.lit("2023-10-31 11:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .withColumn("amount_avg_5_prior_level", F.when(F.col("amount_avg_5_prior") >= 4052, "High").when(F.col("amount_avg_5_prior") >= 1920, "Medium").otherwise("Low"))
)

result = (
    filtered
    .groupBy(
        "session_no",
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("amount_dense_rank", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("amount_dense_rank_quartiles"),
        F.min("txn_time").alias("started_at"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("txn_time")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("txn_time"))) / 60).alias("duration_min"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("merchant")).alias("merchant_list"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
    )
)
```

```python
    .join(df_stores.alias("s"), F.col("src.store_id") == F.col("s.id"), "left")
    .select("src.*", F.col("s.sqft"), F.col("s.store_name"))
)

latest = (
    with_dims
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("store_id", "product_id").orderBy(F.col("quantity_adjusted").desc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .select("id", "product_id", "quantity_adjusted", "sqft")
)

matched_keys = (
    latest
    .select("id", "product_id")
    .subtract(
        df_inventory
        .filter(F.col("last_restock") >= "2023-12-01")
        .select("id", "product_id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    latest
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.product_id") == F.col("k.product_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    reconciled
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_products.alias("d"), F.col("src.product_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
```

```python
    .withColumn("txn_time_day", F.day("txn_time"))

    deduped
    .filter(F.col("txn_time") < "2023-11-13")
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "txn_type",
        "amount",
        "txn_time",

        "is_flagged",
        F.sum("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("txn_time_day", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_amount"),
        F.sum("txn_time_day").over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("txn_time"), "account_id").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_txn_time_day"),
        F.ntile(5).over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("txn_time"), "merchant").orderBy("amount", "id")).alias("amount_bucket"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w_hist).alias("amount_cume_dist"),
    )
)

    metrics
    .filter(F.col("txn_time") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-06-10")))

    )
```

```python
    flattened
    .select("id")
    .intersectAll(
        df_carts
        .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
        .select("id")
    )
)

verified = (
    flattened
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")

        F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("product_id").desc_nulls_last())).alias("product_id_dense_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w_ordered).alias("price_rank"),
    )
)

        "position",
        "product_id",
```

```python
w_part = Window.orderBy("seq_no", "id")

deduped = (
    df_promotions
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy(F.col("starts_on").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select("id", "starts_on", "ends_on", "discount_pct")
)

scored = (
    deduped
    .filter(F.col("discount_pct").between(0.2, 0.29))
    .withColumn("running_discount_pct", F.sum("discount_pct").over(Window.orderBy("ends_on", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy("ends_on", "id")))
)

scored_promotions = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "starts_on",
        "ends_on",
        "running_discount_pct",
        F.lead("running_discount_pct").over(w_part).alias("next_running_discount_pct"),
        F.lag("running_discount_pct").over(w_part).alias("prev_running_discount_pct"),
        F.lag("discount_pct").over(w_part).alias("prev_discount_pct"),
        F.lead("discount_pct").over(w_part).alias("next_discount_pct"),
        F.row_number().over(w_part).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    scored_promotions
    .withColumn("running_discount_pct_bucket", F.ntile(3).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("running_discount_pct").desc(), "id")))
    .withColumn("event_seq_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("event_seq").desc())))
)

base = (
    enriched
    .filter((F.col("ends_on") >= F.lit("2023-08-17").cast("date")) & F.col("prev_discount_pct").between(0.12, 0.28))
    .select(
        "id",
        "ends_on",
        "running_discount_pct",
        "next_running_discount_pct",
        "prev_running_discount_pct",
        "prev_discount_pct",
        "next_discount_pct",
        "event_seq",
        "running_discount_pct_bucket",
        "event_seq_cume_dist",
        (F.col("event_seq_cume_dist") - F.col("running_discount_pct_bucket")).alias("event_seq_cume_dist_minus_running_discount_pct_bucket"),
    )
)

base_promotions = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("ends_on") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-07-09")))
    .withColumn("prev_running_discount_pct_per_next_running_discount_pct", F.round((F.col("prev_running_discount_pct") / F.col("next_running_discount_pct")), 2))
)

result = (
    base_promotions
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("next_discount_pct") >= 0.29, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("next_discount_pct_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("next_running_discount_pct"), 2).alias("avg_next_running_discount_pct"),
        F.round(F.avg("prev_running_discount_pct_per_next_running_discount_pct"), 2).alias("avg_prev_running_discount_pct_per_next_running_discount_pct"),
        F.percentile_approx("event_seq", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("event_seq_quartiles"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.percentile_approx("running_discount_pct_bucket", 0.95).alias("running_discount_pct_bucket_p95"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids_2"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("distinct_ids_2").desc())
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid = (
    df_accounts
    .filter(F.col("status").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "account_type",
        "balance",
        "opened_date",
        F.substring("status", 1, 2).alias("status_prefix"),
        F.date_sub("opened_date", 44).alias("opened_date_minus_44d"),
    )
)

scored = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("balance") < 77000)
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_type",
        "balance",
        "opened_date",
        "opened_date_minus_44d",
        F.avg("balance").over(Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("balance", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_avg_balance"),
        F.max("balance").over(Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("balance", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_max_balance"),
        F.count("balance").over(Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("balance", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count_balance"),
        F.lead("balance", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("account_type").orderBy("balance", "id")).alias("next_balance"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    scored
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("running_max_balance").over(Window.partitionBy("account_type").orderBy("opened_date", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)).alias("running_max_balance_avg_6_prior"),
        F.sum("running_count_balance").over(Window.partitionBy("account_type").orderBy("running_count_balance", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_running_count_balance"),
    )
)

not_flagged = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("x"), (F.col("x.account_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.txn_time") < F.col("s.opened_date_minus_44d")), "left_anti")
)

result = (
    not_flagged
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_type",
        "opened_date",
        "opened_date_minus_44d",
        "running_avg_balance",
        "running_max_balance",
        "running_count_balance",
        "next_balance",
        "running_max_balance_avg_6_prior",
        F.when(F.col("account_type").rlike("^(CHECKING|SAVINGS)$"), "GROUP_B").when(F.col("account_type").rlike("^(CREDIT|LOAN)$"), "EXTENDED").otherwise("GROUP_A").alias("account_type_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy("account_type")
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)

valid = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("reading_ts") >= F.lit("2025-09-01").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("greatest_temp_c_pressure", F.greatest("temp_c", "pressure"))
)

with_windows = (
    valid
    .withColumn("last4_min_temp_c", F.min("temp_c").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("last4_sum_temp_c", F.sum("temp_c").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("last4_max_temp_c", F.max("temp_c").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("pressure_rank", F.rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("pressure").asc_nulls_last())))
)

filtered = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("pressure").between(1016, 1019))
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("last4_max_temp_c") + F.col("pressure_rank")).alias("last4_max_temp_c_plus_pressure_rank"),
        F.when(F.col("status_bits") >= 12, "High").when(F.col("status_bits") >= 3, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("status_bits_level"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    filtered
    .select("id", "device_code")
    .subtract(
        df_device_readings
        .filter(F.col("status_bits") > 10)
        .select("id", "device_code")
    )
)

verified = (
    filtered
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.device_code") == F.col("k.device_code")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

filtered_device_readings = (
    verified
    .filter(F.col("humidity") >= 49)
    .withColumn("pressure_band", F.when(F.col("pressure") >= 1022, "High").when(F.col("pressure") >= 999, "Medium").otherwise("Low"))
)

scored = (
    filtered_device_readings
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "pressure",
        "last4_min_temp_c",
        "pressure_rank",
        "last4_max_temp_c_plus_pressure_rank",
        "pressure_band",
        F.count("last4_min_temp_c").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-1800, Window.currentRow)).alias("last4_min_temp_c_count_30m"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("greatest_temp_c_pressure").desc_nulls_last())).alias("greatest_temp_c_pressure_rank"),
    )
)

scored_device_readings = (
    scored
    .select(
        "pressure",
        "last4_min_temp_c",
        "pressure_rank",
        "last4_min_temp_c_count_30m",
        "greatest_temp_c_pressure_rank",
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("pressure").desc_nulls_first())).alias("pressure_dense_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored_device_readings
    .select(
        "last4_min_temp_c",
        "pressure_rank",
        "greatest_temp_c_pressure_rank",
    )
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid = (
    df_shipments
    .filter((F.col("delivered_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-06-01"))) & (F.col("shipped_date") <= "2024-12-30"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "delivered_date",
        "status",
        F.round("cost", 2).alias("cost_rounded"),
        F.concat("carrier", F.lit(" "), "status").alias("carrier_status"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    valid
    .select("carrier")
    .exceptAll(
        df_shipments
        .filter(F.col("order_id").isNull())
        .select("carrier")
    )
)

verified = (
    valid
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.carrier") == F.col("k.carrier")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

filtered = (
    verified
    .filter((F.col("delivered_date") >= F.lit("2023-06-03").cast("date")) & (F.col("shipped_date") >= "2023-07-19"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.upper("carrier").alias("carrier_upper"),
        F.when(F.col("cost_rounded") >= 89, "High").when(F.col("cost_rounded") >= 15, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("cost_rounded_level"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("N/A")).alias("carrier_filled"),
    )
)

remaining_keys = (
    filtered
    .select("status", "carrier")
    .subtract(
        df_shipments
        .filter(F.col("cost").between(56, 65))
        .select("status", "carrier")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    filtered
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.status") == F.col("k.status")) & (F.col("s.carrier") == F.col("k.carrier")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

with_windows = reconciled.withColumn("cost_rounded_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("cost_rounded")))

scored = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("shipped_date") <= "2025-07-01")
    .select(
        "delivered_date",
        "cost_rounded",
        "carrier_status",
        F.rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("cost_rounded").asc_nulls_last())).alias("cost_rounded_rank"),
    )
)

base = (
    scored
    .filter((F.col("delivered_date") > F.lit("2023-08-16").cast("date")) & (F.col("cost_rounded_rank") > 3))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("cost_rounded") >= 66, "High").when(F.col("cost_rounded") >= 10, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("cost_rounded_level"),
        (F.datediff(F.current_date(), "delivered_date") / 365).alias("years_since_delivered_date"),
    )
)

result = (
    base
    .select("cost_rounded", "carrier_status", "cost_rounded_rank")
    .orderBy(F.col("cost_rounded_rank").desc())
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

cleaned = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNotNull() & (F.col("order_id") == 31))
    .withColumn("quantity_scaled", F.round((F.col("quantity") * 0.85), 2))
)

enriched = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "id",
        "quantity",
        "unit_price",
        F.lag("quantity_scaled").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("quantity", "id")).alias("prev_quantity_scaled"),
        F.lead("quantity_scaled").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("quantity", "id")).alias("next_quantity_scaled"),
        F.lag("quantity").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("quantity", "id")).alias("prev_quantity"),
        F.lead("quantity").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("quantity", "id")).alias("next_quantity"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("quantity", "id")).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

cleaned_order_items = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("prev_quantity_scaled") < 42)
    .select(
        "id",
        "quantity",
        "prev_quantity_scaled",
        "next_quantity_scaled",
        "prev_quantity",
        "next_quantity",
        "event_seq",
        F.least(F.col("prev_quantity_scaled"), F.col("quantity")).alias("least_prev_quantity_scaled_quantity"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    cleaned_order_items
    .select(
        "id",
        "quantity",
        "prev_quantity_scaled",
        "prev_quantity",
        "next_quantity",
        F.sum("quantity").over(Window.orderBy("event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_sum_quantity"),
        F.max("quantity").over(Window.orderBy("event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_max_quantity"),
        F.avg("quantity").over(Window.orderBy("event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_avg_quantity"),
        F.count("quantity").over(Window.orderBy("event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count_quantity"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("running_max_quantity") >= 8.6, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("running_max_quantity_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("quantity", 0.5).alias("quantity_p50"),
        F.percentile_approx("prev_quantity_scaled", 0.95).alias("prev_quantity_scaled_p95"),
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("quantity_p50").desc_nulls_first())
)
```

```python
        "status",
        F.datediff(F.current_date(), "shipped_date").alias("days_since_shipped_date"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("carrier_filled"),
    )
)

latest = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("delivered_date").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)

    .select("order_id")
    .exceptAll(

        .filter(F.col("shipped_date") >= "2025-05-01")
        .select("order_id")
    )
)

    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.order_id") == F.col("k.order_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

base = (
    verified
    .filter((F.col("shipped_date") >= F.lit("2023-04-06")) & (F.col("carrier").isNotNull()))

        F.datediff(F.current_date(), "shipped_date").alias("days_since_shipped_date_2"),

    .join(df_orders.alias("p"), F.col("src.order_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")

        "shipped_date",

        "days_since_shipped_date_2",
        "is_lost",
        "amount",
        F.round((F.col("amount") / F.sum("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("carrier"))), 4).alias("amount_share"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("is_lost").desc_nulls_first())).alias("is_lost_dense_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("days_since_shipped_date")).alias("days_since_shipped_date_cume_dist"),
        F.count("is_lost").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("shipped_date"), "order_id")).alias("shipped_date_month_count_is_lost"),
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "shipped_date"), "order_id").orderBy(F.col("is_lost").desc())).alias("is_lost_percent_rank"),

)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

with_dims = (
    df_web_events
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("d"), F.col("e.session_id") == F.col("d.id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("d.customer_id").isin([16, 23, 25, 35]))
    .select("e.*", F.col("d.browser"))
)

with_windows = (
    with_dims
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(5).over(Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("event_time"), "page").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").desc(), "id")).alias("duration_sec_bucket"),
        F.lead("duration_sec", 1).over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("WEEK", "event_time"), "event_type").orderBy("event_time", "id")).alias("next_duration_sec"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").desc(), "id")).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

scored = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "duration_sec",
        "browser",
        "next_duration_sec",
        "event_seq",
        F.sum("duration_sec_bucket").over(Window.partitionBy("page", "session_id").orderBy("duration_sec_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_duration_sec_bucket"),
        F.max("event_seq").over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy(F.col("event_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)).alias("event_seq_max_7d"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    scored
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").asc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

result = (
    deduped
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("event_seq") >= 8, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("event_seq_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("running_duration_sec_bucket") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("browser") == "Chrome", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("running_duration_sec_bucket_per_chrome"),
        F.count_if(F.col("browser") == "Safari").alias("safari_events"),
        F.count_if(F.col("browser") == "Edge").alias("edge_events"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("browser")).alias("num_browsers"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("safari_events").desc_nulls_first())
)
```
