        "firmware",
        F.lower("firmware").alias("firmware_lower"),
        F.initcap(F.trim("device_code")).alias("device_code_title"),
    )
)

valid = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("firmware").isin(["1.0.3", "1.1.0", "2.0.1"]))
    .withColumn("firmware_length", F.length("firmware"))
)

    .select(
        "id",

        "status_bits",
        "device_code_title",

        F.avg("humidity").over(w_running).alias("last7_avg_humidity"),
        F.sum("humidity").over(w_running).alias("last7_sum_humidity"),
        F.min("humidity").over(w_running).alias("last7_min_humidity"),

    enriched
    .filter(F.col("last7_max_humidity") >= 59)
    .withColumn("last7_max_humidity_rounded", F.round("last7_max_humidity", 2))
)

daily = (
    base
    .cube(
        F.when(F.col("last7_min_humidity") >= 66, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("last7_min_humidity_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("last7_max_humidity") >= 82, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("last7_max_humidity_tier"),
    )

        F.percentile_approx("last7_min_humidity", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("last7_min_humidity_quartiles"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.sum("status_bits").alias("total_status_bits"),
        F.bit_and("status_bits").alias("status_bits_bit_and"),
    )
)

result = (
    daily
    .select(
        "last7_min_humidity_tier",
        "last7_max_humidity_tier",
        "last7_min_humidity_quartiles",
        "event_count",
        "total_status_bits",

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy(F.col("seq_no_whole").desc_nulls_last())
w_running = Window.orderBy(F.col("created_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-3600, Window.currentRow)

flattened = (
    df_carts
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "created_at",
        "coupon_codes",
        F.explode("attributes").alias("attr_key", "attr_value"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    flattened
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "attr_key").orderBy("created_at", "id", "attr_key")).alias("event_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("created_at").desc(), "id", "attr_key")).alias("seq_no"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy("created_at", "id", "attr_key")).alias("seq_no_2"),
    )
)

base = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("seq_no").between(5, 6))
    .select(
        "id",
        "created_at",
        "attr_key",
        "attr_value",
        "seq_no_2",
        F.ceil("seq_no").alias("seq_no_whole"),
        F.coalesce("attr_key", F.lit("NONE")).alias("attr_key_clean"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    base
    .select("id")
    .intersect(
        df_carts
        .filter(F.col("created_at") >= "2024-02-24")
        .select("id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

enriched_carts = (
    reconciled
    .select(
        "*",
        F.percent_rank().over(w_grp).alias("seq_no_whole_percent_rank"),
        F.max("seq_no_whole").over(Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("created_at"), "attr_key").orderBy(F.col("created_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-900, Window.currentRow)).alias("seq_no_whole_max_15m"),
        F.count("seq_no_2").over(w_running).alias("seq_no_2_count_1h"),
        F.avg("seq_no_whole").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("created_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-1800, Window.currentRow)).alias("seq_no_whole_avg_30m"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    enriched_carts
    .filter(F.col("attr_key").isNotNull() & (F.col("created_at") > F.lit("2025-03-01 19:00:00").cast("timestamp")))
    .withColumn("created_at_period", F.date_trunc("WEEK", "created_at"))

        "id",
        "created_at",
        "attr_key_clean",
        "seq_no_whole_avg_30m",
        "created_at_period",
        F.round((F.col("seq_no_2_count_1h") / F.sum("seq_no_2_count_1h").over(Window.partitionBy("attr_key"))), 4).alias("seq_no_2_count_1h_share"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched_carts_2
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("seq_no_whole_avg_30m") >= 73, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("seq_no_whole_avg_30m_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("seq_no_2_count_1h_share"), 2).alias("avg_seq_no_2_count_1h_share"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("distinct_ids") < 1000)
    .orderBy(F.col("avg_seq_no_2_count_1h_share").desc())
)

    )
)

enriched = (
    base_subscriptions
    .select(
        "id",
        "end_date",
        "monthly_fee_sum_90d",
        "first_known_monthly_fee",
        "monthly_fee_avg_3_prior",

    .select(
        "account_id",
        "txn_type",
        "txn_time",

    .select(

        "customer_id",

        "start_date",
        "end_date",
        "monthly_fee",
        "status",
        (F.datediff(F.current_date(), "start_date") / 30).alias("months_since_start_date"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    base
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("months_since_start_date").asc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

valid = (
    deduped
    .filter(F.col("end_date") > F.lit("2023-09-19").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "end_date",
        "monthly_fee",
        "months_since_start_date",
        F.ceil("monthly_fee").alias("monthly_fee_whole"),
    )
)

deduped_subscriptions = (
    valid
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("months_since_start_date", "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

enriched = (
    deduped_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("customer_id") == 2)
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "monthly_fee",
        "months_since_start_date",
        "rank_in_group",
        F.lag("monthly_fee_whole", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("rank_in_group", "id")).alias("prev_monthly_fee_whole"),
        F.avg("monthly_fee").over(Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("months_since_start_date", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)).alias("monthly_fee_avg_5"),
        F.max("monthly_fee_whole").over(Window.partitionBy("customer_id")).alias("customer_id_max_monthly_fee_whole"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("end_date"), "customer_id").orderBy(F.col("monthly_fee").asc_nulls_first())).alias("monthly_fee_dense_rank"),
        F.sum("monthly_fee").over(Window.orderBy("monthly_fee_whole", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "prev_monthly_fee_whole",
        "monthly_fee_avg_5",
        "monthly_fee_dense_rank",
        F.lead("customer_id_max_monthly_fee_whole").over(w_ordered).alias("next_customer_id_max_monthly_fee_whole"),

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("week", "sale_date"), "product_id").orderBy("sale_date", "id")
w_hist = Window.orderBy(F.col("price").asc_nulls_first())
w_running = Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy("stock_qty", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_running_2 = Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy(F.col("stock_qty").asc_nulls_first())

metrics = (
    df_store_sales
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "sale_date",
        F.round((F.col("units") / F.sum("units").over(Window.partitionBy("store_id"))), 4).alias("units_share"),
        F.lag("revenue", 2).over(w_part).alias("prev_revenue"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("units").asc_nulls_first())).alias("units_rank"),
        F.avg("revenue").over(Window.orderBy("sale_date", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)).alias("revenue_avg_2"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    metrics
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("e.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("p.product_name").like("Lap%"))
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.product_id",
        "e.prev_revenue",
        F.col("p.launch_date"),
        F.col("p.price"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "prev_revenue",
        "launch_date",
        "price",
        F.sum("prev_revenue").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("prev_revenue", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_prev_revenue"),
        F.sum("prev_revenue").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("price", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_prev_revenue"),
        F.lead("price", 2).over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("launch_date"), "product_id").orderBy("prev_revenue", "id")).alias("next_price"),
        F.last("price", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("price", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_price"),
        F.ntile(4).over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("price", "id")).alias("price_bucket"),
    )
)

joined = (
    with_windows
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("e.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.product_id",
        "e.price",
        "e.cumulative_prev_revenue",
        "e.last_known_price",
        "e.price_bucket",
        F.col("p.category"),
        F.col("p.stock_qty"),
        F.col("p.launch_date").alias("product_launch_date"),
    )
)

metrics_store_sales = (
    joined
    .select(
        "*",
        F.dense_rank().over(w_hist).alias("price_dense_rank"),
        F.sum("last_known_price").over(w_running).alias("running_last_known_price"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w_running_2).alias("stock_qty_cume_dist"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics_store_sales
    .withColumn("running_stock_qty_cume_dist", F.sum("stock_qty_cume_dist").over(Window.orderBy("last_known_price", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("stock_qty_avg_5_prior", F.avg("stock_qty").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("running_last_known_price", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)))
    .withColumn("running_last_known_price_share", F.round((F.col("running_last_known_price") / F.sum("running_last_known_price").over(Window.partitionBy("category"))), 4))
)

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

lines = (

        "currency",

    lines
    .select(
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        "element",
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("element").desc_nulls_first())).alias("element_rank"),
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("element").asc_nulls_first())).alias("element_percent_rank"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    with_windows
    .select("plan")
    .subtract(
        df_price_tiers
        .filter(F.col("currency") == "USD")
        .select("plan")
    )
)

verified = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.plan") == F.col("k.plan")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

remaining_keys = (
    verified
    .select("plan")
    .subtract(
        df_price_tiers
        .filter(F.col("currency") == "USD")
        .select("plan")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    verified
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.plan") == F.col("k.plan")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    kept_rows
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("element") >= 71, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("element_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("plan") == "basic", F.col("element"))).alias("basic_total_element"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("plan")).alias("num_plans"),
        F.percentile_approx("element_percent_rank", 0.95).alias("element_percent_rank_p95"),

lines = (

    .filter(F.col("key") == "version")
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "key",
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(8) != 0).cast("int").alias("flag_bit8"),
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
    )
)

scored = (
    unpacked
    .filter(F.col("flag_bit8") == 0)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(10).over(Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("flag_bit8").desc(), "id", "key")).alias("flag_bit8_bucket"),
        F.first("status_code_high", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("key", "service").orderBy("flag_bit8", "id", "key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_status_code_high"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    scored
    .withColumn("running_count_flag_bit8", F.count("flag_bit8").over(Window.partitionBy("service", "key").orderBy("status_code_high", "id", "key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("running_max_flag_bit8", F.max("flag_bit8").over(Window.partitionBy("service", "key").orderBy("status_code_high", "id", "key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("running_min_flag_bit8", F.min("flag_bit8").over(Window.partitionBy("service", "key").orderBy("status_code_high", "id", "key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
)

matched_keys = (
    metrics
    .select("service", "id")
    .intersect(
        df_app_logs
        .filter(F.to_date("log_ts") >= "2025-05-22")
        .select("service", "id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.service") == F.col("k.service")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

metrics_app_logs = (
    reconciled
    .withColumn("key_stddev_samp_first_known_status_code_high", F.stddev_samp("first_known_status_code_high").over(Window.partitionBy("key", "service")))
)

result = (
    metrics_app_logs
    .groupBy("service")
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("service") == "search", F.col("key_stddev_samp_first_known_status_code_high")).otherwise(0)).alias("search_key_stddev_samp_first_known_status_code_high"),
        F.avg("key_stddev_samp_first_known_status_code_high").alias("avg_key_stddev_samp_first_known_status_code_high"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("service") == "search", 1)).alias("search_rows"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("service") == "billing", 1)).alias("billing_count"),

    .select("s.*")

        F.round((F.col("quantity") / F.sum("quantity").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id"))), 4).alias("quantity_share"),

        "corr_quantity_unit_price",
        "quantity_rank",

        F.cume_dist().over(w_running).alias("unit_price_cume_dist_2"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w_running_2).alias("quantity_share_percent_rank"),

        F.percentile_approx("quantity_rank", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("quantity_rank_quartiles"),

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

cleaned = (
    df_inventory
    .filter(F.col("last_restock") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-03-31")))
    .select("*", F.coalesce("quantity", F.lit(0)).alias("quantity_filled"))
)

base = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("quantity_filled").between(36, 59))
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "last_restock",
        F.add_months("last_restock", 3).alias("last_restock_plus_months"),
        F.date_trunc("year", "last_restock").alias("last_restock_period"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    base
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_products.alias("d"), F.col("a.product_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("d.product_name"))
)

with_prev = with_dims.withColumn("prev_last_restock_period", F.lag("last_restock_period").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("last_restock_period", "id")))

with_gaps = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_last_restock_period").isNull() | (F.col("last_restock_period") > F.col("prev_last_restock_period") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = (
    with_gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "last_restock",
        "last_restock_period",
        F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("last_restock_period", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("session_no"),
    )
)

result = (
    islands
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("year", "last_restock").alias("year_start"))
    .agg(
        F.max("session_no").alias("max_session_no"),
        F.min("last_restock_period").alias("first_last_restock_period"),
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("last_restock_period")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("last_restock_period"))) / 60).alias("duration_min"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("duration_min") > 0)
    .orderBy(F.col("max_session_no").desc_nulls_last())
)
